title: Graph-theoretic design of lasing networks for physical vision
summary: Physical neural networks perform learning through the intrinsic nonlinear dynamics of matter. Optimising their design presents a considerable challenge: complex many-body physics can provide powerful computation, but are expensive to simulate and large experimental optimisation runs are impractical to fabricate. Hence, the high-dimensional space of possible network topologies cannot be effectively directly searched. Here, we show that this search can be efficiently performed in an abstract graph space that is vastly cheaper to explore. Using random lasing networks -- composed of interconnected nanoscale waveguides and hosting strongly coupled lasing modes -- as an exemplar physical vision system, we establish a quantitative three-layer link: simple graph-theoretic metrics predict the nonlinear lasing physics, which in turn predicts vision performance. After validating this relationship using physical simulations, we exploit it to drive an evolutionary algorithm using graph metrics, producing network topologies that outperform random designs at a fraction of the computational cost (3000$\times$ speed-up compared to physical simulation). On simulated image-classification tasks, graph-optimised networks substantially improve classification accuracy. As our framework operates on network topology rather than substrate-specific physics, we anticipate it can transfer to other network-based physical learning systems, providing an efficient route for the directed design and optimisation of complex, strongly-interacting physical neural networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在抽象图空间而非物理空间中优化物理神经网络拓扑的高效方法。以随机激光网络为例，建立"图度量→非线性激光物理→视觉性能"的定量三层联系，并利用图度量驱动进化算法生成网络拓扑，相比物理仿真实现3000倍加速，显著提升图像分类精度。
AI.motivation: 物理神经网络的优化极具挑战性：复杂多体物理虽能提供强大计算能力，但仿真成本高昂且大规模实验优化不可行，导致高维网络拓扑空间无法被有效直接搜索。
AI.method: 1) 以耦合纳米波导构成的随机激光网络为原型物理视觉系统；2) 建立图论指标→非线性激光物理→视觉性能的三层定量映射关系；3) 用物理仿真验证该关系后，利用图度量驱动的进化算法搜索网络拓扑，替代昂贵的物理仿真优化。
AI.result: 图度量优化的网络拓扑在图像分类任务上显著优于随机设计，同时相比物理仿真实现3000倍计算加速。
AI.conclusion: 该框架基于网络拓扑而非特定基质的物理特性运作，可迁移至其他基于网络的物理学习系统，为复杂强相互作用物理神经网络的定向设计与优化提供高效路径。

title: Superconductivity in the $t$-$t'$ Hubbard Model from Symmetry-Preserving Neural-Network Quantum States
summary: Despite its fundamental importance in the theory of strongly correlated electrons, the nature of the ground state of the two-dimensional doped Hubbard model remains intensely debated. Variational approaches provide a powerful route to this problem, but their conclusions can depend sensitively on the chosen wave-function parameterization, the mean-field initialization, or the pinning fields used to guide the optimization, as well as on boundary conditions. This can favor one type of symmetry breaking over another, making it difficult to distinguish the genuine interplay of intertwined or competing orders from biases induced by the variational parameterization. Here, we introduce the Symmetry-Preserving Backflow Pairing (SBP) ansatz, a neural-network wave function that respects translational symmetry by construction and thereby avoids these broken-symmetry minima. The SBP ansatz reaches state-of-the-art variational energies for the $t$-$t'$ Hubbard model on lattices up to $24\times24$ with $504$ electrons, below those of competing pure stripe solutions. By extrapolating to the thermodynamic limit, we find robust evidence for $d$-wave superconducting order, resolving a long-standing question about the $1/8$-doped model at $t'/t=-0.2$ and $U/t=8.0$. Built on general principles of symmetry and locality, the SBP wave function provides a broadly applicable variational representation for challenging interacting fermionic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对称保持回流配对（SBP）神经网络波函数，通过构造性地保持平移对称性，避免了变分方法中因对称性破缺最小值导致的偏差，在高达24×24、504电子的t-t' Hubbard模型上达到了最先进的变分能量，并通过热力学极限外推证明1/8掺杂、t'/t=-0.2、U/t=8.0体系存在d波超导序，解决了长期争议。
AI.motivation: 二维掺杂Hubbard模型基态性质是强关联电子理论中的根本性问题，但变分方法的结果高度依赖波函数参数化、平均场初始化、固定场和边界条件，容易偏向某种对称性破缺，难以区分真实的竞争序与参数化引入的偏差。
AI.method: 引入对称保持回流配对（SBP）变分基，一种神经网络波函数，通过构造保证平移对称性，避免落入破缺对称性的局部极小值。在高达24×24（504电子）的t-t' Hubbard模型上进行变分优化，并外推到热力学极限。
AI.result: SBP变分基在24×24晶格上达到优于纯条纹态的变分能量，处于当前最优水平。热力学极限外推提供了1/8掺杂、t'/t=-0.2、U/t=8.0体系存在d波超导序的稳健证据。
AI.conclusion: 基于对称性和局域性的一般原理，SBP波函数为具有挑战性的相互作用费米子系统提供了广泛适用的变分表示，解决了关于该掺杂体系是否存在d波超导序的长期争议。

title: Exceptional activated mode theory for generalized real-complex transitions
summary: Real-to-complex spectral transitions mark the onset of amplification in non-Hermitian systems, but their thresholds are often treated as model-specific quantities. Here we develop a general, non-perturbative activated-mode principle that governs the real-to-complex threshold across broad classes of non-Hermitian systems. A central insight is that only a small Hilbert subspace is ``activated" at the transition onset, which can be variationally determined through the competition between spectral detuning and mode-level projected non-Hermitian couplings. The result is a closed-form exceptional-activation condition for arbitrarily large ``disturbances", rather than a perturbative estimate. We apply our framework to three contrasting illustrative problems, establishing (i) a closed-form threshold for critical non-Hermitian skin amplification at \emph{all} system sizes; (ii) a new link between impurity tunneling threshold and exceptional point switching; and (iii) activation channel switching without underlying topological phase transition. Overall, our findings recast real-to-complex transitions as generic mode-selection problems independent of any specific symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个通用的、非微扰的"激活模式"原理，用于描述非厄米系统中实谱到复谱转变（即放大起始）的阈值。核心洞见是转变起始仅涉及一个可利用谱失谐与模式级非厄米耦合竞争来变分确定的小希尔伯特子空间，从而得到适用于任意大小扰动的闭式激发条件，并应用于三类不同问题的阈值分析。
AI.motivation: 非厄米系统中实谱到复谱的转变标志着放大的起始（Exceptional Point），但现有阈值分析通常是模型特异的或微扰性的，缺乏一个统一的、非微扰的理论框架来预测这一转变阈值。
AI.method: 提出"激活模式"原理：在转变起始时仅有一个小希尔伯特子空间被激活，可通过谱失谐与模式级投影非厄米耦合之间的竞争进行变分求解。由此推导出闭式"奇异激活条件"（exceptional-activation condition），适用于任意大小的扰动量，而非仅限微扰范围。
AI.result: 将该框架应用于三个对照性问题：(i) 给出临界非厄米趋肤效应放大在所有系统尺寸下的闭式阈值；(ii) 建立杂质隧穿阈值与奇异点切换之间的新联系；(iii) 展示无底层拓扑相变情况下的激活通道切换现象。
AI.conclusion: 实复谱转变可被重新理解为通用的模式选择问题，与具体对称性无关，为非厄米系统中的放大阈值提供统一的理论描述。

title: The nature of the "pseudogap" in the insulating phase of highly disordered superconductors
summary: Disordered thin films undergoing a superconductor-insulator transition provide a controlled setting for studying pseudogap physics in the absence of competing electronic orders. Although theory predicts that local Cooper pairing can survive deep into the insulating phase, direct spectroscopic confirmation has remained experimentally inaccessible because tunneling measurements in highly insulating films require ultra-high-resistance junctions and picoampere current sensitivity. Here we combine ultra-high-resistance planar tunneling spectroscopy on amorphous indium oxide films with quantum Monte Carlo simulations of the attractive Hubbard model to probe the single-particle excitation spectrum deep in the insulating regime. We find striking agreement between experiment and theory: the single-particle gap not only survives across the superconductor-insulator transition, but increases substantially with disorder, reaching values more than twice those observed on the superconducting side. With increasing temperature, the gap fills rather than closes, while coherence peaks are suppressed and spectral weight redistributes to energies far exceeding the gap scale. Our results provide direct quantitative experimental confirmation of the theoretically predicted Cooper-pair insulating state with localized Cooper pairs and establish a unified connection between the pseudogap above $T_c$ and the insulating gap as manifestations of pairing without global phase coherence.

AI.tldr: 本文将超高电阻平面隧穿谱技术应用于非晶氧化铟薄膜，并结合吸引Hubbard模型的量子蒙特卡洛模拟，在超导-绝缘体转变的深绝缘区探测单粒子激发谱。实验与理论惊人一致：单粒子能隙在转变后不仅存活而且随无序度显著增大（超过超导侧两倍），升温时能隙"填充"而非"闭合"。该工作首次定量证实了局域库珀对绝缘态的存在，统一了Tc以上赝能隙与绝缘体能隙这一配对但无全局相位相干的物理图像。
AI.motivation: 理论预测局域库珀对可在超导-绝缘体转变的深绝缘相中存在，但由于高绝缘薄膜需要超高电阻结和皮安级电流灵敏度，一直缺乏直接的谱学实验验证。作者旨在填补这一实验空白，并为赝能隙物理提供无序体系中无竞争电子序干扰的受控研究平台。
AI.method: 实验上采用超高电阻平面隧穿谱技术测量非晶氧化铟薄膜的单粒子激发谱；理论上运用吸引Hubbard模型的量子蒙特卡洛模拟进行直接对比，两者在深绝缘区同时探测单粒子能隙随无序度的演化规律及其温度依赖行为。
AI.result: 实验与理论定量吻合：单粒子能隙跨越超导-绝缘体转变后继续存活且随无序度大幅增加，峰值约为超导侧两倍以上；升温过程中能隙呈"填充"而非"闭合"行为，相干峰被抑制，谱权重向远超能隙标度的能量再分布。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理论预言的局域库珀对绝缘态（Cooper-pair insulator）提供了直接的定量实验证实，并建立了一个统一框架：Tc以上赝能隙与绝缘体能隙本质上是同一种"配对但缺乏全局相位相干"现象的不同表现。

title: Intermediate scattering function of Brownian particles in a tilted cosine potential
summary: We solve the Fokker-Planck equation for a Brownian particle in a tilted cosine potential and derive the intermediate scattering function (ISF), which captures the full spatio-temporal dynamics of the system. The model consists of a single overdamped Brownian particle in one dimension. We derive a generalized ISF comprising two wave vectors to describe correlations in the periodic potential. Exploiting the periodicity via Bloch's theorem, we formulate the problem within a spectral-theoretical framework and numerically compute the corresponding eigenfunctions and eigenvalues, from which we obtain the ISF and the probability density. Using time-dependent perturbation theory, we expand the ISF and derive low-order moments, including the mean-square displacement, time-dependent diffusivity, skewness, and the non-Gaussian parameter. Our analytical results are validated by Brownian-dynamics simulations and analyzed focussing on different regimes of the tilting force. The results are compared to a harmonic approximation and the deterministic limit.

AI.tldr: 本文求解了倾斜余弦势中布朗粒子的Fokker-Planck方程，推导出包含两个波矢的广义中间散射函数（ISF），利用Bloch定理在谱理论框架下数值计算本征函数与本征值，并通过时间依赖微扰理论展开ISF，得到均方位移、时间依赖扩散率、偏度及非高斯参数等低阶矩。解析结果经布朗动力学模拟验证，并与谐振近似及确定性极限进行了比较。
AI.motivation: 理解布朗粒子在周期性势场中（如倾斜余弦势）的完整时空动力学，特别是中间散射函数能全面刻画系统关联结构，但此前缺乏系统的解析推导，需要对不同倾斜力区域的动力学行为进行深入分析。
AI.method: 采用谱理论结合Bloch定理求解一维过阻尼布朗粒子在倾斜余弦势中的Fokker-Planck算符，数值计算其本征函数与本征值以获得ISF和概率密度；利用时间依赖微扰理论展开ISF以推导低阶矩。
AI.result: 成功获得广义两波矢ISF及概率密度的解析与数值结果，推导出均方位移、时间依赖扩散率、偏度与非高斯参数的表达式，并通过布朗动力学模拟验证了理论结果在不同倾斜力区域的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该谱理论框架能够全面刻画倾斜周期性势中布朗粒子的时空动力学，ISF的推导为后续研究提供了理论基础，并与谐振近似和确定性极限在不同情形下表现出各自适用范围。

title: The "Moiré Capacitor Effect" and Stabilization of Fractional Chern Insulators in Rhombohedral Graphene Superlattices
summary: While the necessity of a moiré potential for fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) in rhombohedral graphene-hBN superlattices, first predicted in Ref. 1, is now grounded in experiments, a theory of its origin and importance remains at large. We present a mechanism---the moiré capacitor effect---that enhances the moiré potential by electrostatically imprinting the valence charge density onto the conduction bands. We derive the analytical form of this term and reveal its crucial role in stabilizing a parent state with Chern number $C=1$ at filling $ν=1$. We propose a parent state theory which posits that stability of the Chern insulator and flatness of its hole excitations are necessary for obtaining FCIs upon doping. We then perform multi-band exact diagonalization calculations to confirm the emergence of FCIs at $ν= 2/3$ in the presence of the moiré capacitor effect. Our FCI state is stabilized by inter-band fluctuations, unlike in the moire-free case which collapses with band-mixing. We provide the first consistent theory for this state in aligned samples and explain its absence in unaligned ones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"莫尔电容器效应"机制，通过静电将价带电荷密度印迹到导带，增强菱方石墨烯-hBN超晶格中的莫尔势，从而稳定Chern数C=1的母态（填充ν=1），并进一步在ν=2/3处确认分数陈绝缘体（FCI）的出现。这是首个针对该体系中FCI态一致性的理论，解释了其在对齐样品中出现而在未对齐样品中缺失的原因。
AI.motivation: 尽管莫尔势对于菱方石墨烯-hBN超晶格中分数陈绝缘体（FCI）的必要性已被实验证实（最初在Ref. 1预测），但其来源和重要性的理论仍然缺失，需要建立一个统一的机制来解释该体系中FCI的稳定化条件。
AI.method: 1) 提出莫尔电容器效应机制，推导其解析形式；2) 提出母态理论，认为陈绝缘体的稳定性和空穴激发的平带性是掺杂获得FCI的必要条件；3) 采用多带精确对角化计算，验证在莫尔电容器效应存在时ν=2/3处FCI的出现，并对比无莫尔势情况下的带混合坍缩行为。
AI.result: 莫尔电容器效应显著增强莫尔势，稳定C=1的母态；多带精确对角化证实了在ν=2/3处存在FCI，且该FCI态由带间涨落稳定，而无莫尔势时带混合会导致FCI坍缩。
AI.conclusion: 提供了针对菱方石墨烯-hBN体系中同位对齐样品FCI态的第一个自洽理论，同时解释了未对齐样品中FCI缺失的原因，确立了莫尔电容器效应作为该体系中莫尔势增强与FCI稳定的关键机制。

title: TCAD Cryogenic Model Parameters Calibration based on 65 nm NMOS Experimental Data
summary: In this paper, 65 nm n-type Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor Field-Effect-Transistors (nMOSFETs) are taped out and measured at 292 K to 4.5 K. Technology Computer-Aided-Design (TCAD) model parameters are then calibrated to fit the simulation curves to experimental electrical curves. Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) is used to unveil the dimensions of the transistors to ensure accurate modeling. The experimental and simulation capacitance-voltage (CV) curves, drain current - gate voltage (IDVG) curves, and drain current - drain voltage (IDVD) curves are fitted well using the calibrated parameters. The major models calibrated are the Lucent model, which is comprised of an extended PhuMob model, Lombardi model for surface mobility, and the Hänsch high field mobility model. A band-tail model with adjusted band width is applied to fit the sub-threshold swings at all temperatures. The calibrated parameters are expected to be applicable to other technologies because TCAD models are not technology-specific. It is also found that, except for saturation velocity, no new temperature-dependent model is needed. The calibration process and fitting strategies are detailed and are expected to be applicable to calibrate other transistor types.

AI.tldr: 本文对65 nm n型MOSFET在292 K至4.5 K的低温范围内进行了流片和测量，并通过TCAD仿真校准了模型参数，使其与实验电学特性（CV、IDVG、IDVD）精确匹配。校准的模型包括Lucent迁移率模型（扩展PhuMob模型、Lombardi表面迁移率模型和Hänsch高场迁移率模型）及带尾模型。研究还发现除饱和速度外无需引入新的温度依赖模型，且该校准方法可推广至其他工艺和器件类型。
AI.motivation: 低温（深低温）工作条件下，MOSFET的传输特性与室温下显著不同，但现有TCAD模型在低温范围内对65 nm及以下先进节点的适用性缺乏验证。作者希望通过实验与仿真结合，校准出适用于宽温域（292 K至4.5 K）的TCAD模型参数，并为其他工艺节点和器件类型的低温建模提供通用校准策略。
AI.method: 首先在65 nm工艺上流片并制作nMOSFET器件，在292 K至4.5 K温区内进行电学测量；利用TEM表征器件实际尺寸以确保几何建模准确；随后使用TCAD仿真工具，通过校准模型参数使仿真CV、IDVG、IDVD曲线与实验数据吻合。主要校准的物理模型包括：Lucent模型（由扩展PhuMob模型、Lombardi表面迁移率模型和Hänsch高场迁移率模型组成）以及带尾模型（调整带宽以拟合各温度下的亚阈值摆幅）。
AI.result: 在292 K至4.5 K全温区内，使用校准后的TCAD模型参数，仿真CV、IDVG和IDVD曲线与实验曲线拟合良好。校准过程中发现，除饱和速度外，其他模型均无需额外引入新的温度依赖关系。此外，由于TCAD模型本身不具有工艺特定性，校准后的参数具有跨工艺节点移植的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了通过系统化的校准流程，现有TCAD物理模型可以很好地描述65 nm nMOSFET在4.5 K至292 K宽温域内的电学特性。所提出的校准流程和拟合策略具有通用性，可推广至其他晶体管类型和工艺技术，为低温集成电路（如量子计算控制电路）的器件建模提供了可靠基础。

title: Embedding Stabilizer Codes and Leakage Correction in Multilevel Quantum Systems
summary: Leakage beyond the computational subspace is a major source of error in multilevel quantum hardware. We show that any \( [[n,k,d]] \) stabilizer code can be embedded isometrically into a single \(D\)-dimensional system while preserving its complete error-correcting structure. We further derive a necessary and sufficient condition for exact leakage correction, proving that leakage is correctable precisely when it does not distinguish between logical states. These results establish a unified framework for quantum error correction in multilevel quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 本文证明任意[[n,k,d]]稳定子码可以等距嵌入到单个D维系统中并保持完整的纠错结构，同时推导出精确泄漏纠正的充要条件，建立多能级量子系统中量子纠错的统一框架。
AI.motivation: 在多能级量子硬件中，泄漏到计算子空间之外的错误是主要误差来源，需要理解如何在多能级系统中进行量子纠错。
AI.method: 通过等距嵌入方法将任意稳定子码嵌入单一D维系统，并推导泄漏可纠正的充要条件。
AI.result: 证明了任意[[n,k,d]]稳定子码可等距嵌入单一D维系统，并得出泄漏可纠正当且仅当泄漏不区分逻辑态。
AI.conclusion: 建立了多能级量子系统中量子纠错的统一理论框架，为多能级量子硬件的容错计算提供理论基础。

title: Black-Box Knowledge Transfer across Distinct Feature Sets
summary: Pre-trained black-box predictive functions encode knowledge distilled from massive datasets and extensive computation. However, when the available input features differ from those the black box expects, direct use is infeasible. We introduce a method for transferring predictive knowledge from the black box to a new, heterogeneous input space. Our approach decomposes the target regression function into a transferable component, which the black box can inform, and a non-transferable component, which captures information unique to the new space. We propose a two-step neural network procedure, estimating the transferable component from abundant unlabeled feature pairs that bridge the two input spaces and the non-transferable component from limited labels. We derive prediction risk bounds that improve on those of a non-transfer alternative when the non-transferable component is small or smooth, and the procedure adapts to either case. Under additional conditions, the worst-case risk of our estimator is of strictly smaller polynomial order than the minimax risk of estimation from the labeled data alone. We extend the framework to multiple black boxes, each on its own input space, and show that aggregation can reduce prediction error relative to the best single black box. Simulated and real data demonstrate the practical value of the method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将预训练黑盒预测函数的知识迁移到异构输入空间的方法。该方法将目标回归函数分解为可迁移部分（由黑盒提供信息）和不可迁移部分（仅依赖新空间信息），并通过两步神经网络过程估计这两部分，理论分析与实验均表明该方法优于非迁移基线。
AI.motivation: 预训练黑盒预测函数蕴含大量数据和计算带来的知识，但当可用的输入特征与黑盒期望的特征不一致时，无法直接使用这些黑盒。因此需要一种方法，能够将黑盒中的预测知识迁移到异构输入空间中，即使输入空间不同也能利用黑盒的预测能力。
AI.method: 作者将目标回归函数分解为可迁移组件（由黑盒作为信息源）和不可迁移组件（捕捉新空间独有的信息）。提出两步神经网络方法：第一步利用大量无标签的特征对（跨越两个输入空间的桥梁）估计可迁移组件；第二步利用有限标签数据估计不可迁移组件。框架可扩展至多个黑盒（各自在不同输入空间），通过聚合降低预测误差。
AI.result: 推得了预测风险界，当不可迁移组件较小或平滑时，优于非迁移备选方案，且方法能自适应于两种情况。在额外条件下，估计量的最坏情况风险在多项式阶上严格小于仅利用标签数据的最小极大风险。模拟与真实数据实验验证了方法的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为跨异构输入空间的黑盒知识迁移提供了一种理论基础扎实且实践有效的框架，并证明了多黑盒聚合可进一步降低预测误差。

title: Magnetism in antiperovskite (Li$_2$\textit{M})\textit{Ch}O (\textit{M} = Fe, Mn, Co; \textit{Ch} = S, Se) diluted magnets with fixed 1/3 filling: the key role of magnetic anisotropy
summary: We report the magnetic properties of a series of lithium-rich antiperovskites (Li$_2M$)$Ch$O ($M$ = Fe, Co, Mn and $Ch$ = Se, S) where transition metal and lithium ions are randomly distributed on the X-sites of the X$_3$BA structure, thereby forming a strongly diluted magnetic sublattice. Our study hence enables us to investigate the evolution of magnetic order at fixed 1/3-filling -- which is in the vicinity but slightly above the percolation threshold -- upon variation of the spin size, the magnetic anisotropy, and the orbital configuration. The data imply the absence of a distinct Curie-Weiss behavior up to 350~K but show rather large and weakly temperature-dependent magnetic susceptibility. We observe clear signatures of long-range antiferromagnetic order evolving in the 1/3-filled and strongly diluted magnetic X-site lattice with increasing Néel temperatures from $T_{\rm{N}}\simeq 30$~K in (Li$_2$Mn)$Ch$O to $\simeq 50$~K in (Li$_2$Fe)$Ch$O and $70-90$~K in (Li$_2$Co)$Ch$O. Except for $M$ = Co, the chalcogenide has no sizable effect on $T_{\rm N}$. We conclude significant magnetic coupling and short-range magnetic correlations at well above $T_{\rm N}$ which is in line with the observation of a broad electron spin resonance signal at room temperature. The actual ordering temperatures are strongly diminished by magnetic dilution. While structural parameters such as the tolerance factor and bonding angles do not strongly affect $T_{\rm N}$, a key parameter is the magnetic anisotropy of the transition metals.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了锂富集反钙钛矿材料(Li₂M)ChO (M = Fe, Co, Mn; Ch = Se, S)的磁性研究。该材料中过渡金属和锂离子在X位随机分布，形成强稀释磁性亚晶格。研究发现，在1/3填充（接近但略高于渗流阈值）的体系中存在长程反铁磁有序，Néel温度从Mn体系的~30 K升高到Fe体系的~50 K和Co体系的70-90 K。除Co外，硫族元素对T_N影响不大。磁性各向异性是决定T_N的关键参数。
AI.motivation: 研究者旨在探索在固定1/3填充（接近渗流阈值）条件下，具有强稀释磁性亚晶格的体系中磁有序的演化规律，特别是自旋大小、磁各向异性和轨道构型对磁性行为的影响。
AI.method: 制备了一系列(Li₂M)ChO反钙钛矿材料，通过改变过渡金属（M = Fe, Co, Mn）和硫族元素（Ch = Se, S），系统研究了磁性随自旋尺寸、磁各向异性和轨道构型的变化。采用了磁化率测量和电子自旋共振（ESR）等手段。
AI.result: 观察到体系在350 K以上不存在明显的Curie-Weiss行为，而是呈现较大且弱温度依赖的磁化率。存在明确的长程反铁磁有序：T_N从Mn体系的~30 K到Fe体系的~50 K，再到Co体系的70-90 K。除Co外，硫族元素对T_N影响不大。过渡金属的磁各向异性是决定T_N的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 强磁耦合和短程磁关联在远高于T_N的温度下仍存在（与室温下宽ESR信号一致），实际有序温度受磁稀释作用大幅降低。结构参数（如容忍因子和键角）对T_N影响有限，磁各向异性才是控制T_N的核心参数。

title: Thermodynamics of Learning: A Typed Four-Component Accounting of Memory, Fit, and Value
summary: What a finite learning device has recorded and what will hold value for it on future tasks are not the same quantity. We develop a typed accounting for finite-state learning devices that separates four components: a training-side fit functional $Φ_{\mathrm{fit}}$, the record-correlation stock $J_{D}=I(M;D)$, an update-side search ledger $σ_{M}$, and an operational capital value $V(M;T,b)$. This value is the work gap between an informed protocol class and a blind class obtained by deleting the memory-read port and re-optimizing from scratch. (I) Separation: for every $n$, there is a device family on which record correlation and world correlation grow by $n\ln 2$ while the capital gain is exactly zero. In the $\mathrm{flat}^{*}$ regime, data-free updates never increase $V$. (II) Capitalization ledger: an exact $\mathrm{flat}^{*}$ extraction identity and a universal ledger identity give, for (F5$'$)-stable $M$-local updates under a no-discarded-record-correlation condition (f), the bound $η_{\mathrm{cap}}\le 1$ for the capitalization efficiency $η_{\mathrm{cap}}=ΔV/(k T\,σ_{M})$, together with necessary and sufficient conditions for equality. (III) Value retention: for the retention gap $L_{\mathrm{gen}}$ and retention ratio $ρ_{\mathrm{gen}}$ (the former carries no sign constraint; the latter is defined for positive training-side value and is not confined to $[0,1]$) we give a two-layer alignment domain: an exact exchange rate between value and the side-information-adjusted record fit $I(M';D\mid Y)$ without any record-side-information independence assumption, and a raw record-stock exchange rate under a joint side-information neutrality condition $(M,D)\perp Y$, whose boundary is marked by an explicit one-time-pad witness. These are statements about finite-device value retention under task-distribution shift, not a theory of statistical generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文为有限状态学习设备建立了类型化会计框架，将"设备已记录的内容"与"对未来任务有价值的内容"分离为四个独立分量：训练侧拟合泛函、记录相关库存、更新侧搜索账本和运营资本价值。文章在三块内容中证明了分离定理、资本化账本恒等式与价值保留对齐域，揭示了记录相关性与世界相关性均可增长但资本增益为零的现象。
AI.motivation: 传统学习理论将"记录"与"价值"混为一谈，但有限学习设备已经记录的信息量与其未来任务中的效用并非同一量。作者希望建立更精确的会计核算体系，区分设备在训练侧、记录侧、更新侧与运营侧的不同角色，从而解释为何记录相关性与世界相关性增长时资本价值可能不变，并为设备价值评估提供严格框架。
AI.method: 作者提出了一个四元分解：(1) 训练侧拟合泛函 Φ_fit；(2) 记录相关库存 J_D = I(M;D)；(3) 更新侧搜索账本 σ_M；(4) 运营资本价值 V(M;T;b)，定义为知情协议类与删除记忆读取端口后重新优化的盲协议类之间的工作间隙。在 flat* 机制下建立精确提取恒等式和普适账本恒等式，在 (F5') 稳定 M-局部更新与无丢弃记录相关条件 (f) 下推导资本化效率上界 η_cap ≤ 1，并通过两层对齐域刻画价值保留的性质，包括精确汇率和基于联合侧信息中性条件的原始记录库存汇率，标出一次性密码本证明确认边界。
AI.result: (I) 分离定理：对每个 n 都存在设备族使得记录相关性与世界相关性增长 n ln 2 但资本增益恰为零；在 flat* 机制下数据无关更新不增加 V。(II) 资本化账本：在特定稳定性与条件 (f) 下，资本化效率 η_cap ≤ 1，并给出了等号成立的充要条件。(III) 价值保留：给出两层对齐域；第一层在无记录侧信息独立假设下建立 V 与侧信息调整后记录拟合 I(M';D|Y) 之间的精确汇率，第二层在联合侧信息中性条件 (M,D)⫫Y 下建立原始记录库存汇率，其边界由显式一次性密码本实例标记。
AI.conclusion: 本文刻画了有限状态学习设备中"记录"与"价值"的严格分离，展示了资本化效率上界及等号条件，并在任务分布漂移下提供了价值保留的两层精确对齐域。作者明确强调这些都是关于有限设备价值保留的形式化陈述，而非统计泛化理论。

title: Boundary phases and thermodynamics of the Kondo spin-$s$ chain: from overscreened Kondo to boundary-bound states
summary: We study a spin-$\frac12$ impurity coupled to the boundary of a strongly correlated spin-$s$ Takhtajan--Babujian chain, an integrable model whose low-energy physics is described by a perturbed $SU(2)_{2s}$ Wess--Zumino--Witten conformal field theory. While boundary conformal field theory determines the low-energy universality class of the weak-coupling regime, exact Bethe Ansatz methods reveal a sequence of boundary quantum phase transitions in which impurity-bound states emerge and reorganize the Hilbert space into multiple excitation towers built on distinct boundary configurations. This tower restructuring provides the organizing principle for a rich boundary phase diagram extending beyond the conventional Kondo regime. Weak antiferromagnetic coupling realizes the overscreened $2s$-channel Kondo universality class, whereas stronger couplings generate localized boundary modes and qualitatively new screening mechanisms. To describe the resulting thermodynamics, we develop a generalized thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz framework that captures the multi-tower structure across all regimes. The impurity entropy reproduces the boundary conformal field theory prediction in the overscreened Kondo regime but develops pronounced nonmonotonic temperature dependence once boundary-bound states appear, in quantitative agreement with large-scale finite-temperature matrix-product-operator simulations. Complementary dynamical calculations reveal sharp threshold features in the impurity spectral function that directly track the underlying tower structure. Together, boundary conformal field theory, exact Bethe Ansatz, generalized thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz, and tensor-network simulations provide a unified description of impurity screening, boundary-bound-state formation, and excitation-tower reconstruction in a correlated spin-$s$ chain.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自旋-1/2杂质耦合到自旋-s Takhtajan–Babujian链边界的强关联可积模型，结合边界共形场论、精确Bethe Ansatz、广义热力学Bethe Ansatz与张量网络模拟，统一描述了杂质屏蔽、边界束缚态形成和多激发塔重构的边界量子相变机制。研究发现弱反铁磁耦合实现过屏蔽2s-通道Kondo普适类，强耦合则产生局域边界模式及新的屏蔽机制，并揭示杂质熵的非单调温度依赖与谱函数的阈值特征。
AI.motivation: 传统Kondo框架无法充分描述强关联自旋链边界杂质在高耦合强度下出现的丰富物理现象，尤其是边界束缚态的形成和Hilbert空间的多塔重构机制。作者旨在突破常规Kondo范式的局限，建立统一的描述框架来理解强耦合区域中杂质屏蔽的新机制。
AI.method: 采用多方法互补的研究策略：(1) 边界共形场论（BCFT）确定弱耦合区域的低能普适类；(2) 精确Bethe Ansatz揭示边界量子相变序列及多激发塔结构；(3) 发展广义热力学Bethe Ansatz（gTBA）框架以捕捉跨所有区域的多塔贡献；(4) 大规模有限温度矩阵乘积算子（MPO）模拟进行交叉验证；(5) 动力学计算（杂质谱函数）补充阈值特征分析。
AI.result: 弱反铁磁耦合再现2s-通道过屏蔽Kondo普适类，杂质熵与BCFT预言定量吻合。强耦合下边界束缚态出现后，杂质熵呈现显著的非单调温度依赖，与MPO模拟定量一致。杂质谱函数出现反映塔结构的尖锐阈值特征，广义TBA框架成功刻画全参数区域的完整热力学。
AI.conclusion: 边界共形场论、精确Bethe Ansatz、广义热力学Bethe Ansatz和张量网络模拟共同构成了对相关自旋-s链杂质问题的统一描述，揭示了超越传统Kondo区域的丰富边界相图，为理解强关联体系中杂质屏蔽、边界束缚态形成与激发塔重构提供了完整的理论框架。

title: A discrete duality finite volume method with harmonic average for semiconductor drift-diffusion equations
summary: The stationary drift-diffusion model is widely used to model charge transport in semiconductor devices. Classical methods, such as the finite volume Scharfetter--Gummel (FVSG) method, perform well on high-quality Delaunay meshes but struggle on irregular or distorted meshes due to their reliance on Voronoi diagrams. To overcome this mesh limitation, this article introduces a new approach that integrates harmonic average stabilization into the discrete duality finite volume method (DDFV-HA). To validate our scheme, we compare DDFV-HA and FVSG for semiconductor simulations on both high- and low-quality meshes. Experiments show that DDFV-HA matches FVSG on high-quality meshes and is more reliable and accurate on low-quality meshes. Applying DDFV-HA to a real-world thyristor further confirms that it is well-suited for semiconductor simulations in complex, irregular domains where high-quality meshes are not easy to generate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将调和平均稳定化技术集成到离散对偶有限体积法（DDFV-HA）中，用于求解半导体器件中的稳态漂移-扩散模型。相比经典的有界体积Scharfetter-Gummel（FVSG）方法，DDFV-HA在低质量或不规则网格上表现更可靠和准确，同时在高品质网格上与FVSG相当。通过在真实晶闸管上的应用验证了该方法在复杂不规则域的适用性。
AI.motivation: 经典FVSG方法依赖于Voronoi图和Delaunay网格，在高品质Delaunay网格上表现良好，但在不规则或畸变网格上效果不佳。这限制了其在复杂、不规则半导体器件仿真中的应用，因为此类域中难以生成高品质网格。
AI.method: 将调和平均稳定化（harmonic average stabilization）技术融入离散对偶有限体积法（discrete duality finite volume method，DDFV），提出DDFV-HA新格式。通过在高、低品质网格上进行DDFV-HA与FVSG的对比实验，并在真实晶闸管器件上应用验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，DDFV-HA在高品质网格上能匹配FVSG的精度；在低品质网格上比FVSG更可靠、更准确。在真实晶闸管上的应用进一步确认了该方法在复杂、不规则域中半导体仿真的适用性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DDFV-HA是一种克服网格质量限制、适用于复杂不规则几何域的半导体漂移-扩散仿真数值方案，在高品质网格下可与经典FVSG相当，在低品质网格下更具优势，适合作为复杂器件仿真的可靠选择。

title: Spatially Dense, Continuous-Variable Quantum Computing with Solid State Spin Nonlinearities
summary: Nanomechanical structures have been investigated as a method of achieving long-lived quantum excitations at radio frequencies. Their high quality factors are especially intriguing as a medium for bosonic encoding of quantum information. However, to leading order, mechanical modes typically lack the nonlinearities necessary to achieve interaction between bosonic channels and thus are limited in their ability to scale to the many-qubit regime necessary for practical quantum computing. In this work, we propose and describe an approach for bosonic quantum information processing that uses strain-sensitive solid-state spins as nonlinear elements to produce the relevant nonclassical mechanical states. We outline the architecture required to achieve nearest-neighbor connectivity between mechanical cat-state qubits on-chip, as well as the control and readout architecture required for universal quantum computation. In addition, we show that this architecture can allow for a high spatial density of logical qubits by leveraging both the efficiency of bosonic error correction schemes and the small sizes of the constituent nanomechanical resonators and spin qubits. Finally, we identify the necessary performance metrics that will enable error-correction thresholds at high qubit densities, illuminating a path towards scalable quantum information processing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于纳米机械谐振器与应变敏感固态自旋的玻色子量子信息处理架构，利用自旋作为非线性元件实现机械猫态量子位，并论证该架构可实现片上的最近邻连接、通用量子计算、高空间密度逻辑量子位以及可扩展的量子信息处理路径。
AI.motivation: 纳米机械结构具有高品质因数，可用于射频波段的长期量子激发和玻色子编码，但机械模式本身缺乏非线性，无法实现玻色子信道间的相互作用，难以扩展到多量子位规模。因此需要引入额外机制来产生非线性相互作用，以实现玻色子量子计算的可扩展性。
AI.method: 该工作采用应变敏感固态自旋作为非线性元件，通过与纳米机械谐振器的耦合产生非经典机械态（猫态）。论文描述了实现机械猫态量子位片上最近邻连接所需的架构、实现通用量子计算所需的控制与读取架构，并利用玻色子纠错方案的高效性和纳米谐振器与自旋量子位的小尺寸实现高空间密度逻辑量子位。
AI.result: 研究表明该架构可以实现纳米机械猫态量子位的片上最近邻连通性及通用量子计算的完整控制和读取方案，并能实现高空间密度逻辑量子位。同时，论文识别了实现高量子位密度下纠错阈值所需的性能指标。
AI.conclusion: 作者论证了该架构为可扩展量子信息处理提供了可行路径，明确了达到错误纠正阈值所需的关键性能指标，为后续的实验实现和工程优化指明了方向。

title: SSPO: Structure-Aware Similarity-Weighted Preference Optimization for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) relies on parallel solution sampling for training, yet existing methods fail to fully exploit the rich information latent in a co-sampled solution group. Preference-optimization methods anchor on the single best solution and discard fine-grained quality and structural signal from all other peers-a failure we term gradient signal polarization. Mean-based baselines instead weight peers uniformly, so structurally near-identical peers flood the baseline with redundant information and keep gradient variance high-a failure we term baseline redundancy. We propose SSPO (Structure-Aware Similarity-Weighted Preference Optimization), which scores all $B$ sampled solutions jointly through a dissimilarity-weighted leave-one-out baseline: structurally distinct peers receive higher weight, resolving both failures in a single mechanism. The baseline uses zero-parameter, problem-adaptive solution embeddings built from the encoder's existing node representations. Experiments on TSP, EFL, and JSP benchmarks show consistent gains over prior best-anchor and uniform-weight baselines. A direct comparison against uniform RLOO on TSP and EFL confirms that structure-aware weighting is the primary driver of improvement. The SSPO-trained EFL policy has been deployed in a production facility-location system at JD$\mathord{.}$com, confirming practical viability at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SSPO（结构感知相似度加权偏好优化）方法，通过不相似度加权的留一基线联合打分所有 B 个采样解，同时解决神经组合优化训练中梯度信号极化和基线冗余两个问题。在 TSP、EFL、JSP 基准上一致优于现有最佳锚点与均匀权重基线，且已部署于京东生产级设施选址系统。
AI.motivation: NCO 训练依赖并行解采样，但现有方法未能充分利用共采样解组中的丰富信息。偏好优化锚定单一最优解并丢弃其他解的细粒度质量与结构信号（梯度信号极化）；均值基线又对同伴均匀加权，导致结构近似的解涌入基线产生冗余并使梯度方差偏高（基线冗余）。
AI.method: 提出 SSPO，对所有 B 个采样解联合打分，采用不相似度加权留一基线：结构上不同的解获得更高权重，通过单一机制同时解决上述两个失败。基线利用从编码器现有节点表征构建的零参数、问题自适应的解嵌入。
AI.result: 在 TSP、EFL、JSP 基准上一致优于既有最佳锚点与均匀权重基线；在 TSP 与 EFL 上直接对比均匀 RLOO，证实结构感知加权是改进的主要驱动力。SSPO 训练的 EFL 策略已部署于京东物流生产级设施选址系统，证实了规模化实际可行性。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知的相似度加权基线能够有效利用共采样解组的结构信息，克服梯度极化和基线冗余两大缺陷，显著提升 NCO 训练性能，并具备实际部署价值。

title: Neural Quadratic Forms: A Unified Minimal Model for Sudden Learning and Scaling Laws
summary: Neural networks trained by gradient descent on a smooth cost function can nevertheless learn in steps: the cost holds on long plateaus and then drops abruptly. Meanwhile, training losses instead follow smooth power laws. Variants of both behaviors occur in architectures with very different microscopic structures, which is the signature of a few relevant collective variables. We show that a symmetry fixes what those variables are: a network layer is a sum over interchangeable units, so relabeling the units leaves it unchanged; given smoothness and the condition that a unit's gradient vanish at the origin, symmetry then enforces a universal leading form for the expansion about the near-zero weights present at the start of training, the quadratic $\Tr[WW^{\top}A(x)]$, in which every architectural detail is confined to a single ``structure matrix" $A(x)$ that we compute for each architecture. Perceptrons, attention layers, mixtures of experts, and convolutions become one model at different $A$. Its training dynamics then close on the ``order parameter" $M=WW^{\top}$ and, whenever the data matrices share an eigenbasis, reduce to a Lotka--Volterra equation whose modes switch on one after another. The smaller the initial weights, the further apart the switch-on times, and the plateaus appear as a singular limit of a smooth flow; when many modes are unresolved the same events merge into a power law in training time whose exponent the theory predicts. We confirm both numerically across training methods and architectures.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了神经网络训练中“阶梯式”损失曲线与“幂律式”损失曲线统一于同一理论框架：层的置换对称性迫使近零权重的展开具有普适二次形式 Tr[WW^T A(x)]，所有架构差异都浓缩在唯一的“结构矩阵”A(x)中。训练动力学在序参量 M=WW^T 上封闭，并在数据矩阵共享特征基时约化为 Lotka–Volterra 方程，模式依次开启。初始权重越小，开启时间间隔越大，平台区表现为光滑流的奇异极限；当众多模式未分辨时，同一事件合并为训练时间的幂律，其指数可由理论预测。
AI.motivation: 梯度下降训练的网络尽管代价函数光滑，却常呈现“平台-突降”的阶梯式学习行为；与此同时训练损失又遵循光滑的幂律。这两种看似矛盾的行为在不同微观结构的架构中均出现，暗示存在少数相关集体变量。作者希望找出决定这些变量的机制，并统一解释阶梯式与幂律式学习现象。
AI.method: 作者利用神经层对可互换单元置换的不变性这一对称性，结合光滑性以及单元梯度在原点的消失条件，推导出近零权重展开的普适前导形式 Tr[WW^T A(x)]。这将感知机、注意力层、专家混合和卷积等不同架构统一为一个模型，仅通过“结构矩阵”A(x) 区分。训练动力学在 M=WW^T 上封闭；当数据矩阵共享特征基时，约化为 Lotka–Volterra 方程，模式依次被激活。理论预测平台区是光滑流的奇异极限，而未分辨模式合并时表现为训练时间幂律，指数可由理论算出。
AI.result: 作者从理论上证明了该普适形框架的正确性，并首次在数值上跨训练方法与多种架构（感知机、注意力、专家混合、卷积）验证了两种看似不同的行为——阶梯式平台与幂律下降——均能被统一理论所刻画。还定量预测了幂律的指数。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络训练的阶梯性和幂律性并非源于不同的机制，而是同一对称性约束下的普适动力学在不同分辨尺度上的表现。置换对称性决定了重要的集体变量（序参量 M），从而为理解深度学习的涌现式阶段学习提供了统一的理论基础。

title: Local and quasilocal conservation laws of three-state IRF cellular automata and their quantum deformations
comment: 41 pages, 4 figures; Research in this work has been assisted by generative AI
summary: Using patch-matrix-product methods, we study two reversible three-state interaction-round-a-face cellular automata introduced by Klobas and Prosen [J. Phys. A 55, 094003 (2022)] - the species-preserving and species-flipping rules - and a coherent quantum deformation interpolating between them. Within an explicit translationally invariant ansatz, the two classical rules share a one-parameter family of quasi-local conservation laws with an auxiliary-dimension-three realization. Every regular member is also the first centered logarithmic derivative of an analytic auxiliary-dimension-two family passing through the identity observable. On the closed span of this family and the three elementary local charges, the only nonzero Euler velocities are $\pm\sqrt{3/23}$. Consequently, $\sqrt{3/23}$ is a rigorous lower bound on the maximal Euler speed in any larger conserved sector. For the species-flipping rule, this value agrees with the reported extrapolated value $0.361$ of Klobas and Prosen, strongly supporting completeness of the known sound-active charges. The species-preserving rule admits, in addition, a staggered generating family whose logarithmic derivatives form an infinite tower of strictly local charges. In the quantum deformation, the same algebraic structures yield exact low-bond-dimension invariant states (scar candidates), exponentially long-lived quasi-local quasimodes, and diagonal quasi-local charges that produce a nonzero Mazur bound after projection away from the three elementary local charges.

AI.tldr: 本文利用patch-matrix-product方法，研究了Klobas和Prosen引入的两种可逆三态相互作用绕面元胞自动机（物种保持与物种翻转规则）及其量子相干变形。两类经典规则共享一参数族拟局域守恒律，其最大欧拉速度为√(3/23)，为物种翻转规则提供了严格的传播速度下界，与文献报告的外推值0.361一致。物种保持规则还存在交错生成族产生无限塔严格局域荷。量子变形中揭示了低键维不变态（疤痕候选）、指数长寿命拟局域拟模以及非零Mazur界。
AI.motivation: 旨在严格刻画可逆三态相互作用绕面元胞自动机的守恒律结构、最大欧拉速度（GHD框架中的传播速度）以及量子变形下的动力学性质，验证并支持Klobas-Prosen关于sound-active荷完整性的猜想。
AI.method: 采用patch-matrix-product（补丁矩阵积）方法，在平移不变精确ansatz下构造辅助维数为三的拟局域守恒律族；通过解析辅助维数为二的生成族提取中心对数导数；在量子变形中利用相同代数结构构造不变态、拟模和Mazur界。
AI.result: 两类经典规则共享一参数族拟局域守恒律，非零欧拉速度唯一为±√(3/23)，由此给出严格的最大欧拉速度下界。物种翻转规则的√(3/23)≈0.3612与外推值0.361一致。物种保持规则额外有交错生成族产生严格局域荷塔。量子变形中构造了疤痕候选态、指数长寿命拟模和非零Mazur界。
AI.conclusion: 结果强有力地支持了物种翻转规则中已知sound-active荷的完整性，同时为物种保持规则提供了新的严格局域守恒荷结构；量子变形的代数框架为构造精确动力学不变量和长寿命拟模提供了统一途径。

title: Fermionic Anomalies of Finite Symmetries on Lattices
summary: We develop a lattice characterization of fermionic 't Hooft anomalies of finite internal symmetries in (1+1)D and (2+1)D, formulated in terms of obstructions to symmetric short-range-entangled (SRE) states. We consider lattice systems formed by tensor product of onsite fermionic and bosonic Hilbert spaces, and finite internal symmetry given by a central extension $\mathbb Z_2^F\to G_f\to G_b$. We extract a hierarchy of fermionic anomaly indices for a given symmetry operator. In (1+1)D, an exact lattice symmetry is characterized by a pair of cohomological data $(n_2,ν_3)$. For $G_f=G_b\times\mathbb Z_2^F$, we show that a symmetry with trivial anomaly indices $(n_2,ν_3)$ is onsiteable and hence admits a symmetric SRE state, establishing that these indices faithfully detect the lattice anomaly. Comparing with continuum QFT, we find that exact lattice symmetries do not realize the additional $H^1(BG_b,\mathbb Z_2)$ anomaly layer in continuum QFT. In particular, for $G_b=\mathbb Z_2$, exact lattice symmetries realize only the even $\mathbb Z_4$ subgroup of the continuum $\mathbb Z_8$ classification. In (2+1)D, we identify three successive anomaly layers of cohomological data $(n_2,n_3,ν_4)$. We show that a nontrivial value of any layer obstructs symmetric SRE. For $G_f=G_b\times\mathbb Z_2^F$, it also forbids a symmetric invertible state. When the bosonic group $G_b$ is non-trivially extended by fermion parity, the lattice obstruction to SRE states does not generally coincide with the continuum 't Hooft anomaly. We explicitly construct a $\mathbb Z_4^F$ lattice symmetry in (2+1)D with nontrivial lattice anomaly index that forbids symmetric SRE states, even though its continuum anomaly is trivial. Our results highlight a mismatch between lattice and continuum anomalies and motivate a systematic study of which continuum anomalies admit exact microscopic lattice realizations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了(1+1)D和(2+1)D有限内部对称性下费米子't Hooft反常的格点表征，通过对称短程纠缠(SRE)态的障碍来刻画。作者建立了费米子反常指标的层次结构，并揭示了格点对称性与连续QFT反常之间的不匹配：格点精确对称性无法实现连续QFT中的某些反常层。
AI.motivation: 理解费米子系统的对称性反常通常通过连续QFT框架进行，但量子场论中的反常分类并不总能由微观格点模型精确实现。本文旨在建立格点意义上的费米子't Hooft反常表征，澄清"哪些连续反常可以拥有精确的微观格点实现"这一基本问题。
AI.method: 作者采用格点系统框架，考虑由局域费米子和玻色子希尔伯特空间张量积构成的系统，对称性为中心扩张Z2^F→Gf→Gb的有限内部对称性。他们提取了对称算符的费米子反常指标层次，在(1+1)D由上同调数据(n2,ν3)刻画，在(2+1)D由三层上同调数据(n2,n3,ν4)刻画，并系统分析各层的SRE障碍性质。
AI.result: (1+1)D：证明了平凡反常指标的对称性可以onsite化并允许对称SRE态，指标忠实检测格点反常；格点对称不实现连续QFT中额外的H^1(BGb,Z2)反常层，且Gb=Z2时仅实现连续Z8分类中的偶Z4子群。(2+1)D：三个反常层(n2,n3,ν4)中任一层非平凡都阻碍SRE；对Gf=Gb×Z2^F还禁止对称可逆态；当Gb被费米子奇偶性非平凡扩张时，格点SRE障碍与连续反常不一致，并构造了Z4^F格点对称性作为反例。
AI.conclusion: 格点反常与连续反常存在系统性差异：格点精确对称性只能实现连续反常分类的一部分，且当玻色子群被费米子奇偶性非平凡扩张时，两者甚至不一致。这凸显了需要系统研究哪些连续反常允许精确微观格点实现，并为格点反常理论提供了严格框架。

title: Using Diffusion Models to Estimate Uncertainties in Analytic Continuation
summary: Inverse problems are ubiquitous in physics, chemistry, and engineering, arising when reconstructing hidden quantities from indirect measurements. A key example is the analytic continuation of imaginary-time correlation functions (iTCFs) to the real-frequency domain. This process requires an inverse Laplace transform, which is inherently ill-posed and highly sensitive to small input variations. Recent neural network (NN)-based methods have shown promising results by learning mappings from imaginary-time to real-frequency spectra, often outperforming traditional techniques such as maximum entropy. However, because the problem is ill-posed, many spectra fit the same iTCF. Regression-based approaches output a single solution, which approximates an average over the true solution space, and therefore fail to capture the full distribution of plausible power spectra. To address this issue, we introduce a diffusion-based framework for analytic continuation that learns the distribution of spectra consistent with a given iTCF. It offers two key advantages. First, it quantifies uncertainty directly from the learned distribution. Second, by analyzing the spread and structure of this distribution, we can quantitatively assess the intrinsic hardness of each inversion problem. We measure this hardness with a new metric, the uncertainty pseudo-volume. Applying the framework to an iTCF from a path-integral molecular dynamics simulation of liquid parahydrogen, we obtain the self-diffusion coefficient with an error bar and flag a secondary high-frequency peak as a possible spurious artifact. In contrast to previous attempts at uncertainty quantification, our generative approach rests on a concrete probabilistic basis, providing a more theoretically grounded measure of confidence in the reconstructed power spectra.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于扩散模型的生成式框架用于解析延拓问题，通过学习与给定虚时关联函数一致的光谱分布，实现了不确定性量化，并通过新的"不确定性伪体积"指标评估每个反演问题的内在难度。应用于液态仲氢的路径积分分子动力学模拟数据，成功给出了自扩散系数的误差棒并识别出可能的虚假高频峰。
AI.motivation: 解析延拓（虚时关联函数到实频域的逆拉普拉斯变换）是典型的病态反问题，大量谱函数对应同一iTCF。现有基于回归的神经网络方法仅输出单一解（近似于真实解空间的平均），无法捕捉合理功率谱的完整分布，缺乏基于严格概率论的置信度量。
AI.method: 引入扩散模型的生成式框架，学习与给定iTCF一致的光谱分布；通过分析该分布的展宽和结构来量化每个反演问题的内在硬度，提出新的度量指标——不确定性伪体积（uncertainty pseudo-volume）；应用框架于液态仲氢的路径积分分子动力学模拟所得iTCF。
AI.result: 在液态仲氢的iTCF应用中，成功获得带误差棒的自扩散系数，并标记了一个可能的次级高频伪影峰；相比之下，以往的不确定性量化尝试缺乏严格概率基础，而该生成式方法具有具体概率依据，为重建功率谱提供了更理论基础的置信度量。
AI.conclusion: 该扩散生成式框架不仅能够从病态反问题中提取完整的光谱解分布以实现严谨的不确定性量化，还能用不确定性伪体积客观评估每个反演问题的固有难度，比传统和现有NN方法提供更可靠、更理论自洽的置信度度量。

title: Quantum Tanner Codes at Moderate Blocklength
summary: We present explicit constructions of quantum Tanner (QT) codes with good rate and distance, obtained through two complementary approaches: the left-right Cayley complex (LRCC) description and the "lifting" perspective, in which a seed Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) code is lifted by commuting left-right regular actions of a finite group $\mathcal{G}$. Through an extensive search over non-abelian groups from GAP's SmallGrp library, we investigate the moderate-blocklength regime ($n \in [500,1000]$) and identify several new code instances with distance upper bounds exceeding $20$. These include $[[480,8,(\leq 21,\leq 21)]]$, $[[504,4,(\leq 36,\leq 27)]]$, $[[672,4,(\leq 48,\leq 28)]]$, $[[720,6,(\leq 30,\leq 30)]]$, and $[[864,8,(\leq 39,\leq 31)]]$, with these bounds obtained using up to $350$ million trials of sQetch, a randomized distance estimator. The code instances presented have check weights ranging from $9$ to $20$. Using the Tesseract decoder, we estimate pseudo-thresholds of $3.6\%$-$4.6\%$ under phenomenological noise and $0.14\%$-$0.27\%$ under circuit-level noise, comparable to prior results at shorter code lengths. We also provide QuantumExpanders.jl, an open-source Julia library for constructing QT codes and explicit constructions of Ramanujan graphs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两种互补方法（左-右Cayley复形描述和"提升"视角）显式构造了具有良好码率和距离的量子Tanner（QT）码，并在中等码长区间（n∈[500,1000]）通过对GAP SmallGrp库中非阿贝尔群的广泛搜索，发现了多个距离上界超过20的新码实例，同时提供了Tesseract译码器下的噪声阈值估计和开源的Julia库QuantumExpanders.jl。
AI.motivation: 量子Tanner码作为有前途的量子LDPC码候选，需要在高码率和好距离之间取得平衡。已有构造在中等码长区间的具体码实例有限，且缺乏系统性的群搜索来发现最优参数。本文旨在通过大规模群搜索和两种互补构造视角，填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用两种互补方法构造QT码：(1) 左-右Cayley复形（LRCC）描述；(2) "提升"视角，即通过有限群G的交换左-右正则作用提升一个种子CSS码。利用GAP SmallGrp库对非阿贝尔群进行广泛搜索，使用sQetch随机距离估计器（最多3.5亿次试验）估计距离上界，并用Tesseract译码器评估噪声阈值。
AI.conclusion: 系统性群搜索证实了中等码长QT码可实现超过20的距离上界，且性能与更短码长相当。提供的开源Julia库QuantumExpanders.jl可用于构建QT码和显式Ramanujan图，为后续研究者提供实用工具。

title: Online Inference for Quantile Temporal Difference Learning in Distributional Reinforcement Learning
summary: In this paper, we study how to perform statistical inference for quantile temporal difference learning (QTD) in distributional reinforcement learning. Assuming access to a generative model, we first establish functional central limit theorems for both synchronous and asynchronous QTD, which show that the averaged iterates of QTD converge weakly to a rescaled Brownian motion. We next provide online inference methods. Based on random scaling, the inference procedure constructs an asymptotically pivotal statistic for inference by using the information along the whole QTD path. Meanwhile, the proposed statistic can be computed online without storing the entire trajectory of QTD iterates. This substantially reduces the memory requirement and enables efficient statistical inference in distributional reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了分布强化学习中分位数时序差分学习（QTD）的统计推断问题。在生成模型假设下，建立了同步与异步QTD的函数中心极限定理，并提出了基于随机缩放的在线推断方法，在无需存储完整轨迹的情况下构造渐近枢轴统计量，大幅降低内存需求。
AI.motivation: 分布强化学习中QTD算法的统计推断问题尚未得到充分研究，现有的推断方法通常需要存储完整的迭代轨迹，内存开销大，限制了其在实际应用中的效率。
AI.method: 首先在生成模型假设下，为同步和异步QTD建立函数中心极限定理（FCLT），证明QTD的平均迭代弱收敛于重缩放布朗运动；随后基于随机缩放（random scaling）方法构造渐近枢轴统计量进行在线推断，该统计量利用整个QTD路径的信息，但可在线计算而无需存储完整轨迹。
AI.result: 建立了同步与异步QTD的函数中心极限定理，证明其平均迭代弱收敛于重缩放布朗运动；提出的随机缩放推断方法构造的统计量具有渐近枢轴性质，且实现了在线计算，显著降低了内存需求。
AI.conclusion: 本文为QTD算法提供了理论基础上的统计推断框架，通过随机缩放方法实现了高效、低内存的在线推断，为分布强化学习中的不确定性量化提供了实用工具。

title: In-situ Adjoint Wave Control in Reconfigurable Non-Hermitian Nonlinear Systems
summary: Complex multipath environments are usually avoided in wave-based information processing because repeated scattering creates many interfering propagation paths, obscuring controllability and generating extreme sensitivity to perturbations. The addition of nonlinear mechanisms fundamentally alters the wave-control landscape by breaking the superposition principle that underpins most wave-management strategies. Here, we show that these two apparent impediments -- multipath complexity and nonlinearity -- can instead be harnessed as key resources for physical optimization. We demonstrate an in-situ adjoint optimization protocol in a wave-chaotic platform incorporating a single localized nonlinear defect, in which the system itself performs both the forward and the adjoint propagations required for gradient evaluation. Recurrent multipath returns repeatedly expose the wave to the defect, producing from a minimal hardware a rich nonlinear input-output map with many pathway-mediated degrees of freedom. At the same time, a suitable adjoint excitation enables direct extraction of the sensitivities from measurements alone, without a digital twin or conventional numerical backpropagation. We experimentally validate the protocol on a minimal nonlinear multipath platform composed of incommensurate coaxial cables connected via T-junctions, one of which hosts a diode-loaded cavity. Our approach opens a route to adaptive wireless communications, imaging and analog intelligence in complex, partially unknown environments where conventional modeling is impractical.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实验验证了一种在非线性多径波动系统中利用系统自身进行前向与伴随传播的位点伴随优化协议，将多径复杂性与非线性从障碍转化为物理优化的资源，在由同轴电缆与二极管腔构成的最小非线性平台上实现了无需数字孪生或数值反向传播的梯度提取。
AI.motivation: 传统波动信息处理通常回避复杂多径环境（因重复散射产生干扰路径、极端敏感性）以及非线性机制（破坏叠加原理），两者被视为波控障碍。作者试图证明二者并非天然缺陷，而可被转化为物理优化的关键资源，从而在复杂、部分未知环境中实现无需传统建模的自适应控制。
AI.method: 采用在位伴随优化（in-situ adjoint optimization）协议：在波浪混沌平台中引入单一局域非线性缺陷（二极管加载腔），系统自身同时执行梯度评估所需的前向与伴随传播；利用多径反复返回使波多次暴露于缺陷，从最小硬件生成丰富的非线性输入-输出映射与路径介导自由度；通过适当的伴随激励直接从测量中提取灵敏度，不依赖数字孪生或数值反向传播。实验平台由非可公度同轴电缆经T型接头互连构建。
AI.result: 在由非可公度同轴电缆与T型接头（其一接二极管腔）构成的最小非线性多径平台上实验验证了该协议，成功实现了直接基于测量的灵敏度提取与梯度评估，证明了多径与非线性作为优化资源的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作开辟了在复杂且部分未知环境中实现自适应无线通信、成像与模拟智能的新途径，尤其是在传统建模不切实际的场景下，多径复杂性与非线性可被协同利用以实现物理层面的原位优化。

title: Equivariant learning of a transferable three-dimensional classical density functional
summary: Liquids exhibit collective behavior that depends sensitively on thermodynamic conditions, interfaces and confinement, yet predicting each new state commonly requires a separate atomistic simulation. Classical density functional theory offers a reusable variational description, but its central excess free-energy functional is generally unknown, and learned approximations have largely remained restricted to planar or lower-dimensional settings. Here we show that this functional can be learned directly from fully three-dimensional equilibrium density fields while preserving spatial symmetry and variational consistency, without free-energy or chemical-potential labels. A single learned functional transfers across temperatures, system sizes and statistical ensembles, and recovers structure factors, the equation of state, liquid--vapor coexistence and interfacial broadening, none of which are used as training targets. Applied to complex three-dimensional geometries, it predicts the non-monotonic force associated with formation and rupture of a solvent-depleted bridge between colloids and adsorption in an interconnected gyroid pore. These results demonstrate that equilibrium density data can be converted into a transferable thermodynamic generator connecting microscopic liquid structure to response, phase behavior and collective phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了可以从三维平衡密度场直接学习经典密度泛函理论（cDFT）中的超额自由能泛函，无需自由能或化学势标签，同时保持空间对称性和变分一致性。单个学习到的泛函可跨温度、体系尺寸和统计系综迁移，能恢复结构因子、状态方程、液-汽共存和界面展宽等未作为训练目标的性质，并成功预测复杂三维几何中的溶剂桥力和孔内吸附行为。
AI.motivation: 液体的集体行为对热力学条件、界面和限域敏感，但预测每一种新状态通常需要单独进行原子模拟，计算成本高昂。经典密度泛函理论提供可复用的变分描述，但其核心的超额自由能泛函形式通常是未知的，而现有的学习近似大多局限于平面或低维设置，缺乏处理真实三维复杂几何的能力。
AI.method: 直接从全三维平衡密度场中学习超额自由能泛函，在训练过程中保持空间对称性和变分一致性，无需任何自由能或化学势标签。该方法利用平衡密度数据本身作为监督信息，通过变分原理约束来构造可迁移的热力学泛函。
AI.result: 单个学习到的泛函可跨温度、体系尺寸和统计系综迁移，能够恢复结构因子、状态方程、液-汽共存曲线和界面展宽等未作为训练目标的性质。在复杂三维几何中，成功预测了胶体间溶剂耗尽桥形成与破裂过程中的非单调力，以及互连螺旋二十四面体（gyroid）孔内的吸附行为。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明平衡密度数据可被转化为一个可迁移的热力学生成器，将微观液体结构与响应、相行为及集体现象联系起来，为密度泛函理论的学习提供了三维、无标签条件下的可行路径，有望替代大量重复的原子模拟。

title: Revisiting magnon bound states: ferro-antiferromagnetic $J_1\!-\!J_2$ square-lattice model
comment: 37 pages, 17 figures. Supplementary Material (SM) available under "Ancillary files"
summary: A comprehensive analysis of pairing and bound states of magnons in the Heisenberg $S\!=\!1/2$ square-lattice $J_1\!-\!J_2$ ferro-antiferromagnetic model is presented. We highlight the similarities and differences between the bound states of spin flips on a lattice and those of particles in the continuum. Magnon bound states at finite pair momentum are studied throughout the Brillouin zone and a convenient lattice partial-wave nomenclature is advocated. The mechanisms of enhanced stability or fragility of these bound states for the high-symmetry pair momenta are identified and quantified as relating to the effective dimensional reduction or enhancement, respectively. These effects are also shown to control the evolution of the bound states with the model parameters, providing a transparent framework for understanding magnon pairing in a more general setting. A method to determine the bound state phase boundaries is presented.

AI.tldr: 本文对海森堡 S=1/2 方格 J1-J2 铁磁-反铁磁模型中磁振子的配对与束缚态进行了系统分析，提出了晶格分波命名法，并揭示了高对称对动量下束缚态稳定性与有效维度降维/增强之间的定量关系。
AI.motivation: 理解磁振子束缚态不仅有助于阐明晶格上自旋翻转束缚态与连续介质中粒子束缚态之间的异同，还能为更一般的磁振子配对现象提供统一的理论框架。
AI.method: 在整个布里渊区内对有限对动量下的磁振子束缚态进行研究，引入晶格分波命名法，并通过有效维度降维或增强的机制来定量识别和描述高对称对动量下束缚态稳定性增强或脆弱性增加的机制，同时提出确定束缚态相边界的方法。
AI.result: 识别并量化了高对称对动量下束缚态稳定性增强或减弱的具体机制，证明这些机制与有效维度降维或增强直接相关，并揭示了束缚态随模型参数演化的规律。
AI.conclusion: 提供了理解磁振子配对问题的透明框架，并给出了一套确定束缚态相边界的实用方法，为更一般背景下磁振子束缚态的研究奠定了基础。

title: Modeling Bond-Dependent Kitaev-like interaction in 2D Edge-Sharing Tetrahedral Magnets: FeX (X=Te, Se)
summary: Bond-dependent magnetic interactions, exemplified by the Kitaev model, are known to arise from the interplay between spin-orbit coupling(SOC) and specific coordination geometries, yet their existence has so far been predominantly associated with edge-sharing octahedral systems. Whether analogous interactions survive in edge- sharing tetrahedral environments - relevant to iron-based superconductor parent compounds - remains an open question. Here, we construct a Kitaev-like model for monolayer FeTe and FeSe and demonstrate the presence of a previously unrecognized bond-dependent Ising-type interaction, induced jointly by chalcogen-mediated SOC and the tetrahedral crystal-field geometry. By mapping the first-principles calculations derived magnetic anisotropy energy mapping across representative linear magnetic orders, we disentangle the bond-dependent contributions from single-ion anisotropy. We reveal that the Kitaev-like interaction dominates the magnetic anisotropy in FeTe, whereas in FeSe, it fiercely competes with a single-ion anisotropy of opposite sign. The resulting noncollinear local anisotropy axes generate intrinsic single-site spin frustration, providing a microscopic mechanism for magnetic disorder beyond isotropic exchange models. Our results establish edge-sharing tetrahedral magnets as a new setting for bond-dependent interactions and extend the scope of Kitaev physics beyond octahedral coordination.

AI.tldr: 该论文在单层FeTe和FeSe中构建了Kitaev类模型，揭示了由硫族介导的自旋轨道耦合和四面体晶体场几何共同诱导的键依赖Ising型相互作用，将Kitaev物理从八面体配位拓展到共享边四面体环境。
AI.motivation: 以往键依赖磁性相互作用（如Kitaev模型）主要被认为存在于共享边八面体系统中，而共享边四面体环境（与铁基超导体母体化合物相关）中是否存在类似相互作用是一个悬而未决的问题。
AI.method: 构建单层FeTe和FeSe的Kitaev类模型，通过第一性原理计算推导磁各向异性能映射，在代表性线性磁序上分离键依赖贡献与单离子各向异性，从而解析出键依赖的Ising型相互作用。
AI.result: 发现在FeTe中Kitaev类相互作用主导磁各向异性，而在FeSe中它与符号相反的单离子各向异性激烈竞争。由此产生的非共线局域各向异性轴引发本征单自旋阻挫，为超越各向同性交换模型的磁无序提供了微观机制。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了共享边四面体磁体作为键依赖相互作用的新场景，将Kitaev物理的适用范围从八面体配位拓展到更广泛的晶体环境。

title: Flux control of measurement back-action and Leggett-Garg correlations in chiral quantum walks
summary: Gauge-invariant fluxes control interference in chiral continuous-time quantum walks. We investigate how they affect sequential measurements at a single vertex, using a dichotomic observable that distinguishes return to that vertex from occupation of its complement. For a walker initially localized at the measured vertex, the complete two-time statistics, including measurement back-action and Leggett--Garg correlators, are determined exactly by the return amplitude, connecting temporal correlations to the local spectral measure and gauge-invariant closed-walk interference. At short times, the leading disturbance is independent of the Peierls phases, whereas flux sensitivity enters at higher orders through interference among closed walks. We further identify a graph-independent sufficient mechanism for saturating the Lüders bound: flux can reduce the rooted dynamics to a balanced two-dimensional Krylov subspace with equal spectral weights, yielding a constructive flux-engineering criterion for attaining the Lüders bound of $3/2$ at finite times. The mechanism is realized exactly on a two-flux diamond graph, where destructive interference renders additional rooted modes dark and the local back-action depends on relative combinations of the two independent fluxes. For flux-threaded cycles, an exact winding-number expansion reveals a parity-dependent onset: the leading flux contrast occurs generically at order $t^N$ for even cycles and $t^{2N}$ for odd cycles. Across the cycles examined, flux can either enhance the maximal Leggett--Garg violation or shift strong violations to earlier measurement times, with half flux driving the four-site cycle to the Lüders bound. These results establish gauge-invariant flux as a resource for engineering local measurement back-action and temporal quantum correlations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究手性连续时间量子行走中规范不变的磁通如何影响单顶点顺序测量的干扰效应。作者证明完整的两时间统计量（含测量反作用和Leggett-Garg关联）完全由返回振幅决定，并发现了饱和Lüders界3/2的图无关充分机制——即磁通可将根植动力学约化为具有等谱权重的二维Krylov子空间。该机制在双通量金刚石图上精确实现，并通过环上的精确卷绕数展开揭示了宇称依赖的磁通对比起始阶数。
AI.motivation: 理解手性连续时间量子行走中规范不变的磁通（Peierls相位）如何作为资源来工程化局部测量反作用和时序量子关联是核心动机。作者希望建立时序相关性与局部谱测度及规范不变闭合行走干扰之间的精确联系，并寻找饱和Lüders界的不依赖具体图结构的充分条件。
AI.method: 作者聚焦于单一顶点的顺序测量，使用区分返回该顶点与占据其补集的两分观测值。通过初始局域化在测量顶点的步行者，他们用返回振幅精确确定完整的两时间统计量（含测量反作用和Leggett-Garg关联子）。采用短时间扰动展开、Krylov子空间约化分析，以及对磁通贯穿环路的精确卷绕数展开来揭示宇称依赖的磁通效应。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：（1）短时间主导扰动独立于Peierls相位，磁通敏感性在更高阶通过闭合行走干扰进入；（2）识别出图无关的饱和Lüders界机制：磁通将根植动力学约化为等谱权重的平衡二维Krylov子空间，在有限时间达到3/2界，并在双通量金刚石图上精确实现；（3）磁通环路给出宇称依赖起始阶：偶环为t^N阶、奇环为t^{2N}阶的磁通对比；（4）磁通可增强最大Leggett-Garg违背或将强违背移至更早测量时间，半通量驱动四站点环至Lüders界。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了规范不变的磁通作为工程化局部测量反作用与时序量子关联的可靠资源，提供了磁通工程设计的建设性判据，并为量子行走中的时序关联研究建立了基于返回振幅的统一分析框架。

title: Statistical Properties of Robust Learning under Distributional Shifts
summary: Distributional shifts arise when the target deployment environment differs from the source environment that generated the training data. Robust learning frameworks such as Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) and Robust Satisficing (RS) aim to address this challenge, yet their finite-sample guarantees under such shifts, and their systematic comparison, remain underexplored: existing analyses typically establish guarantees either in the source environment or for adversarial worst-case performance over an ambiguity set. This paper instead studies generalization error in the target environment---the excess loss under the shifted target distribution. Our contributions are threefold. First, we derive finite-sample generalization error bounds in the shifted target environment for both DRO and RS. These bounds explicitly characterize the trade-off between reduced sensitivity to shift and the regularization penalty induced by each method's robustness hyperparameter, and they avoid the curse of dimensionality associated with Wasserstein empirical concentration. Second, when partial shift information such as shift magnitude or direction is available, we propose information-directed hyperparameter calibrations and compare the two methods given the same information. Under these calibrations, and in the partial-information regimes we study, DRO and RS exhibit complementary theoretical and empirical behavior. Finally, we apply the framework to a network lot-sizing problem, using it to interpret how robust policies respond to positive shifts in the demand distribution. Together, these results fill a gap in understanding the statistical properties of robust learning methods under distributional shifts and provide a principled basis for comparing DRO and RS.

AI.tldr: 本文研究分布偏移下DRO（分布鲁棒优化）和RS（鲁棒满足）两种鲁棒学习方法的有限样本泛化误差，推导目标环境下的泛化误差界，提出信息导向的超参数校准方法，并在网络批量问题中验证两者在部分信息下的互补行为。
AI.motivation: 现有鲁棒学习分析（如DRO和RS）的有限样本保证通常局限于源环境或对抗性最坏情况性能，缺乏对目标偏移环境下泛化误差的系统研究，且两种方法在偏移场景下的对比尚属空白。
AI.method: 首先推导DRO和RS在偏移目标环境下的有限样本泛化误差界，显式刻画鲁棒性超参数带来的偏移敏感性降低与正则化惩罚之间的权衡，并避免Wasserstein经验集中带来的维度灾难；其次在部分偏移信息（如偏移幅度或方向）可用时，提出信息导向的超参数校准方法并对比两方法；最后在网络批量问题中进行应用验证。
AI.result: 得到了DRO和RS在目标偏移环境下的有限样本误差界，明确了鲁棒超参数的权衡结构；在部分信息机制下，两者展现出互补的理论与经验行为；网络批量问题中对需求和分布正偏移下鲁棒策略的响应提供了解释。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果弥补了鲁棒学习方法在分布偏移下统计性质理解的空白，并为DRO与RS的系统比较提供了原则性依据。

title: Biorthogonal-only Floquet Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions
summary: Non-Hermitian dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) are intrinsically sensitive to the choice of inner product under nonunitary time evolution. Although the biorthogonal formulation based on associated states provides a normalized Loschmidt echo with a probabilistic interpretation, previous studies have found biorthogonal and self-normal DQPTs to occur in the same parameter regimes, suggesting that the two forms of dynamical criticality are concomitant. Here we demonstrate that this is not the case. In an exactly solvable periodically driven non-Hermitian Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain, we uncover a finite biorthogonal-only Floquet DQPT regime, where the biorthogonal Loschmidt rate becomes nonanalytic while the self-normal Loschmidt rate remains smooth. The critical conditions are obtained analytically, showing that the onset of biorthogonal Floquet DQPTs is locked to the exceptional lines of the effective Floquet Hamiltonian, whereas self-normal criticality has no corresponding spectral boundary. Moreover, for each critical momentum, the biorthogonal DQPT exhibits a pair of critical times within every driving period, whereas the self-normal DQPT exhibits only one. Our results establish a fundamental distinction between biorthogonal and self-normal DQPTs, thereby opening a route toward new nonequilibrium quantum phenomena in non-Hermitian systems.

AI.tldr: 本文在精确可解的周期驱动非厄米SSH链中，发现了一个有限的仅双正交Floquet DQPT区域——双正交Loschmidt速率出现非解析性而自正规Loschmidt速率保持光滑，从而确立了双正交与自正规DQPT之间的根本区别。
AI.motivation: 非厄米动力学量子相变(DQPT)对内积选择固有敏感，但此前研究表明双正交和自正规DQPT发生在相同参数区间，暗示两者并存。本文旨在证明这一认知是错误的，揭示两种形式的动力学临界性并非总是共存的。
AI.method: 采用精确可解的周期驱动非厄米Su-Schrieffer-Heeger(SSH)链作为模型，通过解析推导得到临界条件，分别计算双正交与自正规Loschmidt率，并分析其非解析性及其与有效Floquet哈密顿量奇异线(exceptional lines)之间的关系。
AI.result: 发现了一个有限的双正交Floquet DQPT区域，其中双正交Loschmidt率非解析而自正规Loschmidt率光滑。双正交Floquet DQPT的起始被锁定在有效Floquet哈密顿量的奇异线上，而自正规临界性没有对应的谱边界。此外，每个临界动量下，双正交DQPT在每个驱动周期内出现一对临界时间，而自正规DQPT仅出现一个。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了双正交与自正规DQPT之间的根本区别，打破了以往认为两者始终共存的认知，为非厄米系统中新的非平衡量子现象开辟了道路。

title: Defect-induced optical magnons and local magnetic correlations in MnSb2Te4
summary: Magnetic defect engineering offers a route to manipulate and control magnetic and electronic states in quantum materials. In the Mn(Bi,Sb)2Te4 family of topological magnetic insulators, Sb substitution facilitates site mixing between Mn and Sb atoms that affects magnetic order and band topology. Here we directly probe these defect-induced magnetic interactions using inelastic neutron scattering on single crystals of MnSb2Te4. We find that antisite mixing generates inequivalent and disordered magnetic sublattices where strong defect-induced antiferromagnetic coupling produces an optical magnon with a large gap. Semi-classical spin-dynamics simulations accurately capture magnetic excitations in the ordered and paramagnetic states and identify that linear Mn-Te-Mn bonds mediate coupling to antisite magnetic defects.

AI.tldr: 本文利用非弹性中子散射技术直接探测了MnSb2Te4单晶中由缺陷诱导的磁相互作用，发现反位混合产生了不等价且无序的磁子晶格，强缺陷诱导的反铁磁耦合产生了具有大能隙的光学磁振子。半经典自旋动力学模拟准确捕获了有序态和顺磁态的磁激发，并确认线性Mn-Te-Mn键介导了与反位磁缺陷的耦合。
AI.motivation: 磁缺陷工程为操纵量子材料中的磁性和电子态提供了一种途径。在Mn(Bi,Sb)2Te4拓扑磁性绝缘体家族中，Sb取代促进了Mn和Sb原子之间的位点混合，这种位点混合会影响磁序和能带拓扑。然而，此前缺乏对这些缺陷诱导磁相互作用的直接探测，因此需要直接的实验手段来揭示这些相互作用的本质。
AI.method: 研究采用非弹性中子散射（INS）技术，对MnSb2Te4单晶进行直接探测。同时使用半经典自旋动力学模拟来重现和解释实验观测到的磁激发谱，包括有序态和顺磁态下的激发行为。
AI.result: 研究发现反位混合生成了不等价且无序的磁子晶格，其中强缺陷诱导的反铁磁耦合产生了具有大能隙（gap）的光学磁振子。半经典自旋动力学模拟准确捕获了有序态和顺磁态的磁激发特征，并识别出线性Mn-Te-Mn键是介导与反位磁缺陷耦合的关键结构单元。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过直接的中子散射测量揭示了MnSb2Te4中缺陷诱导磁相互作用的微观机制，阐明了反位缺陷如何通过线性Mn-Te-Mn超交换路径产生强反铁磁耦合和大能隙光学磁振子，为理解该拓扑磁性绝缘体家族的磁性和电子结构提供重要实验依据。

title: Characteristic Mode Analysis of Plasmonic Nanostructures Using Hydrodynamic Volume Integral Equation
summary: Metallic nanostructures confine electromagnetic fields at subwavelength scales, making them attractive as plasmonic nanoantennas. At these scales, the response of metals becomes nonlocal, and the hydrodynamic model is widely used to capture this response. However, existing solvers provide only the response to a prescribed excitation and do not directly reveal the intrinsic resonances of the structure. This work extends the characteristic mode analysis to plasmonic nanostructures to enable excitation-independent modal analysis of their resonant behavior. For simple metals, the coupled hydrodynamic and volume integral equations are reduced to a single hydrodynamic volume integral equation in terms of the induced current. The equation is discretized and cast as a generalized eigenvalue problem within the characteristic mode analysis framework, whose solution yields the characteristic mode currents and modal significance curves of the structure. The proposed framework is validated through three metallic nanostructures: a nanosphere, a nanorod, and a nanodimer. The results show that the method identifies the intrinsic resonances of each structure, including resonances not excited by a given source and additional resonances arising from the nonlocal response, which are absent in local models. The proposed framework provides physical insight into the modal mechanisms of plasmonic nanostructures and serves as a practical tool for their analysis and design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将特征模式分析扩展到等离子体纳米结构的框架，通过将流体动力学模型与体积积分方程结合，将问题转化为广义特征值问题，从而实现与激励无关的模态分析。该方法在一维纳米球、纳米棒和纳米二聚体上验证，能够识别局部模型无法捕捉的非局部响应相关的额外共振。
AI.motivation: 金属纳米结构在亚波长尺度上限制电磁场，可作为等离子体纳米天线。在此尺度下，金属的响应变得非局部，流体动力学模型被广泛用于捕捉该响应。然而，现有求解器只能提供对给定激励的响应，无法直接揭示结构的内在共振特性，因此需要一种与激励无关的模式分析方法。
AI.method: 针对简单金属，将耦合的流体动力学方程与体积积分方程简化为单一的水动力学体积积分方程（以感应电流为未知量）。将该方程离散化并构建为特征模式分析框架下的广义特征值问题，求解得到特征模式电流和模态显著性曲线。
AI.result: 通过纳米球、纳米棒和纳米二聚体三种金属纳米结构进行了验证。结果表明，该方法能识别每种结构的内在共振，包括给定激励未能激发的共振，以及由非局部响应引起的、在局部模型中不存在的额外共振。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为等离子体纳米结构的模态机制提供了物理洞察，并可作为其分析与设计的实用工具。

title: Coherent temporal filtering of multimode parametric down-conversion using a quantum pulse gate
summary: Spectrally pure and indistinguishable single photons are essential for quantum network platforms, where high-visibility interference underpins many quantum information protocols. However, most practical single-photon sources emit spectrally multimode states with reduced purity. Conventional spectral intensity filtering can partially improve purity but cannot select a well-defined temporal mode (TM). Here, we demonstrate coherent temporal filtering of a multimode parametric down-conversion (PDC) source using a quantum pulse gate (QPG) and benchmark its performance against conventional intensity filtering. The generated PDC photons exhibit strong spectral correlations, rendering extraction of pure heralded photons from the pair a challenge. We demonstrate that QPG filtering consistently generates heralded photons with purities above 0.90 regardless of the filter shape. Contrariwise, using spectral intensity filters yields mixed photons. Photon purities are probed with chronocyclic Q-function tomography. Furthermore, we demonstrate the versatility of QPG filtering by extracting structured TMs, including superposition of picosecond time bins. These results establish the QPG as a practical coherent filtering tool for quantum network applications.

AI.tldr: 本文演示了用量子脉冲门（QPG）对多模参量下转换（PDC）单光子源进行相干时间滤波，实现了纯度高于0.90的标记光子，而传统光谱强度滤波只能产生混合态光子。
AI.motivation: 实际单光子源通常发射光谱多模态，导致纯度降低。传统光谱强度滤波虽能部分改善纯度，但无法选择明确定义的时间模式（TM），这限制了量子网络应用中高可见度干涉等量子信息协议的性能。
AI.method: 利用量子脉冲门（QPG）对具有强光谱关联的多模PDC源进行相干时间滤波，并与传统光谱强度滤波进行基准对比；采用chronocyclic Q函数层析技术测量光子纯度，并进一步演示了包括皮秒时间仓叠加态在内的结构化TM提取。
AI.result: QPG滤波无论滤波形状如何均能一致地产生纯度高于0.90的标记光子，而光谱强度滤波产生混合光子；QPG还能提取结构化时间模式，包括皮秒时间仓的叠加态。
AI.conclusion: QPG被确立为一种实用且普适的相干滤波工具，适用于量子网络应用。

title: High-dimensional networks and mean squared error for possibly misspecified models
summary: To avoid missing important variables and their connections in networks, more and more variables are included in network analysis. Here we show that in a setting with many more parameters than observations (high-dimensional) it is possible to get a conservative (i.e., low false positive rate) estimate of the neighbourhood for each node (which connections are in the network). A neighbourhood is often estimated with a linear model, and this leads to two interesting cases: (i) If the true model is linear, then neighbourhood selection work reasonably well, and (ii) if the true model is nonlinear, then neighbourhood selection requires a penalty for the high dimensions. Here we show the impact of the ridge parameter on the mean squared error, and how this leads to low test variance and hence to neighbourhoods with large numbers of edges. We connect these insights with results from machine learning, where the so-called double descent (when more parameters are included than observations, the mean squared error goes down a second time) has put the traditional view on model selection upside down. Essentially, for adequate neighbourhood selection in models with a large number of parameters, the volume of the model space needs to be included in the penalty. Most neighbourhood selection methods (e.g., Lasso, AIC, BIC) lead to spurious edges (high false positive rate), but we prove that in the high-dimensional setting, minimum description length leads to correct neighbourhood selection or smaller (low false positive rates) in both cases when either the model is correctly or incorrectly assumed linear

AI.tldr: 在高维网络分析中，当参数数量远超观测值时，最小描述长度（MDL）方法能够提供保守（低假阳性率）的邻域估计，而Lasso、AIC、BIC等传统方法则会产生虚假边（高假阳性率）。
AI.motivation: 随着越来越多变量被纳入网络分析，高维场景下（参数远多于观测）如何避免遗漏重要变量及其连接，同时保持低假阳性率成为关键挑战。
AI.method: 从线性模型估计邻域出发，对比线性与非线性两种真实模型场景，讨论岭参数对均方误差的影响，并结合机器学习中的双下降现象，提出在高维设置下需将模型空间体积纳入惩罚项，采用最小描述长度（MDL）进行邻域选择。
AI.result: 证明在高维场景下，无论真实模型是线性还是非线性（线性假设），MDL方法都能实现正确的邻域选择或产生更小的假阳性率，而传统方法（Lasso、AIC、BIC）会导出大量虚假边。
AI.conclusion: 高维网络邻域选择应将模型空间体积纳入惩罚，MDL是兼顾正确性与保守性的有效方法，其洞察与机器学习的双下降现象相呼应。

title: Stochastic Nonlinear Waves in all the Right Phases
summary: I present an overview of different phases used in the literature to describe the phase of travelling waves in reaction-diffusion equations. The discussion is tailored to understand the effectiveness of these different phase descriptions in a stochastic setting in 1D. The explicit computation of the autonomous isochronal phase for the Nagumo equation is a new result.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了反应-扩散方程中行波相位的不同定义方式，并在一维随机设定下评估这些相位描述的适用性，其中首次显式计算了Nagumo方程的自守等时相位。
AI.motivation: 在反应-扩散方程中，行波的"相位"有不同的数学描述方式（如等时相位、等变相位等），但在随机环境（噪声扰动）下，这些不同相位定义的适用性和有效性尚未被系统地比较和评估。理解不同相位描述在随机设定下的表现，对于研究噪声对行波传播的影响具有重要意义。
AI.method: 本文采用综述与分析相结合的方法：（1）系统梳理文献中用于描述反应-扩散方程行波相位的各种定义和框架；（2）在一维随机设定下分析这些相位描述的有效性；（3）针对Nagumo方程，给出了自守等时相位（autonomous isochronal phase）的显式解析表达式，这是一个新的数学结果。
AI.result: 提供了一维随机设定下不同行波相位描述方法的系统比较，并给出了Nagumo方程的自守等时相位的显式计算，这是此前文献中尚未见到的结果。
AI.conclusion: 不同的相位定义在随机环境下具有不同的适用性，需要根据具体问题选择合适的相位描述；同时，Nagumo方程等时相位的显式公式为后续随机分析提供了新的工具。

title: Dipolar-driven mean-field criticality in the ferrimagnet Eu$_2$MnSi$_2$O$_7$
summary: We report mean-field critical behavior in Eu$_2$MnSi$_2$O$_7$, a melilite-type ferrimagnet with spin-only Eu$^{2+}$ and Mn$^{2+}$ moments and negligible orbital contributions. Magnetization measurements combined with neutron powder diffraction reveal critical exponents close to the mean-field values, indicating that long-range dipolar interactions govern the asymptotic critical behavior in this insulating ferrimagnet. The refined magnetic structure, described by the magnetic space group $P2_12_1^\prime2^\prime$, exhibits a tilted ferrimagnetic configuration driven by the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction, reflecting the noncentrosymmetric nature of the lattice. These results extend the applicability of mean-field theory to complex insulating magnets and establish Eu$_2$MnSi$_2$O$_7$ as a platform for exploring ferrimagnetism and long-range interactions. To our knowledge, this is the first insulating ferrimagnet in which dipolar interactions drive mean-field criticality.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了Eu₂MnSi₂O₇这一褐帘石型铁氧磁体中的平均场临界行为。通过磁化测量和中子粉末衍射实验，发现其临界指数接近平均场值，表明长程偶极相互作用主导了该绝缘铁氧磁体的渐近临界行为。磁性结构由磁空间群P2₁2₁′2′描述，呈现由Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用驱动的倾斜铁氧磁构型。这是首个由偶极相互作用驱动平均场临界性的绝缘铁氧磁体。
AI.motivation: 探索平均场理论在复杂绝缘磁体中的适用性，并寻找新的铁氧磁体平台以研究长程相互作用驱动的临界行为。
AI.method: 结合磁化测量与中子粉末衍射技术，提取临界指数并精修磁性结构，确定磁空间群与磁构型。
AI.result: 获得的临界指数接近平均场值，证明长程偶极相互作用主导临界行为；磁性结构为P2₁2₁′2′空间群下的倾斜铁氧磁构型，由DMI相互作用驱动。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将平均场理论的适用范围扩展至复杂绝缘磁体，并确立Eu₂MnSi₂O₇作为探索铁氧磁性与长程相互作用的平台，这是首个偶极相互作用驱动平均场临界性的绝缘铁氧磁体。

title: Mechanisms of Nanoscroll Formation and Particle Encapsulation in Janus MXenes
comment: This is a preprint submitted to a journal for publication
summary: Morphology transfer of 2D Janus MXenes into nanoscrolls unlocks unusual properties. Although a scalable synthesis route has been experimentally verified, the atomistic mechanism underlying nanoscroll formation remains poorly understood. We use large-scale reactive molecular dynamics simulations, validated against density functional theory (DFT) and experimental structural and elastic properties, to investigate stability and quantify the driving forces and geometry governing nanoscroll formation in three Janus MXenes, (Tx)Ti2C(Ty), where (Tx) and (Ty) denote the bottom and top surface terminations among bare (-b), -O, and -OH. Both square and infinitely wide flakes with lengths ranging from 10 to over 120 nm are simulated. We find that 1-7% lattice-induced strain generates a bending moment in these structures. The sheet scrolls, curves, or forms a nanotube depending on the resulting curvature and initial sheet size. For MXenes with an initial length of 120 nm, multiwalled nanoscrolls form with interlayer distances of around 0.7 nm and inner diameters of about 7 nm for (O)Ti2C(OH) and (b)Ti2C(OH), whereas (b)Ti2C(O) instead produces a much larger interlayer distance of around 1.7 nm and an inner diameter exceeding 20 nm. We show that spontaneous scrolling of a Janus MXene in the presence of an anchored nanoparticle produces a core@shell composite, in which the particle locally deforms the nanoscroll and widens the interlayer channels. This locally tunable, enlarged interlayer spacing offers a promising design route for MXene-based energy-storage electrodes. However, our simulations reveal H2 gas release during encapsulation, which promotes nanobubble formation that can reduce battery life.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大规模反应性分子动力学模拟（经DFT和实验验证），研究了三种Janus MXenes在纳米卷（nanoscroll）形成过程中的原子级机制，发现1-7%的晶格诱导应变产生弯曲力矩，决定卷曲、弯曲或纳米管形成。MXene在锚定纳米颗粒存在下可自发卷曲形成核壳复合材料，从而获得局部可调、增大的层间距，为MXene基储能电极提供设计路线，但模拟揭示封装过程中释放H2气体会形成纳米气泡，可能缩短电池寿命。
AI.motivation: 虽然2D Janus MXenes向纳米卷的形态转移已通过实验验证了可扩展合成路线，但纳米卷形成的原子级机制仍不清楚。理解该机制对于调控MXene纳米卷的结构和性能、进而开发高性能储能材料至关重要。
AI.method: 使用大规模反应性分子动力学（reactive MD）模拟，以密度泛函理论（DFT）和实验的结构及弹性数据为验证基准；模拟了三种Janus MXenes (Tx)Ti2C(Ty)（Tx/Ty分别为-b、-O、-OH），包括方形和无限宽薄片，长度从10nm到超过120nm，并模拟了锚定纳米颗粒下MXene的自发卷曲封装过程。
AI.result: 发现1-7%的晶格诱导应变产生弯曲力矩，导致片材卷曲、弯曲或形成纳米管，取决于曲率和初始片材尺寸。120nm长的MXene可形成多壁纳米卷：(O)Ti2C(OH)和(b)Ti2C(OH)层间距约0.7nm、内径约7nm，而(b)Ti2C(O)层间距约1.7nm、内径超过20nm。锚定纳米颗粒可诱导自发卷曲形成核心@壳复合材料，颗粒局部变形纳米卷并扩大层间通道；但模拟显示封装过程中释放H2气体，促进纳米气泡形成，可能降低电池寿命。
AI.conclusion: 自发卷曲的Janus MXene包裹锚定纳米颗粒可形成核壳复合材料，实现局部可调且增大的层间距，为MXene基储能电极提供了有前景的设计路线。但H2释放导致的纳米气泡问题需在器件设计中加以考虑，以保障电池寿命。

title: Pulse Engineering of Quantum Many-Body Dynamics: Emergent Scar States, Entanglement, and Nonstabilizerness
summary: Understanding and coherently controlling the properties of interacting quantum many-body systems is a central challenge in non-equilibrium quantum physics. While in the past decades, a wide range of many-body Hamiltonians have been introduced to study quantum chaos, atypical eigenstates, and quantum resources, systematically engineering and continuously tuning these properties within a single microscopic model remains largely unexplored. Here, we employ a pulse engineering scheme to construct an effective Hamiltonian that continuously interpolates between a chaotic Heisenberg (XXX) chain with a local impurity and the ZX Hamiltonian. Along this interpolation, we identify several families of analytically tractable atypical eigenstates embedded in the excited-state spectrum with distinct entanglement and nonstabilizerness properties. In the XXX limit, these states exhibit exact plateaus in both entanglement and stabilizer Rényi entropy and correspond to coherent superpositions of long-range valence-bond solid (VBS) states. As the pulse strength increases, the effective Hamiltonians exhibit a hierarchy of new set of approximate entanglement plateaus in the low-energy spectrum. Interestingly, in the fully pulse-engineered ZX limit, we uncover a distinct pair of long-range entangled stabilizer eigenstates, corresponding to rainbow scar states. We further show that pulse engineering preserves the distinct chaotic and non-chaotic regimes of the original model, while that is largely absent in the dynamical generation of entanglement and nonstabilizerness. The pulse-engineered models generate nearly identical quantum resources in both regimes, revealing a partial decoupling between quantum chaos and quantum-resource generation. Our results establish pulse engineering as a versatile framework for generating many-body Hamiltonians with structured eigenstates and tunable quantum resources.

AI.tldr: 本文通过脉冲工程技术构建一个有效哈密顿量，使其在混沌的带杂质海森堡XXX链与ZX哈密顿量之间连续插值，发现多个具有不同纠缠和非稳定化性质的解析可解非典型本征态，并揭示量子混沌与量子资源生成之间的部分解耦。
AI.motivation: 非平衡量子物理中，理解并可控地调控相互作用量子多体系统的性质是核心挑战。虽然已有大量多体哈密顿量用于研究量子混沌、非典型本征态和量子资源，但在单一微观模型中系统地工程化并连续调谐这些性质仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 采用脉冲工程方案构造有效哈密顿量，在混沌的Heisenberg (XXX)链加局域杂质与ZX哈密顿量之间实现连续插值。沿插值路径识别多族解析可解的非典型本征态，分析其纠缠与非稳定化性质，并考察脉冲工程对混沌与非混沌区域的保持及量子资源生成的影响。
AI.result: 在XXX极限发现纠缠和稳定子Rényi熵的精确平台，对应长程价键固体(VBS)态的相干叠加；随脉冲强度增加出现低能谱中的近似纠缠平台层级；在完全脉冲工程化的ZX极限发现一对长程纠缠的稳定子本征态（彩虹疤痕态）。脉冲工程保持原模型的混沌与非混沌区域，但两种区域中动态生成的纠缠和非稳定化资源几乎相同，揭示量子混沌与量子资源生成的解耦。
AI.conclusion: 脉冲工程是生成具有结构化本征态和可调谐量子资源的多体哈密顿量的通用框架，为研究量子混沌与量子资源之间的深层关系提供了新平台。

title: Sinkhorn Linearization and the Spectral Proxy: Unifying the Statistical and Algorithmic Theory of Feature-Parameterized Inverse Optimal Transport via a Single Spectral Sandwich
summary:
We develop the statistical and algorithmic theory of inverse optimal transport (IOT) under the feature-parameterized cost C_theta(i,j) = -theta^T phi(i,j). The core technical contribution is the Sinkhorn linearization -- the implicit-function sensitivity of the entropic OT plan to the cost -- together with its spectral proxy, a formula that is spectrally exact yet geometrically transparent.
  The restricted Hessian on the tangent space satisfies the spectral sandwich (pi_min/epsilon) I <= H_T^{-1} <= (pi_max/epsilon) I, yielding the single core bound sigma_min >= (pi_min/(a_max epsilon)) sqrt(lambda_min(Sigma)) that drives the entire theory. On this core we establish four theorems and one observation.
  T1 (identifiability): theta is globally injective on the quotient of the gauge kernel, with dimension bound F <= (K-1)^2. T2 (sparsistency): the l1-penalized estimator recovers the true support under irrepresentability and score concentration, with exponential failure probability. T3 (well-posedness): the feature-moment map M(theta) = Phi^T x_theta is strongly monotone, and the inverse is Lipschitz with constant L <= epsilon ||Phi^T S_a||_op / (pi_min lambda_min(Sigma)). T4 (convergence): local strong convexity with mu >= pi_min^2 lambda_min(Sigma) / epsilon^2 guarantees monotone gradient descent convergence. O5 (misspecification): the estimator converges to the OT-model projection of the truth; the Holder continuity of the projection map is assessed numerically, yielding setting-dependent empirical exponents alpha_eff in (0,1).

AI.tldr: 本文建立了特征参数化代价下逆最优运输(IOT)的统计与算法理论，核心贡献是Sinkhorn线性化（隐函数灵敏度分析）及其谱代理公式，并基于受限Hessian的谱夹心界推导出四个定理和一个观测（可辨识性、稀疏恢复、良置性、收敛性和误设定分析）。
AI.motivation: 逆最优运输问题是给定观测到的运输计划反推代价函数，在经济学、心理学和机器学习中广泛应用。然而，特征参数化代价下的IOT缺乏系统的统计与算法理论，特别是如何从熵正则化OT计划的灵敏度出发建立可辨识性、估计一致性和收敛性保证，是亟待解决的开放问题。
AI.method: 作者提出Sinkhorn线性化——对熵OT计划关于代价参数的隐函数灵敏度分析，并构造一个谱精确但几何透明的谱代理公式。在切空间上推导受限Hessian满足谱夹心不等式(pi_min/epsilon)I <= H_T^{-1} <= (pi_max/epsilon)I，由此得到核心界sigma_min >= (pi_min/(a_max epsilon)) * sqrt(lambda_min(Sigma))，并在此基础上一一证明四个定理和一个观测。
AI.result: T1：theta在gauge核的商空间上全局单射，维度界为F <= (K-1)^2；T2：l1惩罚估计器在不可表示性和得分集中条件下以指数失败概率恢复正确支撑；T3：特征矩映射M(theta)强单调，逆映射Lipschitz常数为L <= epsilon ||Phi^T S_a||_op / (pi_min lambda_min(Sigma))；T4：局部强凸性保证梯度下降单调收敛，mu >= pi_min^2 lambda_min(Sigma)/epsilon^2；O5：估计器收敛到OT模型对真实值的投影，投影映射的Holder连续性经验指数alpha_eff在(0,1)内。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为特征参数化的逆最优运输问题提供了统一的理论框架，通过Sinkhorn线性化和谱夹心界将可辨识性、稀疏性、良置性、收敛性与误设定分析整合为一个完整的统计与算法理论体系，为后续IOT方法在实际数据中的应用奠定了坚实基础。

title: Diffusion and Solvation Dynamics of Ions in Water: Beyond the Brownian Approximation
comment: 27 pages total, including 4 pages of Supplementary Information; 7 figures (6 main, 1 supplementary) and 7 tables (including 5 supplementary)
summary: The coupled dynamics of ions and water molecules in their first hydration shell impact a variety of processes including ion diffusion, selective ion transport in water-filled nanopores, and the kinetics of ion-pairing, ion adsorption, and metal-ligand binding reactions. In this work, we study these coupled dynamics for alkali metals (Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs), alkaline Earth metals (Mg, Ca, Sr, Ba), and chloride through the lens of their dependence on ion isotopic mass. Results are validated against previous measurements of the isotopic mass-dependence of ion diffusion coefficients in water and previous ab initio calculations of ion high-frequency dynamics in water.
