We find that the vibrational power spectra of ions in water consistently exhibit either two or three peaks, i.e., ions have several rattling frequencies within their solvations shells as previously reported for a subset of the species examined here. These frequencies have different sensititivies to isotopic mass that may serve as signatures of ion solvation processes (such as the tendency of ions to orient their first-shell water molecules) and that also may relate to Hofmeister-like effects including the relative affinity of different metals for ribonucleic acid (RNA).

AI.tldr: 本文研究了碱金属（Li、Na、K、Rb、Cs）、碱土金属（Mg、Ca、Sr、Ba）及氯离子在水合壳层中的离子-水分子耦合动力学，通过分析其对离子同位素质量的依赖性展开研究，发现这些离子在水中的振动功率谱呈现两个或三个峰（即多个rattling频率），且不同频率对同位素质量的灵敏度不同，可作为离子溶剂化过程的特征标志，并可能与Hofmeister效应（包括不同金属对RNA的相对亲和力）相关。
AI.motivation: 离子与其第一水合壳层中水分子之间的耦合动力学影响多种关键过程，包括离子扩散、纳米孔中的选择性离子传输、离子配对、离子吸附以及金属-配体结合反应的动力学。研究这些耦合动力学有助于深入理解离子溶剂化机制及相关生物和化学过程。
AI.method: 通过分析离子振动功率谱对同位素质量（isotopic mass）的依赖性来研究离子-水耦合动力学。研究对象涵盖五种碱金属（Li、Na、K、Rb、Cs）、四种碱土金属（Mg、Ca、Sr、Ba）和氯离子。结果与已有的离子在水中的扩散系数同位素质量依赖性测量以及从头算（ab initio）计算的离子高频动力学进行了验证对比。
AI.result: 研究发现离子在水中的振动功率谱一致地呈现两个或三个峰，即离子在其溶剂化壳层内具有多个rattling频率（此前的子集物种已有报道）。这些频率对同位素质量的灵敏度各不相同，可能作为离子溶剂化过程（如离子定向第一壳层水分子的倾向）的特征标志。这些发现还可能涉及Hofmeister样效应，包括不同金属对核糖核酸（RNA）的相对亲和力。
AI.conclusion: 离子在溶剂化壳层内的多个rattling频率及其对同位素质量的不同敏感性，可以作为离子溶剂化过程的具有物理意义的特征标志，并可能与Hofmeister效应等"特异性离子效应"相关联，为理解离子在生物和化学体系中的行为提供新的视角。

title: Correlation versus Causation in Quantum Criticality
comment: main text: 5 pages, 3 figures; end matter: 2 pages
summary: Correlation functions $\langle O_1(x) O_2(0) \rangle$ reveal scaling dimensions through spatial decay. We instead consider static susceptibility, the change in $\langle O_1(x) \rangle$ from perturbing the Hamiltonian by $O_2(0)$, which we term causation for short. In a conformal field theory (CFT), dimensional analysis predicts decay of $|x|^{-2Δ}$ for correlation and $|x|^{-2Δ+1}$ for causation. Yet we find causation can decay up to fifteen additional orders in $x$ through a general mechanism, which we trace to time-derivative fields being unable to contribute to static response. In higher-dimensional CFTs, this mechanism ensures leading causation arises from primaries, even when descendants dominate correlation, which we leverage with DMRG to identify a previously unresolved corner primary of $Δ\approx 8.8$ and a heavy magnetic line defect primary of $Δ\approx 4.6$ in the $(2+1)$D critical Ising model. Moreover, the same mechanism governs edge-mode localization in $(1+1)$D gapless symmetry-protected topological phases, explaining previously observed anomalously small edge-mode splittings and guiding our construction of spin chains with splittings as small as $1/L^{18}$ and $1/L^{25}$.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"causation"（静态磁化率）作为研究CFT中算符的新工具。与关联函数按|x|^{−2Δ}衰减不同，causation按|x|^{−2Δ+1}衰减，但研究发现其可额外衰减至多15个数量级。机制在于时间导数场无法贡献静态响应。该机制用于识别(2+1)D临界Ising模型中的新角主场（Δ≈8.8）和重磁线缺陷主场（Δ≈4.6），并解释了(1+1)D无间隙SPT相中边缘模式分裂异常小的现象，构造出分裂尺度小至1/L^18和1/L^25的自旋链。
AI.motivation: 传统关联函数通过空间衰减揭示标度维数，但作者提出研究静态磁化率（causation）作为替代/补充工具。关键动机在于发现causation可展现远超维度分析预期的额外衰减（最多15个数量级），这一现象源于时间导数场无法贡献静态响应的普遍机制，并具有广泛的理论与应用价值。
AI.method: 从CFT维度分析出发建立causation的衰减标度| x |^{−2Δ+1}，揭示时间导数场在静态响应中消失的机制，即确保主导项来自主场（primaries）而非descendants。利用这一原理结合DMRG数值方法识别(2+1)D临界Ising模型的角主场和磁线缺陷主场；同时将该机制映射到(1+1)D无间隙SPT相的边缘模式局域化，指导自旋链构造以极小化边缘模式分裂。
AI.result: 发现causation可产生额外15个数量级的衰减；鉴定出(2+1)D临界Ising模型中此前未分辨的角主场（Δ≈8.8）和重磁线缺陷主场（Δ≈4.6）；解释了边缘模式分裂异常小的观测现象，并构造出分裂小至1/L^18和1/L^25的自旋链。
AI.conclusion: causation是揭示CFT中主场信息的有力工具，其普遍机制（时间导数场不贡献静态响应）不仅深化了对静态响应的理解，还在临界系统和无间隙拓扑相中带来重要应用，具有广泛的适用性。

title: Structure-preserving uncertainty quantification for GENERIC dynamics
summary: Structure-preserving machine learning embeds physical structure directly into model architectures, yet uncertainty quantification (UQ) for such hard-constrained models remains limited because standard UQ methods may violate the encoded admissibility conditions, require architectural modifications, or impose substantial computational costs. In this work, we propose Structure-Preserving Epistemic Neural Networks (S-PENNs), a general framework for UQ in scientific machine learning models with hard architectural constraints, and instantiate it for GENERIC (General Equation for Non-Equilibrium Reversible-Irreversible Coupling) dynamics. S-PENNs preserve the structural constraints of a pretrained model by attaching lightweight epinets to its constrained components, ensuring that every sampled realization remains physically admissible by construction. When applied to GENERIC dynamics, such a proposed framework yields thermodynamically consistent rollouts that preserve the first and second laws. Furthermore, we combine S-PENNs with split conformal prediction as a post-hoc calibration method to produce prediction intervals with finite-sample marginal coverage guarantees. We validate S-PENNs on three numerical examples: a harmonic oscillator coupled to a heat bath and an idealized chemical motor, both governed by ODEs, and a one-dimensional viscoplastic model governed by PDEs. Across all three examples, S-PENNs produce thermodynamically consistent stochastic realizations and well-calibrated prediction intervals while reducing the computational cost by about one to three orders of magnitude compared to deep ensembles. Although the present study focuses on GENERIC dynamics, S-PENNs can be extended more broadly to scientific machine learning models in computational mechanics with either hard or soft constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构保持认知神经网络(S-PENNs)，这是一种用于具有硬约束的科学机器学习模型的不确定性量化通用框架。通过在预训练模型的受约束组件上附加轻量级epinets，确保每个采样实现都保持物理可容许性，并结合分裂共形预测提供有限样本边际覆盖保证。在GENERIC动力学上验证，相比深度集成将计算成本降低约1-3个数量级。
AI.motivation: 标准的不确定性量化方法在硬约束(硬编码物理结构)模型中可能违反所编码的容许性条件，或需要修改网络架构，或带来高昂的计算成本。亟需一种既能保持物理结构约束又不牺牲计算效率的UQ框架。
AI.method: S-PENNs通过在预训练模型的受约束组件上附加轻量级epinets来引入认知不确定性，确保所有采样实现满足物理容许性；对于GENERIC动力学，该框架保证热力学一致性(第一、第二定律)；进一步与分裂共形预测(split conformal prediction)结合作为事后校准方法，提供有限样本边际覆盖保证的预测区间。
AI.result: 在三个数值例子(谐波振荡器耦合热浴、理想化化学马达(ODE)、一维粘塑性模型(PDE))上验证，S-PENNs产生热力学一致的随机实现和良好校准的预测区间，计算成本比深度集成降低约1-3个数量级。
AI.conclusion: S-PENNs为具有硬或软约束的科学机器学习模型提供了通用且计算高效的UQ框架，目前聚焦于GENERIC动力学，但可广泛扩展到计算力学中的各类模型。

title: Two-atom Dicke model with atom-atom interaction
summary: Interactions among emitters provide a powerful means of controlling collective light--matter phenomena, yet their role in superradiant criticality has not been thoroughly investigated. Here we construct a minimal model that can yield analytical insights --- a Dicke model with two interacting atoms coupled to a single mode cavity --- to study such interaction effects. We show that interaction changes the phase boundary, and may even completely suppress the atom-photon coupling threshold for superradiance and change the universality class of the phase transition. We further study the dissipative phase transition and quantum dynamics in the presence of dissipation channels such as photon loss and spin relaxation. Our results demonstrate important roles played by the atom-atom interaction and how it can be engineered to control atom-photon coupling.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含两个相互作用原子耦合到单模腔的Dicke最小模型，研究原子间相互作用对超辐射临界现象的影响，发现相互作用可改变相边界、完全抑制原子-光子耦合阈值并改变相变的普适性类别，同时研究了耗散通道下的耗散相变和量子动力学。
AI.motivation: 发射体之间的相互作用是控制集体光-物质现象的有力手段，但它们在超辐射临界性中的作用尚未被深入研究。本文旨在通过一个可解析求解的最小模型来系统探究原子间相互作用对超辐射相变的影响。
AI.method: 构建一个含两个相互作用原子耦合到单模腔的Dicke模型，通过解析方法研究相互作用对相边界、超辐射耦合阈值和普适性类别的影响，并进一步在光子损耗和自旋弛豫等耗散通道存在的情况下研究耗散相变与量子动力学。
AI.result: 研究发现原子间相互作用会改变相边界，甚至可能完全抑制超辐射所需的原子-光子耦合阈值，并改变相变的普适性类别。在耗散通道下也观察到相互作用对耗散相变和量子动力学的显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 原子间相互作用在超辐射临界现象中扮演重要角色，可通过工程设计原子间相互作用来控制原子-光子耦合行为，为调控集体光-物质现象提供了新的途径。

title: Wasserstein Filtering: A Sample Selection Method for Robust Distribution Learning
summary: Given a dataset where a portion of the samples are contaminated, our goal is to recover the underlying clean population distribution. To this end, we propose Wasserstein Filtering (WF), a novel sample selection framework that discards a fraction of suspicious samples and estimates the target distribution using the empirical measure of the remaining data. The core insight is to select a subset of samples whose empirical distribution maximizes its Wasserstein distance to the fully contaminated empirical distribution, thereby preferentially isolating and removing geometrically influential outliers. To render this optimization computationally tractable, we introduce three algorithms: a marginal screening scheme, SinkMarg, and two joint optimization algorithms, SinkWF and SlicedWF, leveraging entropic optimal transport and sliced Wasserstein approximations, respectively. On the theoretical front, we introduce the Far Exclusion and Local Projection (FELP) contamination model, which characterizes corruptions consisting of well-separated outliers and locally indistinguishable perturbations. Under this model, we prove that the WF estimator achieves minimax optimality over distribution families with bounded covariance. Extensive numerical experiments on synthetic datasets, benchmark anomaly detection suites, and robust generative learning with diffusion models demonstrate that WF serves as a highly practical, model-agnostic preprocessing tool. It delivers competitive outlier detection performance and provides substantial downstream benefits for generative modeling under heavy contamination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Wasserstein Filtering (WF)框架，通过最大化子集经验分布与总体污染经验分布之间的Wasserstein距离来筛选并剔除异常样本，从而在部分样本被污染的数据集中恢复真实的干净分布。该方法提供了三个可计算算法（SinkMarg、SinkWF、SlicedWF），并提出FELP污染模型，在该模型下证明了WF估计器在有界协方差分布族上达到极小极大最优性。实验表明WF在异常检测和生成建模（如扩散模型）中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现实数据集常含有被污染的样本，如何从这类数据中可靠地恢复潜在的干净分布是一个核心问题。传统方法面对几何上具有影响力的异常值时可能失效，且缺乏在统一理论框架下保证估计质量的样本筛选方法。
AI.method: 提出Wasserstein Filtering (WF)框架：选择一组样本子集，使其经验分布与完全污染的经验分布之间的Wasserstein距离最大化，从而优先隔离并移除几何上突出的异常值。为计算可行性，开发三种算法：(1) SinkMarg——基于边际筛选的方案；(2) SinkWF——利用熵正则化最优传输的联合优化算法；(3) SlicedWF——基于切片Wasserstein近似的联合优化算法。理论上提出FELP (Far Exclusion and Local Projection)污染模型，刻画由良好分离的异常值和局部不可区分的扰动构成的污染形式，并在该模型下证明WF估计器的极小极大最优性。
AI.result: 在合成数据集、基准异常检测套件以及带扩散模型的鲁棒生成学习任务上的大量数值实验表明，WF作为模型无关的预处理工具具有高度实用性，在异常检测中取得了有竞争力的性能，并在重度污染条件下为生成建模带来了显著的下游收益。
AI.conclusion: WF是一种实用的、模型无关的数据预处理工具，能够有效从受污染数据中恢复干净分布，兼具理论最优性保证和实际算法可计算性，在异常检测和鲁棒生成建模中展现出广泛的应用前景。

title: Beyond persuasion: Mobile electoral interfaces in polarized societies
summary: Many traditional models of electoral dynamics emphasize opinion change, social influence and persuasion mechanisms. In contrast, contemporary polarized societies often exhibit relatively stable partisan blocs coexisting with an electorally relevant mobile population. We propose a minimal dynamical model in which electoral competition is governed not by direct persuasion between opposing blocs, but by the dynamics and allocation of a mobile electoral interface. The electorate is partitioned into two stable partisan blocs and a mobile fraction, while direct transitions between the polarized blocs are strongly suppressed. Mobile voters are allocated between the competing blocs through a Fermi-like probabilistic rule governed by rejection asymmetries. Analytical calculations show that the electoral susceptibility to political shocks is proportional to the stationary size of the mobile electoral interface, identifying electoral mobility as the key quantity controlling the macroscopic response of polarized systems to external perturbations. The model naturally predicts a continuum of mobility regimes, ranging from frozen polarization to highly responsive electoral states characterized by a broad mobile interface. These results suggest that, in strongly polarized elections, aggregate electoral changes may be governed primarily by fluctuations at the mobile electoral interface rather than by large-scale ideological conversion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个最小动力学模型，将选民划分为两个稳定的党派集团和一个移动选民界面，通过Fermi-like概率规则分配移动选民。分析表明选举对外部冲击的敏感性正比于移动界面的稳定规模，并预测从冻结极化到高响应性选举的连续移动性谱系，强调极化选举中的整体变化主要由移动界面波动主导，而非大规模意识形态转变。
AI.motivation: 传统的选举动力学模型强调意见变化、社会影响和说服机制，但这些模型难以解释当代极化社会中党派阵营相对稳定却同时存在选举相关移动人群的现象，因此需要一种不依赖直接说服、而是由移动选举界面动力学主导的新模型。
AI.method: 构建一个将选民划分为两个稳定党派集团和移动人群的极小动力学模型，压制极化阵营间的直接转换，通过基于拒绝不对称性的Fermi-like概率规则实现移动选民在竞争阵营间的分配，并进行解析计算推导选举敏感性与移动界面规模的关系。
AI.result: 解析计算表明政治冲击下的选举敏感性正比于移动选举界面的稳态规模；模型自然预测出从冻结极化到广泛移动界面的高响应性选举之间的连续移动性谱系。
AI.conclusion: 在强极化选举中，总体选举变化可能主要由移动选举界面上的波动所控制，而不是大规模意识形态转化所致；选举流动性是控制极化系统对外部扰动宏观响应的关键量。

title: Topology and Quantum-Spin-Classical-Spin Crossover of the Gapped Kondo Effect
summary: The gapped Kondo effect describes the screening of an $S=\frac12$ impurity spin locally coupled via an antiferromagnetic exchange interaction to a conduction-electron system exhibiting a finite hard gap. Using a combination of a Lanczos transformation and a self-consistent configuration-interaction scheme, we numerically investigate the local phase diagram. Furthermore, we show that the different phases can be characterized by several topological invariants: the conventional momentum-space Chern number of the underlying two-dimensional host system, corresponding to a Chern insulator; the B-space Chern number, defined by coupling the impurity spin to a fictitious local magnetic field $\boldsymbol B$, in the limit $B \to 0$; and the S-space Chern number, defined for a classical impurity spin, i.e., a vector of fixed length. The classical-spin limit is obtained for $B \to \infty$. By varying the field strength, we can therefore continuously interpolate between quantum-impurity-spin and classical-impurity-spin Hamiltonians and investigate whether the corresponding phase diagrams are likewise continuously connected. The gapped underscreened Kondo effect is studied for an impurity spin $S>\frac12$ as well as in the classical-spin limit approached via $B \to \infty$ or $S \to \infty$. Different variants of scattering theory are employed to interpret the resulting phases. Finally, the gapped two-channel overscreened Kondo effect, realized by coupling a quantum impurity spin equally to the local electron spins of both orbitals within a unit cell, is shown to be characterized by spontaneous particle-hole symmetry breaking. This leads to a highly nontrivial quantum-classical phase diagram.

AI.tldr: 本文通过朗扎斯变换与自洽组态相互作用方法，系统研究了有能隙近藤效应的局域相图，涵盖量子自旋（S=1/2）、欠屏蔽（S>1/2）与过屏蔽（双通道）等多种情形。通过引入B空间陈数（有限磁场极限）和S空间陈数（经典自旋极限），将量子与经典自旋哈密顿量连续关联，并用拓扑不变量和散射理论刻画各相。研究发现双通道过屏蔽近藤效应伴随自发粒子-空穴对称性破缺，形成非平凡的量子-经典相图。
AI.motivation: 有能隙近藤效应标志着量子杂质物理与拓扑绝缘体物理的交叉，此前对不同自旋大小和屏蔽通道情形下的相图缺乏系统研究，尤其是量子自旋极限与经典自旋极限之间的拓扑对应关系仍未阐明。
AI.method: 采用朗扎斯变换结合自洽组态相互作用（SCI）方案进行数值计算，定义三类拓扑不变量：传统动量空间陈数、耦合杂质自旋到虚构局域磁场的B空间陈数（B→0极限），以及经典杂质自旋的S空间陈数（B→∞或S→∞极限）。通过调节磁场强度在量子与经典极限间连续插值，辅以散射理论解释各相。
AI.result: 获得了S=1/2、S>1/2（欠屏蔽）及双通道过屏蔽情形的完整局域相图。量子与经典自旋极限间的相图可通过B空间/ S空间陈数建立连续对应；双通道过屏蔽情形展现出自发粒子-空穴对称性破缺，产生高度非平凡的量子-经典相图。
AI.conclusion: 有能隙近藤效应可由多种拓扑不变量完备刻画，量子与经典自旋极限之间存在可连续变形的拓扑联系，而多通道过屏蔽情形引入的对称性破缺使相图结构更加丰富，为理解量子-经典过渡中的拓扑相变提供了统一框架。

title: Integrated Alchemical and Conformational Enhanced Sampling for Solvation Free Energy Calculations
summary: Accurate solvation free energies from molecular dynamics simulations require efficient sampling of coupled slow variables, including solvent coordinates, solute conformational modes, and the alchemical coordinate $λ$. Here, we develop a $λ$-dynamics framework that combines mass scaling, on-the-fly probability enhanced sampling (OPES), and driven adiabatic free energy dynamics (d-AFED) to address these sampling challenges within a unified protocol. For rigid organic solutes, Hamiltonian replica exchange with mass scaling is first used to quantify the effect of octanol solvent relaxation. Reducing all octanol atomic masses by a factor of ten accelerates convergence by more than fivefold while preserving equilibrium solvation free energies. These calculations then provide reference benchmarks for $λ$-OPES, a dual-bias $λ$-dynamics strategy that combines the "standard" and "explore" variants of OPES to promote transitions along the alchemical coordinate. This approach reaches convergence on timescales comparable to replica exchange, but without predefined $λ$ windows or multiple parallel simulations. For flexible $N$-acetyl amino-acid amide solutes, $λ$-OPES is coupled with d-AFED on selected backbone and side-chain dihedrals to enable simultaneous alchemical and conformational enhanced sampling. This combined strategy improves agreement with experimental octanol-water partition coefficients and reduces the mean absolute error from 0.75 log units with $λ$-OPES alone to 0.30 log units with $λ$-OPES-d-AFED. Overall, this work establishes an integrated enhanced sampling protocol for solvation free energy calculations across rigid organic solutes and flexible peptide-like solutes, and provides a foundation for the application of alchemical free energy methods to larger and more conformationally complex systems.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个统一的λ-动力学增强采样框架，结合质量缩放、OPES和d-AFED方法，用于解决溶剂化自由能计算中的慢变量采样问题。该框架对刚性有机溶质和柔性肽类溶质均表现出优异的性能，将柔性溶质的实验辛醇-水分配系数预测误差从0.75 log单位降低到0.30 log单位。
AI.motivation: 分子动力学模拟中准确计算溶剂化自由能面临多重采样挑战：溶剂坐标、溶质构象模式以及alchemical坐标λ都是耦合的慢变量。传统方法（如预先定义λ窗口的副本交换）需要大量并行模拟和预定义参数，效率受限；而对柔性溶质，构象采样与alchemical采样的耦合进一步加剧了困难。
AI.method: 提出一个统一的增强采样协议，包含三个关键组件：(1) 对刚性溶质，先使用HREM（哈密顿副本交换）结合质量缩放（将辛醇原子质量降低10倍）来量化溶剂弛豫效应；(2) 开发λ-OPES双偏置λ-动力学策略，融合"standard"和"explore"两种OPES变体，无需预定义λ窗口即可沿alchemical坐标促进转换；(3) 对柔性溶质，将λ-OPES与d-AFED（驱动绝热自由能动力学）耦合，对选定的骨架和二面角进行同时的alchemical和构象增强采样。
AI.result: 质量缩放将辛醇溶剂弛豫的收敛速度提高5倍以上，同时保持平衡溶剂化自由能不变。λ-OPES在无需预定义λ窗口或多个并行模拟的情况下，达到了与副本交换相当的时间尺度收敛。对于N-乙酰氨基酸酰胺类柔性溶质，λ-OPES-d-AFED组合策略将辛醇-水分配系数的平均绝对误差从单独使用λ-OPES的0.75 log单位降低到0.30 log单位。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一个集成的增强采样协议，可同时适用于刚性有机溶质和柔性肽类溶质，为将alchemical自由能方法推广到更大、更复杂构象体系奠定了基础。

title: Free-Space Quantum Networks and Optimized Fiber-Reinforcement
summary: Free-space quantum communication provides a flexible complement to fiber-based quantum networks, but its point-to-point capacity is fundamentally limited by diffraction, atmospheric extinction and beam wandering induced by turbulence. In this work, we study the end-to-end performance of large-scale free-space quantum networks connecting randomly distributed fixed or mobile users, modelled as Waxman random graphs. We derive the mean network capacity, edge consumption and connectivity phase transitions for both single-path and multi-path (flooding) routing. We also study router-centered star networks, deriving the full distribution of end-to-end capacities as a function of the router's coverage radius. We then consider how performance may be improved by reinforcing free-space networks with a small number of optimally placed fiber-based backbone nodes. We prove that any optimal backbone configuration must correspond to a capacity-maximizing Voronoi tessellation of the network region, and show that this can be efficiently approximated by a centroidal Voronoi tessellation via Lloyd's algorithm, with backbone nodes connected according to a Delaunay triangulation. Numerical results show that even a modest number of backbone nodes substantially improves end-to-end capacity and reduces edge consumption for both mobile and fixed users.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大规模自由空间量子网络的端到端性能，将用户建模为Waxman随机图，推导了单路径和多路径路由下的平均网络容量、边消耗和连通性相变；同时分析了以路由器为中心的星型网络的端到端容量分布。进一步提出用少量光纤骨干节点增强自由空间网络，证明最优骨干配置等价于容量最大化的Voronoi剖分，可通过Lloyd算法和Delaunay三角剖分高效近似求解。
AI.motivation: 自由空间量子通信是对光纤量子网络的重要补充，但其点对点容量受衍射、大气消光和湍流引起的波束漂移等物理因素根本性限制。现有研究缺乏对大规模自由空间量子网络端到端性能的系统分析，作者旨在填补这一空白，并探索如何通过少量光纤骨干节点有效增强网络性能。
AI.method: 将随机分布的固定或移动用户建模为Waxman随机图，分别推导单路径和多路径（洪泛）路由下的平均网络容量、边消耗及连通性相变；推导路由器中心星型网络的端到端容量完整分布。证明最优骨干节点配置对应于容量最大化的Voronoi剖分，利用Lloyd算法通过质心Voronoi剖分近似求解，骨干节点间以Delaunay三角剖分连接。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，即使是数量适度的光纤骨干节点也能显著提升固定和移动用户的端到端容量，并降低边消耗。研究同时给出了网络容量、边消耗和连通性相变的解析结果，以及星型网络的容量分布特征。
AI.conclusion: 以光纤骨干节点增强自由空间量子网络是一种高效且可扩展的策略；最优骨干部署可通过Voronoi剖分与Lloyd算法在多项式时间内近似实现，为大规模混合量子网络设计提供了理论指导。

title: Bagging Robustly Learns VC Classes with Linear Sample Complexity
summary: We revisit the problem of learning predictors robust to adversarial examples at test-time. We prove that VC classes are adversarially robustly learnable with sample complexity linear in the VC dimension $d$, providing an exponential improvement over the previous upper bound of Montasser, Hanneke, and Srebro (2019). Remarkably, this result is achieved with a simple improper algorithm that combines the classic heuristic bagging (bootstrap aggregation) of Breiman (1996) with robust empirical risk minimization (RERM). Our algorithm computes RERMs on $O(d^\star)$ independent bootstrap samples and outputs their majority vote, where $d^\star$ denotes the dual VC dimension. We complement this result with a lower bound showing that this is unavoidable: in general, any learner in this oracle model requires $Ω(d^\star)$ calls to an RERM oracle, even when given arbitrarily many training examples.

AI.tldr: 本文重新研究了测试时对抗鲁棒学习问题，证明VC类可以被对抗鲁棒学习，采样复杂度与VC维d呈线性关系，相比Montasser等人(2019)的先前上界实现了指数级改进。该结果通过结合Breiman(1996)的bagging启发式方法与鲁棒经验风险最小化(RERM)的简单不当学习算法实现。算法在O(d*)个独立bootstrap样本上计算RERM并多数投票输出。论文还给出了下界，证明任何学习器在此oracle模型下至少需要Ω(d*)次RERM oracle调用。
AI.motivation: 先前Montasser等人(2019)对对抗鲁棒可学习性的上界不够紧，本文旨在改进对抗鲁棒学习的样本复杂度界限，将其从指数级降低到与VC维线性相关。
AI.method: 提出一个简单的"不当学习"(improper learning)算法，将经典bagging（bootstrap聚合）与RERM结合：在O(d*)个独立bootstrap采样上分别计算RERM，然后取其多数投票结果作为最终预测器，其中d*为对偶VC维。
AI.result: 证明了VC类的对抗鲁棒可学习性样本复杂度为O(d)（线性于VC维），相对先前上界实现指数级改进；同时给出匹配的下界Ω(d*)，证明在该oracle模型中RERM调用的次数不可避免。
AI.conclusion: 该工作不仅大幅改进了对抗鲁棒学习的样本复杂度理论上界，还表明简单的bagging+RERM组合就能达到近似最优性能，同时下界证明该方法的oracle调用次数在一般情形下是紧的。

title: Capillary self-folding chains
summary: Mesoscale self-assembly provides a route toward the design of programmable microsystems. Here, we construct flexible chains of floating monomers whose curved branches impose upward or downward deformations of the liquid interface, corresponding to effective positive or negative capillary charges. These geometrically encoded deformations generate local attractive or repulsive interactions along the chain. By tuning the capillary sequence, we obtain distinct folded configurations, including straight lines, zigzag patterns, and loops. For short chains, folding is largely governed by nearest-neighbor interactions and leads to well-defined structures. As the chain length increases and non-neighboring segments come into proximity and interact, however, the folding landscape becomes increasingly complex, with multiple metastable states whose number grows exponentially with chain length. We map these landscapes numerically and demonstrate experimentally that mechanical agitation allows the chains to transition between metastable configurations. Beyond encoding a target geometry, the capillary sequence therefore controls the complexity of the folding landscape as well as the degeneracy and mutational robustness of folded structures. These results establish capillary chains as a controllable mesoscale platform for investigating how local interaction rules give rise to collective folding and complex sequence-to-structure relationships reminiscent of those encountered in biomolecular systems.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一种由浮动单体组成的柔性毛细链，单体弯曲分支使液体界面产生上凸或下凹变形，对应有效正或负毛细电荷，从而产生沿链的局部吸引或排斥作用。通过调节毛细序列可获得直线、锯齿和环等多折叠构型。短链折叠主要由近邻相互作用主导，结构明确；随着链长增加，非近邻段相互靠近并相互作用，折叠景观变得复杂，亚稳态数量随链长呈指数增长。数值映射折叠景观并通过机械搅拌实验展示亚稳态间的转变。毛细序列不仅编码目标几何构型，还控制折叠景观复杂度、简并性和突变鲁棒性，为研究局部相互作用规则如何产生集体折叠和复杂序列-结构关系提供了可控的中尺度平台。
AI.motivation: 探索中尺度自组装中如何通过局部相互作用规则实现可编程的折叠行为，并深入研究从简单序列编码到复杂折叠景观的转变，类比生物分子系统中序列-结构关系。
AI.method: 构建浮动单体的柔性毛细链，利用单体弯曲分支诱发液体界面上凸或下凹变形来编码有效正/负毛细电荷；通过调节毛细序列改变链内局部吸引/排斥作用；采用数值方法映射不同链长下的折叠能量景观，并通过机械搅拌进行实验验证。
AI.result: 成功获得直线、锯齿、环等不同折叠构型；短链折叠由近邻相互作用主导并形成明确定义的结构；长链折叠景观复杂度增加，亚稳态数量随链长指数增长；实验证明机械搅拌能使链在亚稳态之间转变。毛细序列控制目标几何编码、折叠景观复杂度、构型简并性及突变鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 毛细链可作为可控的中尺度平台，用于研究局部相互作用规则如何驱动集体折叠行为，揭示与生物分子系统类似的序列-结构复杂关系，为可编程微系统设计提供新途径。

title: Accelerating a Strong-Coupling Non-Equilibrium Steady-State Impurity Solver using (Quantics) Tensor Trains
comment: 21 pages, 21 figures, and 2 tables. Submitted to Physical Review B
summary: Including higher order diagrammatic corrections to the strong-coupling expansion is mainly limited by the evaluation of high-dimensional, time-ordered integrals. In this work we present and compare four different parametrizations of the integrands in order to obtain a low-rank (quantics) tensor-train representation using tensor cross interpolation. Particular emphasis is placed on a quantics time-difference formulation in which the required retarded convolutions are performed directly in quantics tensor-train form. Using controlled Gaussian benchmarks, we analyze the accuracy, bond dimensions, and computational scaling of the different approaches. We then validate the most promising formulations in self-consistent equilibrium and nonequilibrium DMFT calculations and demonstrate calculations up to the third order in the strong-coupling expansion. Finally, we extend the solver to impurity models with retarded density-density interactions and apply it within nonequilibrium extended DMFT. Our results show that tensor cross interpolation substantially reduces the cost of evaluating higher-order diagrams and provides a controlled, systematically improvable framework for nonequilibrium quantum impurity calculations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并比较了四种不同的积分元参数化方法，通过张量交叉插值获得低秩（quantics）张量-train表示，用于高效计算强耦合展开中的高维、时间有序积分。基于高斯基准验证了精度和计算标度，并在平衡和非平衡DMFT计算中验证至强耦合展开三阶，同时扩展到含延迟密度-密度相互作用的杂质模型及非平衡扩展DMFT。
AI.motivation: 强耦合展开中高阶图解修正的计算主要受限于高维时间有序积分的评估，传统方法计算成本极高，亟需一种更高效、可控且可系统改进的方法来处理这类积分。
AI.method: 提出四种不同的积分元参数化方案以获得低秩quantics张量-train表示，特别强调了一种quantics时间差分离散化方案，其中所需的延迟卷积直接在quantics张量-train形式中执行；使用受控高斯基准分析精度、键维数和计算标度。
AI.result: 高斯基准验证了各方法的精度与标度；在自洽平衡和非平衡DMFT计算中成功验证了最有效的公式，实现了强耦合展开至三阶的计算；进一步将该求解器扩展到含延迟密度-密度相互作用的杂质模型，并应用于非平衡扩展DMFT。
AI.conclusion: 张量交叉插值显著降低了高阶图解评估的计算成本，为远离平衡的量子杂质计算提供了一个可控且可系统改进的框架。

title: Finite-Temperature Thermodynamics of Cu(100) Oxidation: Missing-Row Reconstruction, Defect States, and Order-Disorder Transition from Nested Sampling
summary: Metal surfaces undergo structural, compositional, and morphological changes in response to their chemical environment. Tuning the surfaces' function and stability for a given application correspondingly necessitates an understanding of how this surface evolution couples to external conditions. Here, we demonstrate the feasibility of nested sampling simulations to obtain this coupling at first-principles predictive quality. By exploring the full configuration space, nested sampling estimates the partition function and gives direct access to desired thermodynamic ensemble averages at any temperature without prior knowledge. Computational feasibility is achieved through machine-learned interatomic potentials, an efficient GPU implementation of the sampling algorithm and bespoke sampling moves. Applied to the early oxidation of Cu(100), the approach successfully predicts the experimentally observed, complex $(2\sqrt{2}\times\sqrt{2})$R45$^\circ$-O missing-row reconstruction. The full access to the partition function enables a detailed characterization of the temperature-dependent surface evolution, mapping the emergence of defect states and the order-disorder transition of the reconstructed surface.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种结合嵌套采样、机器学习势函数和GPU加速的模拟方法，可在第一性原理预测精度下探索金属表面构型空间，并成功预测了Cu(100)早期氧化中实验观测到的复杂(2√2×√2)R45°-O缺行重构，同时提供了温度依赖的表面演化细节。
AI.motivation: 金属表面会随化学环境发生结构、组成和形态变化，理解表面演化与外部条件的耦合对调控表面功能和稳定性至关重要，但传统方法难以在无先验条件下获得完整的配分函数和任意温度下的系综平均值。
AI.method: 采用嵌套采样（nested sampling）方法探索完整构型空间以估计配分函数，结合机器学习训练的原子间势（MLIPs）保证第一性原理预测精度，并利用高效的GPU实现和定制化采样移动策略提升计算可行性。
AI.result: 成功预测了Cu(100)早期氧化中实验观测到的复杂(2√2×√2)R45°-O缺行重构；通过完整配分函数详细刻画了温度依赖的表面演化，映射了缺陷态的出现以及重构表面的有序-无序转变过程。
AI.conclusion: 嵌套采样结合机器学习势函数与GPU加速是可行的第一性原理级表面演化预测工具，无需先验知识即可获得完整热力学信息，可用于复杂表面重构和相转变的系统性研究。

title: Topological State-Aware Simulation Framework for Inter-Satellite Twin-Field QKD Networks
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Code and data available at Zenodo (https://zenodo.org/records/19778806)
summary: Inter-satellite links (ISLs) are the mandatory backbone for global quantum networks. While Twin-Field Quantum Key Distribution (TF-QKD) successfully surpasses linear rate-loss bounds, its extreme phase sensitivity makes it highly vulnerable to dynamic, non-IID (Independent and Identically Distributed) orbital environments. In composable finite-key analyses governed by the Generalized Entropy Accumulation Theorem (GEAT), traditional adaptive post-selection heuristics either violate strict independence conditions or incur massive second-order penalties that collapse the secret key rate. To overcome this, we introduce a reference-only topological post-selection oracle. By modeling the constellation as a Cellular Sheaf and applying Topological Data Analysis (TDA), our protocol derives a public acceptance event ($Ω$) exclusively from classical beacon telemetry. To rigorously validate this mechanism, we develop a modular simulation framework equipped with stochastic noise injection and an explicit GEAT security ledger. Simulations across 2,000-5,000 km ISL separations compare the same Hodge-Koopman gate with TDA disabled and enabled. At 2,000 km, the median conditional candidate rates are $2.14 \times 10^{-6}$ and $5.87 \times 10^{-7}$ bit per emitted pulse, respectively; both configurations return zero at 3,000-5,000 km. TDA is active in all 4,788 evaluated windows, but does not extend the positive-candidate range in this scenario. These exported rates are conditional numerical candidates: the full protocol-level composable-security proof remains incomplete and the certified composable rate is therefore zero throughout.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于拓扑数据分析（TDA）的参考拓扑后选择预言机，用于克服TF-QKD在低轨星座动态非IID轨道环境中因严格独立性条件违反或二阶惩罚导致的密钥率崩溃问题。仿真显示TDA在2000km处提高条件候选速率，但未扩展正速率范围，且完整可组合安全证明尚未完成，认证可组合密钥率仍为零。
AI.motivation: 星际链路是全球量子网络的关键骨干，TF-QKD虽突破线性率损界限，但其对相位极度敏感，难以应对动态非IID轨道环境。在广义熵累积定理（GEAT）框架下，传统自适应后选择启发式方法要么违反严格独立条件，要么承受巨大二阶惩罚导致秘密密钥率崩溃。因此需要一种既能满足GEAT独立性要求又不会引入过多二阶代价的后选择机制。
AI.method: 将星座建模为细胞层（Cellular Sheaf），应用拓扑数据分析（TDA）从经典信标遥测数据中仅导出公开接受事件Ω，构建参考拓扑后选择预言机。同时开发了一个模块化仿真框架，配备随机噪声注入和显式GEAT安全账本。在2000-5000km星际分离条件下，对比同一Hodge-Koopman门在TDA禁用与启用下的性能。
AI.result: 在2000km距离处，TDA禁用和启用时中位条件候选速率分别为2.14×10⁻⁶和5.87×10⁻⁷ bit/发射脉冲；两配置在3000-5000km均为零。TDA在全部4788个评估窗口中均被激活，但未扩展正候选速率范围。导出的速率为条件数值候选值，完整协议级可组合安全证明尚不完整，认证可组合速率全程为零。
AI.conclusion: 虽然TDA拓扑后选择预言机作为概念验证在短距离上表现出候选速率改进，但该方法在此场景下并未真正扩展正速率覆盖范围，且缺乏完整可组合安全证明。当前结果仅为数值候选，协议尚未达到可部署的认证安全水平。

title: Unifying Generative Models with Path Integrals
summary: We formulate generative modeling as a path integral in which flow-based, diffusion-based, variational, and adversarial models arise as different evaluation principles for a single master action. Its Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-de~Dominicis (MSRJD) form separates free from interacting probability flows and opens them to diagrammatic perturbation theory. The expansion yields a one-loop correction to deterministic samplers at no stochastic-sampling cost, which we validate on solvable and nonlinear drifts, where it reduces a 53 % tree-level error to 1.6 %. Imperfect learned scores enter as insertions and yield a response-weighted score-matching objective, and symmetry-equivariant drift design becomes an operator expansion with EFT power counting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的生成建模路径积分框架（主作用量），将流模型、扩散模型、变分模型和对抗模型统一为同一主作用量的不同评估原则。通过MSRJD形式将自由概率流与相互作用概率流分离，并引入费曼图微扰论：单圈修正可在无随机采样成本下改善确定性采样器（将53%的树级误差降至1.6%）；不完美学习得分作为插入项产生响应加权的得分匹配目标；对称等变漂移设计被重构为具有EFT功率计数的算子展开。
AI.motivation: 当前生成模型领域存在多种看似独立的方法论（流模型、扩散模型、变分和对抗模型），缺乏统一的数学框架来理解其内在联系与差异。作者旨在通过路径积分这一理论工具构建涵盖所有主要生成建模范式的统一形式体系，并挖掘该框架带来的实际计算收益（如无需额外采样成本的微扰修正）。
AI.method: 将生成建模表述为路径积分，采用MSRJD形式体系区分自由与相互作用概率流，使系统可应用费曼图微扰论。具体方法包括：(1) 推导单圈修正公式用于改进确定性采样器；(2) 将不完美学习得分作为外线插入处理，导出响应加权得分匹配目标函数；(3) 利用有效场论（EFT）功率计数对对称等变漂移设计进行算子展开分析。
AI.result: 在可解析和非线性漂移系统上验证了单圈修正的有效性，将树级误差从53%显著降低至1.6%，且不产生额外随机采样成本。此外，推导出的响应加权得分匹配目标以及对称等变漂移的EFT算子展开为设计更优的生成模型提供了新的理论指导。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了生成建模与统计场论之间的深层联系，证明微扰论技术在生成模型中具有实用价值。统一框架不仅提供了理论上的整合视角，还带来了实质性的数值改进，为后续在生成建模中引入更丰富的场论工具（如重整化、对称性分析）开辟了道路。

title: Aperiodicity is sufficient for macroscopic thermalization
summary: We identify a general mechanism for the finite-time thermalization of macroscopic observables, such as coarse-grained charge densities, in terms of elementary forms of the quantum dynamics of initial states: (1) aperiodicity, which provides a computable measure of (2) a dynamical partially ergodic exploration of the Hilbert space. Specifically, this mechanism predicts the equilibration of all (concentrated) macroscopic observables, in almost all states in an initial ensemble and almost all times within finite and longer intervals, given only the observable-independent information that the return probability of the ensemble of initial states is small over a finite time range. As a special case, it also accesses standard results on equilibration over infinitely long times in terms of (stronger versions of) the effective dimension of initial state delocalization in the energy eigenbasis. Our results incorporate macroscopic thermalization into the domain of operational quantum statistical mechanics, recently developed to provide finitely computable criteria for microscopic thermalization. We discuss an overall characterization of this approach as establishing connections between (1) the decay of a (theoretically or experimentally) computable probe indicating memorylessness, (2) a fundamental invariant mechanism in terms of the alignment of observables or states in the Hilbert space, and (3) predicting different natural forms of (classical and) quantum thermalization, most of which rigorously recover conventional eigenstate-based descriptions of infinite-time thermalization as a special case but provide stronger accessible predictions over finite observation times in the thermodynamic limit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种宏观可观测量的有限时间热化的一般机制，基于初始态量子动力学的两个基本要素：(1) 非周期性，提供可计算的热化度量；(2) 希尔伯特空间的动力学部分遍历探索。该机制仅凭初始态系综的返回概率在有限时间内较小这一可观测无关信息，即可预测几乎所有集中的宏观可观测量在几乎所有初始态和几乎所有有限时间内的平衡，并将宏观热化纳入可操作量子统计力学的范畴。
AI.motivation: 传统的量子热化研究（如本征态热化假设ETH）主要关注无限时间极限下的平衡描述，难以对有限时间内的宏观热化行为提供可计算的、可操作的判据。作者希望将宏观热化纳入"可操作量子统计力学"的框架，该框架此前已被发展用于微观热化的有限可计算判据，从而弥合宏观热化理论与有限观测时间实验之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 作者通过识别两个核心要素建立热化机制：(1) 非周期性（aperiodicity），作为初始态量子动力学的一种可计算度量；(2) 动力学部分遍历探索（dynamical partially ergodic exploration of Hilbert space），刻画系统对希尔伯特空间的探索程度。核心条件是该机制仅需观测无关的信息——初始态系综在有限时间范围内的返回概率足够小，即可推导出所有集中的宏观可观测量在几乎所有初始态和几乎所有有限时间内达到平衡的结论。作为特例，该方法还能恢复无限长时间平衡的标准结果（基于有效维度等更强的条件）。
AI.result: 该机制预测：给定初始态系综的返回概率在有限时间范围内较小，则几乎所有（集中的）宏观可观测量在几乎所有初始态和几乎所有有限及更长的时间区间内都能实现平衡。这作为特例包含了无限长时间热化的标准结果（由有效维度的更强版本导出），并且相较于传统本征态描述，在热力学极限下的有限观测时间内提供了更强且更可获得的预测。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了三个层次的联系：(1) 可（理论或实验）计算的探针（返回概率）的衰减反映了系统的"无记忆性"；(2) 其背后是希尔伯特空间中可观测量或态对齐（alignment）这一基本不变机制；(3) 这预测了经典与量子热化的不同自然形式，其中大多数严格恢复了传统本征态描述的无限时间热化作为特例，但在热力学极限下提供了更强的有限观测时间可访问预测。整体上将宏观热化纳入了可操作量子统计力学的理论框架。

title: Emergent Symmetry-Protected Topological Phases via Polyakov Confinement in Quantum Spin Systems
summary: A main theme in modern condensed matter physics is the emergence of fractionalized excitations and gauge structures from quantum spin systems. However, understanding how these exotic degrees of freedom reconfine into new phases of matter remains a fundamental challenge. In this work, we demonstrate that Polyakov's confinement mechanism-a foundation of compact gauge theory-can serve as a dynamical engine to transform a Dirac spin liquid into a symmetry-protected topological (SPT) state. Starting with a Dirac spin liquid with spin-dependent gauge fluxes, we show that the single-occupancy constraint inherent to the physical Hilbert space triggers monopole condensation, dynamically confining bulk spinons while preserving gapless edge modes-realizing a spinon analog of the quantum spin Hall effect. Using a large-scale variational Monte Carlo simulation on a triangular antiferromagnet with an additional Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction, we provide microscopic evidence for this confined SPT phase, including a characteristic area law for the Wilson loop and vanishing topological entanglement entropy. Furthermore, we identify a measurable spin-pump response under magnetic fields, which directly encodes the Berry curvature of the parent Dirac cones. Our results reveal a previously unexplored pathway to SPT physics, bridging the fields of gauge theory, quantum magnetism, and topological matter.

AI.tldr: 本文证明Polyakov禁闭机制可以将Dirac自旋液体转变为对称性保护拓扑（SPT）态，通过单体占据约束触发磁单极凝聚，禁闭体自旋子同时保留无能隙边缘态，实现了自旋子版的量子自旋霍尔效应，并在三角反铁磁体（含Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用）上通过大尺度变分蒙特卡洛模拟提供了微观证据。
AI.motivation: 凝聚态物理的核心问题之一是理解量子自旋系统中分数化激发与规范结构如何重新禁闭形成新的物相，探索从量子自旋液体到传统物相转变的机制与途径。
AI.method: 利用Polyakov禁闭机制（紧致规范场论的基石）作为动力学引擎，结合物理希尔伯特空间固有的单体占据约束触发磁单极凝聚；采用大尺度变分蒙特卡洛模拟于含Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用的三角反铁磁体上，通过Wilson环面积律、拓扑纠缠熵及自旋泵浦响应等观测量表征该SPT相。
AI.result: 实现了Dirac自旋液体到禁闭SPT态的转变：体自旋子被动力学禁闭而边缘模式保持无能隙；Wilson环满足特征面积律、拓扑纠缠熵为零；识别出在磁场下可测量的自旋泵浦响应，直接编码母Dirac锥的Berry曲率。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了从量子自旋体系到SPT物理的全新路径，将规范场论、量子磁性与拓扑物质三个领域联结起来，为研究分数化激发重禁闭形成新物相提供了理论框架与微观证据。

title: Parametric Matrix Models for Emulation in Nuclear and Many-Body Physics
summary:
Progress in nuclear and many-body physics today is predicated on the ability to solve large-scale, strongly correlated quantum many-body problems. As the theoretical models become more sophisticated, they also become more computationally complex. Simultaneously, quantifying uncertainty in model predictions and fitting free parameters to experimental observations requires repeated evaluation of these expensive models. Surrogate models---known as emulators---provide the means of accomplishing these goals.
  This thesis provides an introduction into the current state of emulation in nuclear and many-body physics. The motivations, goals, and origins of currently popular emulation methods are discussed along with selected examples. We see how many methods are closely mathematically related and how trade-offs are made to optimize specific properties or applications.
  The central work in this thesis is the method of parametric matrix models (PMMs), an emulation and general machine learning framework which combines aspects of traditional reduced basis method with modern parametric machine learning. PMMs are able to retain as much or as little physical information about the underlying system as desired, yielding not only excellent performance but also nearly unparalleled adaptability, interpretability, and trustworthiness as an emulation method.
  A formal mathematical framework for PMMs is developed and accompanied by practical step-by-step procedures for the application of the method.
  As part of this thesis, the open-source pyPMM package was developed. This package enables any researcher to construct, train, share, and deploy PMM-based emulators with modular, extendable, and graphics processing unit (GPU)-optimized code. All PMM examples in this thesis were created using this package.

AI.tldr: 本论文系统地介绍了核物理与多体物理中仿真器（emulator）的现状，并提出了参数化矩阵模型（PMMs）这一融合传统降基方法与参数化机器学习的仿真与通用机器学习框架，同时开发了开源软件包pyPMM以供研究者使用。
AI.motivation: 核物理与多体物理中，随着理论模型日益复杂，计算代价急剧上升，同时在拟合实验数据和量化预测不确定性时需要反复评估这些昂贵模型。因此需要开发高效的替代模型（仿真器）来解决这一计算瓶颈。
AI.method: 论文的核心方法是参数化矩阵模型（PMMs），它将传统降基方法（reduced basis method）与现代参数化机器学习相结合，允许根据需求保留任意程度的底层系统物理信息。论文建立了PMMs的形式化数学框架，并提供了逐步实施流程，同时开发了开源的pyPMM包，采用模块化、可扩展且GPU优化的代码实现。
AI.result: 论文展示了PMMs在性能、适应性、可解释性和可信度方面均表现出色，同时指出许多流行的仿真方法在数学上密切相关，并可通过权衡取舍来优化特定属性或应用。所有PMM示例均通过开发的pyPMM包实现。
AI.conclusion: PMMs作为一种仿真与通用机器学习框架，在保留物理可解释性的同时提供优异的仿真性能，结合开源工具pyPMM，使得任何研究者都能便捷地构建、训练和部署基于PMM的仿真器，有望推动核物理及多体物理中的不确定性量化和模型拟合研究。

title: SPLIT-Q: A Scalable Sequential Quantum Computing Framework for Coherent Controlled Islanding
summary: Growing integration of distributed energy resources increases power-system variability and uncertainty. During disturbances, these effects can intensify generation-load imbalances and cascading failures. Controlled islanding limits their propagation by partitioning a compromised grid into connected, electrically sustainable islands. However, classical methods face rapidly growing computational costs as network size and island count increase. Quantum optimization offers an alternative for exploring this combinatorial partition space. Yet monolithic quantum formulations encode all assignment decisions in one circuit, causing qubit demand and circuit complexity to scale with network size. In this study, a qubit-bounded sequential distributed quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) framework is proposed to tackle coherent controlled islanding under limited quantum resources. It formulates the optimization as boundary-conditioned regional quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) subproblems that are solved sequentially within a fixed qubit budget. Thus, circuit width remains independent of network size, with aggregate quantum workload scaling linearly on bounded-degree networks. Evaluation covers eleven IEEE systems from 9 to 300 buses using IBM quantum computing resources, with Gurobi and monolithic QAOA as references. Across all systems, the framework recovers feasible Gurobi-optimal partitions under noise, confirming the resilience of its solution quality. The results further show that the proposed method substantially reduces quantum-resource demand and circuit complexity relative to monolithic QAOA, allowing large islanding problems to be addressed within current hardware limits. The proposed framework provides a feasible and scalable pathway for quantum optimization in large-scale power systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于量子比特预算约束的序列分布式QAOA框架，用于解决大规模电力系统的受控孤立（controlled islanding）问题。该框架将问题分解为边界条件约束的区域QUBO子问题，在固定量子比特预算下序贯求解，电路宽度与网络规模无关，聚合量子计算负载在有限度网络上呈线性增长。在11个IEEE测试系统（9到300母线）上使用IBM量子计算资源验证，恢复出可行的Gurobi最优分区，并相比单体QAOA大幅降低了量子资源需求和电路复杂度。
AI.motivation: 分布式能源资源的大规模接入加剧了电力系统的波动性和不确定性，在扰动期间可能加剧发电-负荷失衡及级联故障。受控孤立策略可通过将受损电网分割为连通且电气可持续的孤岛来限制故障传播。然而经典方法随网络规模和孤岛数量增长面临快速上升的计算成本；量子优化虽为组合分区空间探索提供新途径，但单体量子公式将所有分配决策编码进单一电路，导致量子比特需求和电路复杂度随网络规模增长，超出当前硬件限制。
AI.method: 提出一种量子比特有界的序列分布式量子近似优化算法（QAOA）框架。其核心做法是将受控孤立优化问题表述为边界条件化的区域QUBO子问题，在固定的量子比特预算内序贯求解各子问题。该设计使得电路宽度（qubit数）不依赖网络规模，且在有限度数网络上聚合量子工作量呈线性扩展。评估在IEEE 9-300母线共11个系统上使用IBM量子计算资源进行，以Gurobi和单体QAOA作为参照基准。
AI.result: 在所有11个IEEE测试系统上，该框架在噪声条件下均能恢复可行的Gurobi最优分区，验证了其解质量的鲁棒性。与单体QAOA相比，该方法大幅降低了量子资源需求和电路复杂度，使得大规模孤立问题可在当前硬件限制内得到求解。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为大规模电力系统中的量子优化提供了一条可行且可扩展的路径，证明了在受限量子资源条件下实现大规模受控孤立问题的可行性，展示了量子优化在电力系统规模化应用中的潜力。

title: Don't Cut Corners: How Training Outside the Prior Makes Simulation-Based Inference More Robust
comment: 11 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to PRX Intelligence
summary: Large astrophysical simulation campaigns often generate training data by sampling parameters across a Uniform prior box. Due to the proposal's sharp edge, neural posterior estimators struggle to learn accurate approximations near the boundaries. We propose Tailed-Uniform, a family of hybrid proposal distributions for sampling training simulations for robust simulation-based inference. By padding the original hard-truncated training box with decaying tails, Tailed-Uniform-trained networks yield more accurate posteriors near and beyond the edges. We demonstrate these improvements on a family of tail shapes, including a widened Uniform box as a control. Our results suggest that additional simulations near the prior boundary better constrain the networks as it approaches the edge of the training box, even for Uniform assumed priors. We show these advantages on a toy problem and cosmological parameter inference from the matter power spectrum. These benefits increase in high dimensions, where boundaries dominate parameter space volume.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tailed-Uniform，一种混合提议分布族，用于在仿真驱动（simulation-based inference）训练中解决均匀先验盒边界处神经后验估计器学习精度差的问题。通过在硬截断训练盒外添加衰减尾，提升网络在边界附近及之外的推理精度，并在玩具问题与物质功率谱宇宙学参数推断上验证了效果，且维度越高优势越明显。
AI.motivation: 大型天体物理仿真通常从均匀先验盒子中采样参数生成训练数据，但由于提议分布的尖锐边缘，神经后验估计器在边界附近难以学习到准确的近似，导致边界处的推断精度下降。
AI.method: 提出Tailed-Uniform分布族：在原始硬截断均匀训练盒的基础上，向边界外填充衰减尾（decaying tails），形成混合提议分布用于采样训练仿真数据。以加宽的均匀盒子作为对照，研究不同尾形状的影响。
AI.result: Tailed-Uniform训练的神经网络在边界附近及边界之外产生更准确的后验分布。在玩具问题和基于物质功率谱的宇宙学参数推断上均验证了改进，且这些优势在高维情形下更显著，因为高维空间中边界占据更大比例的体积。
AI.conclusion: 在训练盒边界附近增加额外的仿真数据能更好地约束网络接近边界时的行为，即便最终推断使用的是均匀先验，Tailed-Uniform提议策略仍带来显著的精度提升，为仿真推理中的训练数据采样提供了更优方案。

title: Hidden Dyson Universality in Inverse-Spectral Geometry
summary: Dyson universality typically manifests itself in local eigenvalue statistics. Here we show that its signature survives a nonlinear inverse-spectral reconstruction and reappears in the matrix geometry of the reconstructed operator. Using a dressing transformation, we map each unfolded spectrum to a deformation $f(x)$ of a fixed harmonic oscillator and represent it in the common oscillator basis by $F_{mn}=\bra m|f|n\ket$. We resolve the matrix-element weight into shells of fixed distance $d=|m-n|$, corresponding to the energy-transfer channels of the reference oscillator, and characterize the resulting distribution by distance-shell moments. Independently calibrated on Gaussian $β$-ensembles, these moments vary smoothly with $β$ and distinguish the GOE, GUE, and GSE. With this calibration fixed, applying the same diagnostic to the nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function places the reconstructed operators in the GUE sector. Thus, the GUE character of the zeros is recovered not through direct statistics of the input levels, but from the distance-resolved geometry of the reconstructed operator.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Dyson变换将谱数据重构为算子的几何结构，发现Dyson普适性在重构后仍存留于矩阵几何中。通过距离壳矩的诊断，区分GOE/GUE/GSE，并将Riemann zeta函数的非平凡零点定位于GUE扇区。
AI.motivation: Dyson普适性通常体现在局部本征值统计中，作者希望探索其能否在非线性逆谱重构后存活，并在重构算子的矩阵几何中以新的形式重新显现，从而为谱分类提供独立于直接输入统计的诊断工具。
AI.method: 利用dressing变换将每个展开谱映射为固定谐振子的变形f(x)，在共同基下表示为矩阵元F_mn。按固定距离d=|m-n|（对应参考谐振子的能量转移通道）将矩阵元权重分解为壳层，并定义距离壳矩来描述分布。先在Gaussian β系综（GOE/GUE/GSE）上独立校准这些矩随β的变化，再将该诊断应用于Riemann zeta函数的非平凡零点。
AI.result: 距离壳矩随β平滑变化，能够区分GOE、GUE和GSE三个系综。将该校准好的诊断应用于Riemann zeta函数零点时，重构算子被定位在GUE扇区，表明零点具有GUE特性。
AI.conclusion: Riemann zeta函数零点的GUE特性不是通过输入能级的直接统计获得，而是从重构算子的距离分辨几何中恢复的。这证明了Dyson普适性的特征在逆谱重构后的矩阵几何中依然存留，提供了一种新的谱系综分类途径。

title: Imaginary-time correlations in time-sliced stochastic series expansion
summary: Combined with numerical analytic continuation techniques, quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) methods enable the extraction of real-frequency dynamical properties from imaginary-time correlation functions. However, the efficient computation of imaginary-time correlation functions by QMC simulations can (depending on the particular model used) be challenging, particularly for operators that are off-diagonal in the computational basis. In this work, we present an efficient and general algorithm within the stochastic series expansion (SSE) framework for evaluating imaginary-time correlation functions of both diagonal and off-diagonal operators. The algorithm builds on a discrete imaginary-time slicing of the SSE operator string, which provides correlation functions on a grid of well-defined imaginary-time points with no discretization error. For off-diagonal operators, we derive estimators that integrate directly into the existing SSE directed-loop or cluster updating schemes, introducing only minimal computational overhead. We benchmark the method on the one-dimensional transverse-field Ising model (sampling with cluster updates) and XXZ spin chain (using directed-loop sampling), demonstrating excellent agreement (with only statistical errors) with exact diagonalization of small systems. We also study larger systems to demonstrate efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文在随机级数展开（SSE）框架内提出了一种高效且通用的算法，用于计算对角和非对角算符的虚时关联函数。该算法通过对SSE算符串进行离散虚时切片，在无离散误差的虚时网格点上提供关联函数；对于非对角算符，推导出可直接集成到现有directed-loop或cluster更新方案中的估计量。通过一维横向场Ising模型和XXZ自旋链进行基准测试，结果与精确对角化高度一致。
AI.motivation: 量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）方法结合数值解析延拓技术可以从虚时关联函数中提取实频动力学性质，但高效计算虚时关联函数在处理非对角算符（相对于计算基）时往往具有挑战性，因此需要一种通用的高效算法来同时处理对角和非对角算符的虚时关联函数计算。
AI.method: 在SSE框架内，通过对算符串进行离散虚时切片，在定义的虚时网格点上计算关联函数且无离散误差；针对非对角算符，推导了可集成到现有SSE directed-loop或cluster更新方案中的估计量，仅引入极小的额外计算开销。
AI.result: 在一维横向场Ising模型（使用cluster更新）和XXZ自旋链（使用directed-loop采样）上进行基准测试，结果与小型系统的精确对角化仅有统计误差级别的一致性；同时研究了更大系统以展示算法的效率。
AI.conclusion: 该算法为SSE框架内计算对角和非对角算符的虚时关联函数提供了一种通用、高效且无系统离散误差的解决方案，具有良好的可扩展性和实用性。

title: Time-ordered free energy in correlated quantum systems: An agentic approach
summary: How much work can an agent extract from a temporal sequence of quantum states when it can only operate online under causal constraints---deciding which energy extraction method to use with knowledge of what it has observed before? Here, we study this problem in the context of quantum state sequences that are potentially non-Markovian---generated by some underlying hidden Markov machine that the agent cannot observe. Using techniques from dynamic programming and computational mechanics, we present a method to identify the provably optimal agent strategy, with time complexity that scales linearly with sequence length. This motivates us to introduce the maximum work such agents can extract---time-ordered free energy(TOFE)---as a fundamental measure of free energy available in a temporally correlated quantum system subject to causal considerations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究智能体从时序量子态序列中提取功的最优策略问题，该序列可能非马尔可夫且由不可观测的隐马尔可夫机器生成。作者结合动态规划与计算力学方法，提出了识别可证明最优智能体策略的方法，时间复杂度随序列长度线性增长，并引入了"时间有序自由能"(TOFE)作为因果约束下时域相关量子系统中可用自由能的基本度量。
AI.motivation: 智能体在因果约束下只能在线操作——基于过去观测信息决定当前的能量提取策略。如何在这种受限条件下从（可能非马尔可夫的）量子态序列中提取最大功是一个开放问题，需要一个既能识别最优策略又能量化可提取自由能的理论框架。
AI.method: 利用动态规划与计算力学的技术，处理由隐马尔可夫机器生成的非马尔可夫量子态序列。智能体在线决策，依据历史观测选择能量提取方式，算法的时间复杂度与序列长度呈线性关系。
AI.result: 提出了一种可证明最优的智能体策略识别方法，时间复杂度为线性；并在此基础上引入时间有序自由能(TOFE)作为该问题场景下的功提取上限，即因果约束下时域相关量子系统可提取自由能的基本度量。
AI.conclusion: TOFE为因果受限条件下从时间相关的量子系统中提取自由能提供了理论基础，将计算力学、动态规划与量子热力学相结合，为理解"量子记忆"在能量提取中的价值提供了新的角度。

title: Parity Floors in Quantum Denoisers: A Closed-Form Benchmark for Fixed-Map Denoising Networks
summary: Fixed quantum feature maps are increasingly inserted into diffusion denoisers, but standard image benchmarks do not reveal which structural constraint limits them. We introduce CoupledPhaseTexture, a torus-diffusion benchmark with analytic heat-kernel noising that separates parity, within-sector approximation, and sample-complexity limitations. For the depth-1 RY+CNOT+Pauli-Z family we prove a containment-free parity floor: all reachable features are even functions of the encoded angles while the sine components of the Bayes denoiser are odd, so the excess risk splits exactly into an inaccessible odd part and a within-sector residual. The first term is an irreducible, noise-scale-resolved lower bound holding for every even feature class, with no containment, linearity, or closedness assumption on the feature class. The obstruction is a property of the noise-conditioned denoising target rather than static representability: the floor is re-derived at each noise scale because the target's parity content changes with noise. The measured excess is dominated by the parity proxy on two distinct priors. Higher-order Z readouts improve the even sector, but entanglement does not lower the floor and re-uploading does not reliably close it. Classical controls confirm the deficit is parity rather than quantumness: a cosine-only bank is floored similarly, while adding the sine sector matches the reference. Among tested constructions, odd readouts and a noise-coupled encoder do not match the sine-carrying classical bank. These results motivate nonclassical data access or feature classes without efficient classical surrogates; they do not establish either as sufficient for quantum advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoupledPhaseTexture基准测试，用于分离量子扩散去噪器中固定量子特征映射的三种结构性限制（奇偶性、扇区内近似、样本复杂度）。证明了RY+CNOT+Pauli-Z深度1特征族存在不可约的奇偶性下限，该下限源于噪声条件下的去噪目标本身而非静态可表示性，且纠缠无法消除、重上传无法可靠闭合该下限。
AI.motivation: 固定的量子特征映射被越来越多地插入扩散去噪器中，但标准图像基准无法揭示究竟是哪种结构约束限制了它们的表现。需要一种能够解耦不同限制来源的分析基准，以准确诊断量子特征映射的性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 引入CoupledPhaseTexture，一个环形扩散基准，使用解析热核噪声，可分离奇偶性、扇区内近似和样本复杂度三种限制。对深度1的RY+CNOT+Pauli-Z特征族，通过数学证明建立包含自由的奇偶性下限，并将超额风险精确分解为不可达的奇部与扇区内残差两部分。
AI.result: 证明奇偶性下限对每个偶特征类均成立且不可约，不依赖包含性、线性或封闭性假设。实测超额风险由奇偶性代理主导；高阶Z读出可改善偶数扇区，但纠缠降低不了下限，重上传无法可靠闭合间隙。经典对照实验确认该缺陷源于奇偶性而非量子性：仅余弦库同样受限，加入正弦扇区后达到参考水平。
AI.conclusion: 阻碍源于噪声调节去噪目标的奇偶性结构，而非静态可表示性，且该下限在每个噪声尺度上重新推导。结果提示需要非经典数据访问或无高效经典替代的特征类，但并未证明这些足以实现量子优势。

title: When Can You Trust Offline Evaluation of Equal-Cost Top-k Allocation? A Controlled, Reproducible Benchmark and Practitioner's Guide
summary: Organizations decide whom to treat under a budget and want to know what a targeting rule would have earned before deploying it. Off-policy evaluation promises this from logged data, but the deployable rule is a deterministic top-k policy: it removes all averaging over actions, so weak overlap hits the estimate directly. We benchmark six estimators across five datasets and two known-effect sweeps, and validate the mechanisms against a non-simulated paired reference. First, weak overlap is governed by logger-target action alignment, not by logging sharpness alone: what governs support is the logger's probability of the target's actions. Sharpening a logger built from the target's own score barely moves overlap over the tested range; action-level disagreement collapses it. Effective sample size ranks this risk across logging environments, but is weak at ranking candidates within the single log a practitioner holds, and its cut point does not transfer. Second, the optimizer's curse is not fixed by cross-fitting the outcome nuisance. When the rule is fit on the data used to evaluate it, cross-fitting the nuisance alone leaves the reuse bias in place and makes it worse. Honest policy-level splitting avoids the reuse by targeting the learning procedure's value -- a change of estimand, not a de-biasing of the full-sample policy. Third, propensity-estimation error is the largest degradation we measure: an out-of-fold estimate hurts IPS more than any other stress we apply, leaves doubly-robust estimation almost unchanged, and can invert the overlap diagnostic itself. Logging is synthesized and propensities floored at 0.02, so every failure occurs with bounded weights; the floor also reduces the two tuned hybrids to their untuned parents, leaving four practically distinct estimators, and all exact-value surfaces are synthetic or semi-synthetic. We release the benchmark; public data only.

AI.tldr: 本文对离线策略评估中的确定性top-k策略进行了系统基准测试。研究了六种估计器在五个数据集上的表现，重点考察了三大威胁：弱重叠（由logger-target动作对齐而非logging锐度决定）、优化者诅咒（交叉拟合无法消除复用偏差，需要诚实的策略级拆分）、倾向性估计误差（对IPS伤害最大，可逆转重叠诊断）。
AI.motivation: 组织需要在预算约束下决定如何分配资源，并希望在实际部署之前知道目标分配规则能带来多少收益。离线策略评估（OPE）可以从日志数据中估计这一点，但可部署的规则是确定性top-k策略——它消除了所有动作平均，使得弱重叠问题直接冲击估计值。现有工作缺乏对这一特定场景下OPE方法的系统性评估。
AI.method: 基准测试六种估计器，跨五个数据集和两组已知效应扫描，并使用非模拟的配对参考验证机制。倾向性分数下限设为0.02以确保权重有界。通过logger-target动作对齐程度来构造不同的重叠条件，系统施加交叉拟合、倾向性估计等压力测试。
AI.result: 三大发现：(1) 弱重叠由logger-target动作对齐主导而非logging锐度；有效样本量能跨环境排序风险，但无法在单一日志内排序候选估计器，其截点不可迁移。(2) 交叉拟合倾向性因子无法修复优化者诅咒，甚至会加重复用偏差；需要诚实的策略级拆分，这改变了估计目标而非对全样本策略去偏。(3) 倾向性估计误差是最大的退化来源：out-of-fold估计对IPS伤害最大，几乎不影响双重稳健估计，甚至可逆转重叠诊断。倾向性下限将两个调参混合方法退化为未调参的父方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了确定性top-k策略OPE的三个关键失败机制，为实践者提供了重叠风险诊断的建议（应关注动作对齐而非logging锐度），并强调了策略级诚实拆分和倾向性估计质量在离线评估中的核心重要性。基准已开源，仅使用公共数据。

title: Symmetry Emergence in Self-Organized Criticality
summary: We describe a mechanism of affine symmetry emergence in the maximal density regime of the prototypical model of self-organized criticality when the inverse square of the mesh of the underlying lattice is much larger than the number of random perturbation points distributed according to a prescribed probability measure supported in the interior of the ambient convex domain. Moreover, an appropriate scaling limit of the toppling function (aka odometer), which counts the number of operations per site, is a solution to a non-linear partial differential equation well known in the context of optimal transport and differential geometry, making it possible to accurately estimate the deviation of the density from its maximal value in any macroscopic window. The mechanism for the affine symmetry emergence is due to the novel empirical fact, supported in addition by inductive arguments that have recently being upgraded to a rigorous proof, that the scaling limit of the toppling function is the unique concave solution of the Monge-Ampère equation with Dirichlet boundary condition on the convex domain with the potential given by the probability measure used above as the infinite-perturbation profile.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自组织临界性原型模型（砂堆模型）在最大密度状态下的仿射对称涌现机制。当底层网格间距平方的倒数远大于随机扰动点数量时，坍缩函数（odometer）的标度极限是满足Dirichlet边界条件的Monge-Ampère方程的唯一凹解，其势由给定概率测度决定，从而可在任意宏观窗口准确估计密度偏差。
AI.motivation: 理解自组织临界性模型中经典砂堆模型在最大密度区域的对称性涌现机制，并建立坍缩函数标度极限与最优传输和微分几何中经典非线性偏微分方程（Monge-Ampère方程）之间的联系，以便在宏观尺度上精确刻画密度偏差。
AI.method: 本文采用分析与组合论证相结合的方法：一方面利用归纳论证（近期已被升级为严格证明）建立关键经验事实；另一方面证明在最大密度状态下，当晶格网格的平方倒数远大于扰动点数时，坍缩函数的标度极限唯一收敛到带Dirichlet边界的Monge-Ampère方程的解，其中势函数即所给概率测度。
AI.result: 证明了仿射对称涌现的机制：在该参数区域中，坍缩函数的标度极限是Monge-Ampère方程在凸域上满足Dirichlet边界条件的唯一凹解，从而能够精确估计任意宏观窗口内密度偏离最大值的误差界。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将自组织临界性模型与最优输运理论及微分几何联系起来，为最大密度区域中仿射对称性的涌现提供了严格的数学基础，并为进一步研究砂堆模型中相关临界现象提供了可计算的分析框架。

title: Resonant Far-Infrared Spectroscopy of Flat-Band Fermions in Magic Angle Graphene
comment: 52 pages in total, incluidng 25 pages on main text, figures and extended figures + tables, and 30 pages on theory supplementary information
summary: Moiré engineering in twisted two-dimensional (2D) materials radically alters low-energy bands, interactions and topological quantum states. Despite extensive studies, optical spectroscopy of interacting moiré bands in the characteristic far-infrared (FIR) regime has remained largely unexplored due to extreme experimental challenges. Using a newly developed millikelvin FIR platform, we report the observation of the long-sought-after characteristic FIR resonances of flat-band electrons in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG). We observe highly tunable spectroscopic signatures of interacting light and heavy fermions that constitute the flat bands in MATBG. Using the topological heavy-fermion model (THF), we show that itinerant topological electrons act as an "antenna" that couples strongly to the optical field, with resonant frequencies renormalized by the hybridization with localized heavy electrons. We establish optical selection rules of MATBG which uncovers the key symmetry governing light-heavy fermion hybridization. At charge neutrality, we observe pronounced resonances at energies below the on-site Coulomb energy, implying the emergence of new many-body modes. Our experiments and modeling provide a fundamental understanding of light-matter interactions in MATBG and enable resonant optical spectroscopy of moiré bands down to millikelvin temperatures.

AI.tldr: 本文利用新开发的毫开尔文远红外（FIR）光谱平台，在魔角扭曲双层石墨烯（MATBG）中首次观测到平带电子的特征远红外共振，并通过拓扑重费米子模型揭示了巡游拓扑电子作为"天线"与局域重电子杂化耦合的物理机制，确立了光-重费米子杂化的光学选择定则。
AI.motivation: 虽然莫尔工程在扭曲二维材料中可根本改变低能带、相互作用和拓扑量子态，但受极端实验挑战限制，特征远红外波段下相互作用莫尔带的光谱研究长期处于空白，亟需在该波段实现对MATBG平带电子的直接光学探测与理解。
AI.method: 开发毫开尔文温度的远红外（FIR）光学光谱测量平台；在MATBG中测量平带电子的FIR特征共振；结合拓扑重费米子模型（THF）进行理论建模，分析巡游拓扑电子与局域重电子的杂化耦合对光学响应的贡献，并推导光学选择定则。
AI.result: 观测到高度可调谐的轻/重费米子相互作用光谱特征；证明巡游拓扑电子充当"天线"强烈耦合光场，共振频率受与局域重电子杂化重整化；确立了揭示光-重费米子杂化关键对称性的光学选择定则；在电荷中性点观察到低于局域库仑能的显著共振，表明新的多体模式涌现。
AI.conclusion: 实验与理论建模提供了对MATBG中光-物质相互作用的基础理解，实现了毫开尔文温度下莫尔带的共振光学光谱学，为研究莫尔平带中的多体物理开辟了新途径。

title: Emergence of moiré magnetic chaos in twisted bilayer CrI3
summary: The study of magnetic chaos has traditionally focused on macroscopic variables under external driving. Here we demonstrate a new type of magnetic chaos, termed moiré magnetic chaos, associated with mesoscopic magnetic domain variables in twisted bilayer CrI3 without external driving. The domains are stabilized by a characteristic interlayer exchange frustration, which supplies the multiple dynamical degrees of freedom required for autonomous chaos. Through micromagnetic simulations, we show that relaxation toward moiré magnetic textures is extremely sensitive to minute local perturbations of the initial state, characterized by substantial finite-time Lyapunov exponents and a final-state sensitivity that persists over five decades of perturbation amplitude. Statistical analysis further reveals that the resulting domain configurations are stochastic and pairwise uncorrelated. Our results identify a form of microscopic, undriven chaos in twisted magnets that extends nonlinear magnetism beyond the conventional driven regime.

AI.tldr: 本文在扭曲双层CrI3中发现了一种无需外部驱动的全新磁性混沌类型——莫尔磁性混沌（moiré magnetic chaos）。该混沌源于层间交换阻挫稳定化的介观磁性畴，通过微磁模拟展示了弛豫过程对初始态微小扰动的极端敏感性，并揭示了最终态的高度随机性与无关联性。
AI.motivation: 传统磁性混沌研究局限于外加驱动力下的宏观变量，而自然界中是否存在无需外部驱动、源于材料内部本征机制的微观磁性混沌尚属空白。作者旨在探索并确立一种自主的、无驱动的磁性混沌新范式，以拓展非线性磁学的研究边界。
AI.method: 采用微磁模拟方法，针对扭曲双层CrI3体系进行研究。通过引入层间交换阻挫来稳定介观磁性畴并赋予系统多动力学自由度，进而考察系统在弛豫过程中对初始态微小扰动（跨越五个数量级振幅）的敏感性，计算有限时间李雅普诺夫指数，并进行统计相关分析来刻画最终畴结构的随机性。
AI.result: 揭示了弛豫动力学对初始态的极小扰动具有极端敏感性，有限时间李雅普诺夫指数显著，最终态敏感性在五个数量级扰动振幅范围内持续存在；统计结果表明所得畴构型是随机的且两两不相关。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次证实了扭曲磁性材料中存在一种微观、无驱动的自主混沌，将非线性磁学从传统的受驱动范畴扩展至本征自主混沌的新领域，为磁性混沌研究提供了全新的物理平台。

title: Levitation of a YIG sphere using a magnetic Paul trap - towards strongly coupled quantum magno-mechanics
summary: Magnetic levitation offer passive levitation of massive objects for use in advanced inertia sensors, for the generation of non-classical macroscopic motional states, and towards the table-top testing of low energy gravity with quantum mechanics. Magnons, a quanta of spin wave, couple to many physical quantities and strongly to electromagnetic fields, even at room temperature. In this work we demonstrate the stable trapping of a small YIG sphere using a magnetic Paul trap. We present a classical stability analysis of a magnetic Paul trap and show the stability diagram for all mechanical degrees of freedom. We show that coupling between librational and translational modes changes the stability region. We experimentally levitate the soft magnet yttrium iron garnet at room temperature obtaining Q-factors of $\sim25$ and secular frequencies $15.8$ Hz and $17.2$ Hz. We provide numerical estimates of the achievable enhanced coupling between the center-of-mass motion and excited magnon modes, with a cooperativity above unity despite strong mechanical damping, indicating potential applications in quantum information processing, quantum interconnects and quantum memories.

AI.tldr: 该论文展示了利用磁性Paul阱在室温下稳定悬浮一个小型钇铁石榴石（YIG）球体，实现了约25的Q因子和15.8 Hz、17.2 Hz的质点频率，并通过数值估算表明质点运动与激发磁子模式之间可实现协同度大于1的增强耦合，具有量子信息处理的潜在应用。
AI.motivation: 磁悬浮可用于先进惯性传感器、生成非经典宏观运动态以及桌面级低能引力与量子力学测试。磁子作为自旋波量子，在室温下也能与电磁场强耦合，因此将磁悬浮与磁子系统结合具有重要的物理意义和应用前景。
AI.method: 采用磁性Paul阱对软磁材料YIG小球进行稳定俘获；进行了经典稳定性分析并给出所有机械自由度的稳定性图；分析了摆动（librational）模式与平动模式之间的耦合对稳定区域的影响；在室温下实验悬浮YIG球，测量其Q因子和质点频率；通过数值模拟估算质点运动与磁子模式的耦合能力，计算协同度（cooperativity）。
AI.result: 成功在室温下稳定悬浮YIG球，测得Q因子约为25，质点频率为15.8 Hz和17.2 Hz。稳定性分析表明摆动与平动模式的耦合改变了稳定区域。数值估算显示尽管存在强机械阻尼，质点运动与磁子模式之间的协同度仍可超过1。
AI.conclusion: 球形磁悬浮系统与磁子模式的有效耦合可突破机械阻尼限制实现协同度大于1，表明该系统在量子信息处理、量子互连和量子存储中具有潜在应用价值。

title: Supervised Mixed-Frequency Learning for Macro-Financial Forecasting When Factors are Weak
summary: Factor-MIDAS regressions forecast a low-frequency target by extracting common factors from a large panel of high-frequency predictors via principal component analysis (PCA). While PCA mitigates the curse of dimensionality, it relies on factor pervasiveness, an assumption often violated when factors are weak, as is common in macro-financial forecasting. We propose SsPCA-MIDAS, which integrates supervised scaled PCA (SsPCA) into the mixed-data sampling framework. We establish consistency and asymptotic normality under weak factors, permitting inference on the prediction target. Simulations show that SsPCA-MIDAS outperforms competing PCA-based and supervised methods, especially when weak factors are prevalent. Applying machine-learning techniques such as boosting to the cleaner factors it extracts yields further gains. An extensive application to U.S. macro-financial forecasting shows that SsPCA-MIDAS selects economically meaningful predictors and improves forecasts of GDP, inflation, unemployment, asset prices, and volatility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SsPCA-MIDAS方法，将监督式缩放主成分分析（SsPCA）集成到混合数据采样（MIDAS）回归框架中，用于从高维高频预测变量中提取弱因子以预测低频宏观金融目标，解决了传统PCA-MIDAS在弱因子假设下失效的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统Factor-MIDAS回归依赖PCA提取共同因子来缓解维度灾难，但PCA假设因子具有普及性（pervasiveness），这一假设在宏观金融预测中常见的弱因子情形下经常被违背，导致预测失效。
AI.method: 将监督式缩放PCA（SsPCA）嵌入MIDAS框架中，在PCA前结合目标变量信息对预测变量进行缩放，从而在弱因子条件下仍能有效提取因子；并建立了弱因子下因子估计的相合性与渐近正态性理论。
AI.result: 模拟实验表明SsPCA-MIDAS在弱因子普遍存在时优于其他基于PCA和监督式的对比方法；将机器学习技术（如boosting）应用于提取的更干净因子可进一步改善预测；美国宏观金融实证表明该方法能选择有经济意义的预测变量并改善GDP、通胀、失业率、资产价格和波动率的预测。
AI.conclusion: SsPCA-MIDAS为弱因子场景下的混合频率预测提供了理论保证和实证优势，是一种稳健且有效的宏观金融预测方法。

title: Thermal Hall tomography of chiral superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene
summary: A chiral superconductor carries chiral Majorana modes along its edges, and a single integer, the Bogoliubov--de Gennes Chern number, counts them. Thirty years of candidate materials have not yielded a measurement of that integer, because the magnetic signatures usually invoked are not topologically protected. Rhombohedral graphene makes the question both urgent and answerable: magnetic imaging resolves rewritable time-reversal-breaking domains inside the superconducting phase, while quantum oscillations reveal a normal state too intricate to reconstruct pocket by pocket. We show that the low-temperature thermal Hall conductance returns the integer directly, with no such reconstruction. For band-projected pairing it equals the pairing-vortex winding enclosed by the occupied regions of momentum space. Splitting the intravalley Hamiltonian into symmetric and antisymmetric parts isolates the trigonal warping and finite Cooper pair momentum of the real material: the antisymmetric part is topologically inert, direct Chern calculations across $525$ parameter points show the invariant preserved, and one inequality marks where a Bogoliubov Fermi surface removes quantization. The plateau $κ_{xy}/T=(π^2k_B^2/6h)\,C_{\rm BdG}$ then reads out the integer, its sign reverses with the imaged domain, a written domain wall should carry $2|C_{\rm BdG}|$ Majorana channels, and the thermometry required already resolves single thermal quanta in encapsulated graphene at millikelvin temperatures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在菱面体石墨烯（rhombohedral graphene）等手性超导体中，低温热霍尔电导能直接读出Bogoliubov–de Gennes (BdG) Chern数这一拓扑整数，无需重建复杂的正常态费米面。通过对称/反对称哈密顿量分解论证了反对称部分拓扑惰性，并用525个参数点的直接Chern计算验证不变量被保持，指出了Bogoliubov费米面破坏量子化的条件判据。
AI.motivation: 手性超导体的边缘携带手性Majorana模式，其数量由单一的整数量子数——BdG Chern数——决定。但三十年来候选材料均未能测量该整数，因为通常引用的磁学特征并不受拓扑保护。菱面体石墨烯使该问题既紧迫又可回答：磁成像虽能分辨超导相内可重写的破缺时间反演对称的畴，但量子振荡揭示的正常态过于复杂，无法逐pocket重构。因此需要一种能直接返回该整数的可测量。
AI.method: 作者展示了低温热霍尔电导κ_xy/T=(π²k_B²/6h)C_BdG可直接返回Chern数整数。对带投影配对情形，该值等于被占据动量区域所包围的配对涡旋缠绕数。算法上，将带内(valley内)哈密顿量分解为对称与反对称两部分，以隔离真实材料中的三角翘曲（trigonal warping）和有限Cooper对动量；证明反对称部分拓扑惰性，并通过525个参数点的直接Chern数计算验证不变量被保持；确定一个不等式标记Bogoliubov费米面何时移除量子化。
AI.result: 热霍尔电导平台直接读出Chern数整数，其符号随成像畴反转；写入的畴壁应携带2|C_BdG|条Majorana通道。所需的热测量技术在毫开尔文温度下已能分辨封装的石墨烯中的单热量子，使该方案在实验上可行。
AI.conclusion: 在菱面体石墨烯这一具体材料平台上，热霍尔电导为测量BdG Chern数这一拓扑整数提供了直接、无需重构正常态费米面的实验途径，弥补了三十年来手性超导体拓扑量子数无法被测量这一根本性空白，并对实验实现给出了明确可操作的预测。

title: Giant exciton effects and magneto-excitonic coupling in V4S9X4 2D magnetic semiconductors
summary: Room-temperature spin-optoelectronic devices require a combination of robust ferromagnetism and giant exciton binding, a pairing mutually exclusive in conventional semiconductors due to magnetic localization that screens excitons. Cluster-assembled V4S9X4 (X = F, Cl, Br and I) monolayers overcome this bottleneck via a hierarchical design, that is, intra-cluster localized states host both local magnetic moments and strong electron-hole interactions, while inter-cluster coupling mediates long-range ferromagnetism. Remarkably, these two-dimensional semiconductors exhibit intrinsic ferromagnetism with Curie temperature up to 507.6 K. As a prototype, V4S9Br4 monolayer possesses a giant exciton binding energy of 1.85 eV. Its lowest exciton is a dark state (DI) with a radiative lifetime of 1.20 ns, whereas the first bright exciton (BI) exhibits an ultrafast radiative decay of 86.87 ps. This stark lifetime contrast enables simultaneous ultrafast optical response and long-lived spin information storage. Most notably, switching between ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic order allows for wide-range tuning of exciton lifetime, with the giant binding energy remaining nearly intact. Our findings establish cluster assembly as a powerful paradigm for designing next-generation spin-photonic and quantum information devices operating at room temperature.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种通过团簇组装设计V4S9X4（X=F, Cl, Br, I）单层材料的方法，成功在同一材料中同时实现室温铁磁性（居里温度高达507.6 K）和巨大的激子束缚能（如V4S9Br4为1.85 eV），突破了传统半导体中铁磁性与激子束缚能相互排斥的瓶颈。该材料的最低声激子为暗态（寿命1.20 ns），第一亮激子具有超快辐射衰减（86.87 ps），且可通过铁磁-反铁磁转变大幅调控激子寿命而几乎不影响巨大束缚能，为室温自旋光子学和量子信息器件提供了新范式。
AI.motivation: 室温自旋光电子器件需要同时具备稳健的铁磁性和巨大的激子束缚能，但两者在传统半导体中相互排斥（磁局域化会屏蔽激子）。这一根本性矛盾限制了该类器件的实现，因此亟需寻找能打破这一瓶颈的新型材料设计策略。
AI.method: 采用层级团簇组装设计策略：团簇内局域态同时承载局域磁矩和强电子-空穴相互作用，团簇间耦合媒介长程铁磁有序。通过第一性原理计算等方法系统研究了V4S9X4（X=F, Cl, Br, I）单层材料的铁磁性、激子性质及磁序对激子寿命的调控效应。
AI.result: V4S9X4单层为本征铁磁半导体，居里温度最高达507.6 K；V4S9Br4的激子束缚能为1.85 eV，暗激子寿命1.20 ns，亮激子辐射寿命仅86.87 ps；铁磁-反铁磁转变可在大范围内调控激子寿命，同时巨大束缚能几乎保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 团簇组装被确立为设计下一代室温自旋光子与量子信息器件的强大新范式，能够同时实现在传统材料中不可兼得的室温铁磁性、巨大激子束缚能以及可调控的激子动力学性质。

title: A Minimum-Cardinality Genuinely Unextendible Product Basis in Three Qutrits
summary: It has remained an open question whether a genuinely unextendible product basis (GUPB) exists. We resolve this problem by constructing an explicit three-qutrit GUPB of cardinality fourteen in the smallest tripartite Hilbert space in which a GUPB can exist. Together with the nonexistence of three-qutrit GUPBs of cardinality less than fourteen, our construction proves that fourteen is the minimum cardinality. A padding procedure further extends the construction to all tripartite systems whose local dimensions are at least three. As applications, the normalized projector onto the thirteen-dimensional orthogonal complement of the three-qutrit GUPB is positive under partial transposition and bound entangled across every bipartition, while the GUPB exhibits strong quantum nonlocality without entanglement.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基数为14的三-qutrit广义不可扩展乘积基（GUPB），解决了GUPB是否存在这一开放问题，并通过填充程序将其扩展到所有局部维度至少为3的三方系统。该GUPB的正交补投影算子在每个二分下都是正部分转置且有界纠缠的，同时展现出无纠缠的强量子非局域性。
AI.motivation: 是否存在真正意义上的不可扩展乘积基（GUPB）一直是一个开放性问题，该问题的解决对于理解量子纠缠、量子非局域性以及量子信息处理中的资源理论具有重要意义。
AI.method: 作者在最小的三方希尔伯特空间（三-qutrit系统）中显式构造了一个基数为14的GUPB，并通过填充程序（padding procedure）将构造推广到所有局部维度至少为3的三方系统。
AI.result: 证明了三维三方系统中GUPB的最小基数为14，其正交补空间的归一化投影算子在每个二分下均为正部分转置且有界纠缠态，且该GUPB展现出无纠缠的强量子非局域性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作解决了GUPB存在性的开放问题，建立了最小基数14的严格下界，并将构造扩展到所有局部维度≥3的三方系统，同时揭示了GUPB在纠缠检测和非局域性研究中的重要应用价值。

title: When Explanations Betray Backdoors: Black-Box Auditing for Language Model Classifiers
summary: Language model classifiers with explanations are used for moderation, routing, topic triage, and low-resource annotation. We study black-box auditing when the defender has only clean calibration data without trigger information but can ask the classifier for a label plus a short rationale or quoted evidence. We introduce Groundedness Drift, a lightweight score measuring whether the answer summary remains grounded in the input. Across two 7B backbones, five datasets, and four common non-adaptive OpenBackdoor-style attack families, Groundedness Drift achieves higher AUROC and lower residual target ASR than every compared detector in all cases at a nominal 5\% clean-FPR budget. We then evaluate Unsupported Groundedness, a multi-probe escalation for explanation-camouflage stress cases. Unsupported Groundedness improves signals but does not close the adaptive gap.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型分类器在附带解释（rationale/引证证据）场景下的黑盒审计问题。提出Groundedness Drift指标，衡量答案摘要是否仍锚定于输入文本，在7B规模的两个骨干模型、五个数据集和四种非自适应OpenBackdoor攻击下，以5%干净误报率为预算时，AUROC和残余目标ASR均优于所有对比检测器。进一步提出Unsupported Groundedness多探针升级方案应对解释伪装压力测试，虽能改善信号但无法完全消除自适应攻击差距。
AI.motivation: 现有的带解释的分类器被广泛用于内容审核、路由、主题分类和低资源标注等场景，但攻击者可利用后门注入并生成伪装性解释来逃避检测。防御方仅有干净校准数据、缺少触发信息，因此需要一种仅利用分类器输出（标签+简短解释/引证）即可高效识别被投毒模型的黑盒审计方法。
AI.method: 提出Groundedness Drift分数，一种轻量级度量，检测模型输出摘要是否仍与输入保持"锚定性"；并设计Unsupported Groundedness作为多探针升级方案，针对解释伪装（explanation-camouflage）的高压场景，通过多重探测信号增强检测能力。
AI.result: 在两个7B骨干模型、五个数据集、四种常见非自适应OpenBackdoor攻击家族上，Groundedness Drift在5%干净FPR预算下，所有实验场景的AUROC和残余目标ASR均优于所有对比检测器。Unsupported Groundedness进一步改善检测信号，但未能完全弥合自适应攻击下的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: Groundedness Drift是有效的轻量级黑盒后门审计指标，尤其适用于带解释的LM分类器场景；但在面对自适应（解释伪装式）攻击时仍存在检测鲁棒性的瓶颈，值得未来在更强对抗条件下进一步探索。

title: Observation of Time-Domain Braiding of Non-Abelian Anyons at $ν= 5/2$ State
summary: Unlike elementary particles, which obey either bosonic or fermionic exchange statistics, certain quasiparticles, known as anyons, are predicted to exhibit Abelian or non-Abelian braiding statistics. While braiding Abelian anyons modifies the wavefunction by a 'statistical phase', braiding non-Abelian anyons implements a unitary transformation of the state within a degenerate subspace of states. Experimental evidence of non-Abelian braiding has thus far remained elusive. Here, we report a 'time-domain braiding' signature of non-Abelian anyons in the $ν= 5/2$ fractional quantum Hall state, by extending our previously demonstrated approach with Abelian anyons at $ν= 1/3$. Our approach is based on measurements of the current fluctuations arising from weak partitioning of a highly dilute one-dimensional edge mode. We independently probe the partition noise of the downstream charged mode and also that of the upstream neutral mode. These independent measurements agree with our theoretical predictions for 'time-domain braiding' of the downstream Abelian and the upstream non-Abelian anyons, respectively, in the 'particle-hole Pfaffian' topological order. Together, these results provide evidence for the presence of non-Abelian anyons.

AI.tldr: 该论文报告了在ν=5/2分数量子霍尔态中首次观测到非阿贝尔任意子的"时域编织"签名。通过在弱分割的高稀释一维边缘模式上独立测量下游带电模式和上游中性模式的电流涨落（散粒噪声），实验结果与"粒子-空穴Pfaffian"拓扑序中非阿贝尔任意子的理论预测一致，为非阿贝尔任意子的存在提供了实验证据。
AI.motivation: 非阿贝尔编织统计是拓扑量子计算的基础，但此前一直缺乏实验证据。与阿贝尔任意子仅改变波函数的统计相位不同，非阿贝尔任意子的编织可实现简并子空间内的酉变换，其验证对未来拓扑量子计算具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用"时域编织"方法，将此前在ν=1/3态中验证阿贝尔任意子的方法推广至ν=5/2态。通过对高度稀释的一维边缘模式进行弱分割，独立测量下游带电模式的散粒噪声和上游中性模式的散粒噪声，分别探测阿贝尔和非阿贝尔任意子的编织过程。
AI.result: 下游带电模式与上游中性模式的独立噪声测量结果均与"粒子-空穴Pfaffian"拓扑序中关于下游阿贝尔任意子和上游非阿贝尔任意子"时域编织"的理论预测定量吻合。
AI.conclusion: 独立测量的实验结果与理论预测的一致性，为ν=5/2分数量子霍尔态中存在非阿贝尔任意子提供了证据，这是该领域长期追求的里程碑式结果。

title: Thermal transport in crystals: from the quantum Dyson equation to mesoscopic phonon hydrodynamics
summary: Thermal transport in dielectric, non-magnetic crystals is mediated by quantized lattice vibrations, which drift and interact when driven out of equilibrium by a temperature gradient. This phenomenon can be described at multiple theoretical levels, ranging from fully quantum descriptions to semiclassical and mesoscopic continuum approaches. This review rigorously discusses the theoretical steps and approximations connecting these levels, bridging quantum phonon Dyson and Kadanoff-Baym equations and semiclassical Boltzmann transport formalism, and discussing the coarse-graining procedures that yield mesoscopic viscous heat equations for non-diffusive, hydrodynamic heat transport in devices. We show how the Guyer-Krumhansl and dual-phase-lag equations emerge as special linear-isotropic-band and inviscid limits of the viscous heat equations, respectively; most importantly, we demonstrate that these equations predict not only Poiseuille flow and second sound, but also more exotic effects such as negative thermal resistance, steady-state thermal backflow and vortices. We highlight how combining these frameworks with first-principles simulations connects microscopic phonon physics to observable non-diffusive heat-transport phenomena and guides their detection, amplification, and control. We recast the viscous heat equations in terms of Helmholtz and biharmonic equations solved analytically, and use this to discuss similarities and differences between the macroscopic behavior of the phonon fluid and other hydrodynamic systems, such as classical and electron fluids, focusing on compressibility, vorticity, and their influence on phonon hydrodynamics. We conclude with a roadmap to generalize the tools used to describe phonon hydrodynamics to other quasiparticles, motivating future advances in collective quantum transport phenomena in solids.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评述了介电非磁性晶体中热输运的多尺度理论框架，从量子声子Dyson和Kadanoff-Baym方程出发，经半经典玻尔兹曼输运形式，粗粒化到介观粘性热方程，揭示了Guyer-Krumhansl、双相滞后方程作为其特殊极限的涌现机制，并展示了这些方程对声子流体中Poiseuille流、第二声、负热阻、稳态热回流及涡旋等非扩散热输运现象的预测能力，最后给出了将这些工具推广到其他准粒子的路线图。
AI.motivation: 尽管声子热输运可在量子、半经典和介观连续介质等多个理论层面描述，但这些层面之间的严格理论联系与近似假设尚未被系统梳理，且非扩散热输运（如声子流体动力学）中的奇异现象（负热阻、热回流、涡旋）需要统一的框架进行预测与解释，以便将微观声子物理与宏观可观测现象相连接。
AI.method: 本文采用理论评述方法：(1) 从量子声子Dyson方程和Kadanoff-Baym方程出发，通过严格的近似步骤推导半经典玻尔兹曼输运方程；(2) 通过粗粒化过程建立介观粘性热方程；(3) 证明Guyer-Krumhansl方程（线性各向同性带极限）和双相滞后方程（无粘极限）是粘性热方程的特殊情形；(4) 将粘性热方程重写为Helmholtz方程和双调和方程以获得解析解；(5) 结合第一性原理模拟将微观声子物理与宏观非扩散热输运现象关联；(6) 与经典流体和电子流体的水动力学行为进行类比分析。
AI.result: 该评述严格建立了量子、半经典和介观多尺度理论之间的桥梁，证明粘性热方程在特定极限下可退化为Guyer-Krumhansl和双相滞后方程；系统展示了这些方程能预测Poiseuille流、第二声、负热阻、稳态热回流和涡旋等非扩散现象；并通过对Helmholtz/双调和方程的解析求解，揭示了声子流体与经典流体及电子流体在可压缩性、涡量等方面的相似性和差异性。
AI.conclusion: 统一的多尺度理论框架不仅能描述和预测声子水动力学中的非扩散热输运现象，还能指导其在器件中的检测、放大与控制；未来可将此方法论推广至其他准粒子系统，推动固体中集体量子输运现象的研究发展。

title: A Finite-Window Recovery Hierarchy for Local Quantum Memory
comment: 23 pages, 16 figures; includes Methods and appendices
summary: When quantum information initially stored in a local qubit disappears, it need not be lost: it may have moved into nearby degrees of freedom or become inaccessible to shallow local control. We introduce finite-window recoverability as an operational channel benchmark that separates these possibilities. It compares optimal recovery from the target site, recovery by a bounded-depth decoder on a finite window, and the unrestricted optimum for that window. Its operational component, local variational recovery, uses local state preparation, window-local control, and target-qubit Pauli readout to certify recoverable memory beyond the target and quantify how much of the same-window advantage is accessible to shallow control. In a disordered kicked-Ising Floquet chain, a depth-6 decoder on a five-site window realizes $Q^{\mathrm{opt}}_0<Q^{\mathrm{shallow}}_2<Q^{\mathrm{opt}}_2$ across the crossover regime, with positive certified gain for most disorder realizations and substantial shallow-accessibility fractions. The signal differs from target-site persistence and reconstructed coherent-information increments. Positive radius-2 gain also persists when the task is embedded in longer open chains using an independent tensor-network backend. Guided by this hierarchy, we test a carrier-deletion task in which the original target register is reset after the dynamics. A depth-8 decoder repairs the input from a radius-3 surrounding halo with held-out median $F_{\mathrm{avg}}=0.758$, above the single-qubit classical benchmark $2/3$, and outperforms optimal one-, two-, and three-site halo-subwindow counterfactuals. These results establish finite-window recovery as a local-control benchmark for off-site quantum memory, diagnosing both where local quantum information remains and whether bounded-depth control can refocus it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出有限窗口可恢复性（finite-window recoverability）这一信道基准，用于区分量子信息从局部量子比特消失后是转移到邻近自由度还是仅对浅层局部控制不可达。作者在无序 kicked-Ising Floquet 链中验证了该框架，并展示了有界深度译码器在有限窗口内可认证并恢复离位量子记忆。
AI.motivation: 局域量子比特中的量子信息消失后去向不明：可能转移到邻近自由度，也可能只是对浅层局域控制不可达。现有方法（如目标位持续性和重建相干信息增量）无法区分这两种可能，需要一种能够分离它们的操作性信道基准。
AI.method: 引入有限窗口可恢复性作为信道基准，包含三个比较项：目标位的最优恢复、有界深度译码器在有限窗口内的恢复、以及该窗口的无约束最优恢复。其操作组件为局部变分恢复（local variational recovery），使用局域态制备、窗内局域控制和目标量子比特 Pauli 读出，来认证目标之外的可恢复记忆并量化同一窗口优势中浅层控制可达的比例。所有译码器通过变分优化训练得到。
AI.result: 在无序 kicked-Ising Floquet 链中，深度-6 译码器在五站点窗口上实现 Q_0^opt < Q_2^shallow < Q_2^opt，在交叉区间内大多数无序实现给出正认证增益，且浅层可达占有可观比例。在更长开链中嵌入任务时，正半径-2 增益依然保持。在载体删除（carrier-deletion）任务中，深度-8 译码器从半径-3 环境重构输入，held-out 中位 F_avg=0.758，超过单比特经典基准 2/3，并优于最优的一、二、三站点子窗口反事实。
AI.conclusion: 有限窗口可恢复性确立为离位量子记忆的局域控制基准，能够诊断局域量子信息残留位置，并判定有界深度控制能否将其重新聚焦回复。该框架提供了超越目标位持久性和相干信息增量的更精细操作性判据。

title: Interpretable Causal Discovery via Causal-Effect Constraints
summary: Causal discovery aims to uncover the underlying causal relationships given data generated from a system. The goal, however, is not merely to predict causal edges given data, but also to be able to interpret and explain either observed or hypothesized phenomena, such as a particularly large causal effect.
