We consider this task of conditional causal discovery and cast it as a Bayesian inference problem, in which we target the posterior over causal graphs and parameters conditional on an event such as a causal-effect constraint. Unfortunately, this poses a computational challenge: existing approaches to Bayesian causal discovery struggle when the event has small posterior mass. To address this, we adapt rare-event estimation techniques to perform inference the joint graph-parameter space. Our method gradually drives a particle population toward the constrained region while maintaining samples that approximate the conditional posterior. Empirical evaluation on synthetic graphs validates the accuracy of our approach at small and large scales, and we show in a case study on the Sachs protein dataset how our method can be used to aid scientific exploration by providing pathway-level summaries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种条件因果发现方法，将因果发现问题（如因果效应约束）视为贝叶斯推理问题，并采用罕见事件估计技术（粒子群体逐步逼近约束区域）来高效估计条件后验分布，在合成图和Sachs蛋白质数据上验证了方法的准确性。
AI.motivation: 传统因果发现的目标不仅是预测因果边，还要能解释和说明观测或假设的现象（如大的因果效应）。现有贝叶斯因果发现方法在事件后验质量很小（罕见事件）时计算困难，因此需要一个有效的方法来处理小后验质量条件下的因果推理问题。
AI.method: 将条件因果发现建模为贝叶斯推理问题，目标是获得给定因果效应约束等事件条件下的因果图和参数的后验分布。采用罕见事件估计技术（粒子滤波/粒子群体方法），逐步驱动粒子群体朝向约束区域移动，同时保持样本能够近似条件后验分布。
AI.result: 在合成图上从小规模到大规模均验证了方法的准确性；在Sachs蛋白质数据集上的案例研究展示了该方法可通过通路级摘要辅助科学探索。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够有效处理小后验质量事件下的条件因果发现问题，为科学探索提供了可解释的通路级因果摘要工具。

title: Evaluating Electrostatic Embedding MLIP/MM for Relative Binding Free Energy Calculations
summary: Alchemical relative binding free energy (RBFE) calculations are limited by the fixed-charge approximation of classical force fields. Hybrid machine learning interatomic potential/molecular mechanics (MLIP/MM) schemes correct ligand strain, but under mechanical embedding still describe ligand--environment electrostatics with static point charges. Electrostatic embedding schemes coupling machine-learned charges to the MM environment have been proposed and validated against QM/MM for simple systems, but not tested in a production alchemical workflow. We take the electrostatic embedding scheme of Semelak et al.\ and evaluate it on protein--ligand RBFE. We trained a TensorNet2 model, \texttt{AceFF-2-RESP-1}, on $10^{6}$ conformations from the AceFF dataset, jointly predicting energies, forces and Restrained Electrostatic Potential (RESP) charges. We chose RESP over MBIS for commensurability with the AMBER-family force field it couples to. The predicted charges enter the short-range direct-space part of the particle mesh Ewald sum, with Thole damping to prevent polarization catastrophes during alchemical transformations. We tested the scheme across five targets from the Wang et al.\ benchmark set, fixed in advance by a prior study, with three replicates per edge and matched protocols. Electrostatic embedding improved every accuracy and correlation metric for TYK2 ($ΔΔG$ RMSE $0.86 \rightarrow 0.45$~kcal/mol against GAFF2), but performed comparably to the classical and mechanical-embedding baselines for CDK2, thrombin, p38 and JNK1. Standard single-molecule energy and charge benchmarks were not good predictors of this target-dependent outcome. TYK2 combined good $ΔΔG$ accuracy with the lowest force error on the Schrödinger benchmark, but this pattern did not hold for the other targets.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了一种将静电嵌入方案集成到生产级炼金术相对结合自由能（RBFE）工作流中的方法，使用机器学习原子间势/分子力学（MLIP/MM）杂化方案，其中TensorNet2模型（AceFF-2-RESP-1）联合预测能量、力和RESP电荷。在Wang等人的基准集五个靶标上的测试表明，静电嵌入仅在TYK2上显著改善了所有精度和相关性指标（ΔΔG RMSE从0.86降至0.45 kcal/mol），而在CDK2、凝血酶、p38和JNK1上表现与经典和机械嵌入基线相当。标准单分子能量和电荷基准无法预测这种靶标依赖性的结果。
AI.motivation: 经典力场的固定电荷近似限制了炼金术相对结合自由能（RBFE）计算的精度。虽然MLIP/MM杂化方案通过机械嵌入可以纠正配体应变，但仍以静态点电荷描述配体-环境静电相互作用。已有的静电嵌入方案虽在简单系统中验证过，却未在工业级炼金术工作流中测试。本研究旨在填补这一空白，评估静电嵌入方案在蛋白-配体RBFE中的实际表现。
AI.method: 采用Semelak等人的静电嵌入方案，在AMBER家族力场（GAFF2）框架下，以均匀矩阵乘法（PME）求和的短程直接空间部分引入机器学习预测的RESP电荷，并用Thole阻尼防止炼金术变换中的极化灾难。训练了一个TensorNet2模型AceFF-2-RESP-1，基于AceFF数据集的10^6个构象，联合预测能量、力和RESP电荷（相较MBIS选择RESP以与AMBER力场兼容）。实验在Wang等人基准集中预先固定的五个靶标（TYK2、CDK2、凝血酶、p38、JNK1）上进行，每个边三个重复，采用匹配的协议。
AI.result: 静电嵌入在TYK2上显著改善了所有精度和相关性指标（ΔΔG RMSE从0.86降至0.45 kcal/mol，相对GAFF2），但在CDK2、凝血酶、p38和JNK1上表现与经典和机械嵌入基线相当。标准单分子能量和电荷基准无法作为靶标依赖性结果的可靠预测因子。TYK2兼顾了良好的ΔΔG精度和最低的Schrödinger基准力误差，但该模式未在其他靶标上复现。
AI.conclusion: 静电嵌入方案在炼金术RBFE中的收益是靶标依赖性的，虽然对TYK2效果显著，但对其他靶标未见改进。这表明当前的静电嵌入方案尚不能作为通用改进手段，其应用效果取决于具体蛋白-配体体系。标准单分子基准无法预测工作流级别的性能，提示需要更接近生产条件的评估策略。未来需要进一步研究为何靶标之间存在这种差异，并探索更稳健的嵌入策略。

title: Sector-resolved non-Bloch topology and nonlocal entanglement dynamics in a bond-dissipative Kitaev chain
summary: A core characteristic of dissipative non-Hermitian topology is that the relaxation dynamics tracks the non-Bloch bulk-boundary correspondence, rendering an algebraic decay in the gapless regime and an exponential falloff in the gapped phase, so that local observables directly diagnose the topology. We show that this correspondence breaks down in a dissipative topological superconductor, where the local observables turn blind to the very topology they are expected to decipher. Via a bond-dissipative dimerized Kitaev chain in a third-quantized rapidity-matrix formulation, we find that at zero chemical potential the Majorana rapidity matrix decomposes into two independent non-Hermitian sectors, each with its own generalized Brillouin zone and non-Bloch winding number, thereby revealing a sector-resolved non-Bloch bulk-boundary correspondence. The local density is a cross-sector covariance and relaxes at the sum of the two sector rates, so it remains sector-blind even when one sector is gapless and topological. For balanced gain and loss, the finite-time zero events of the entanglement spectrum under purely periodic-boundary Lindblad evolution recover this hidden edge content sector by sector, serving as a dynamical invariant that returns the open-boundary edge rapidities without physically opening the chain.

AI.tldr: 本文发现在耗散拓扑超导体中，非布洛赫体边对应关系在局域观测量层面失效。通过键耗散二聚化Kitaev链的第三量子化快度矩阵表述，作者发现Majorana快度矩阵在零化学势下分解为两个独立非厄米扇区，各自的密度是跨扇区协变量，因此即使一个扇区处于无间隙拓扑态，局域观测量仍对其"失明"。而在平衡的增益与损耗条件下，纯周期边界Lindblad演化下纠缠谱的有限时间零事件可以逐扇区恢复隐藏的边缘内容，成为一种无需物理开链即可返回开边界边缘快度的动力学不变量。
AI.motivation: 耗散非厄米拓扑的核心特征是弛豫动力学追踪非布洛赫体边对应，局域观测量可直接诊断拓扑。作者希望探究这一对应关系在耗散拓扑超导体中是否依然成立，并寻找能够恢复隐藏拓扑信息的替代探测手段。
AI.method: 采用第三量子化的快度矩阵表述，研究键耗散二聚化Kitaev链。在零化学势下将Majorana快度矩阵分解为两个独立非厄米扇区，分别定义广义布里渊区与非布洛赫绕数。通过解析局域密度的弛豫行为（其为跨扇区协变量，弛豫速率是两个扇区速率之和），并在平衡增益/损耗条件下分析周期边界Lindblad演化纠缠谱的有限时间零事件，以逐扇区恢复边缘信息。
AI.result: 发现零化学势下Majorana快度矩阵分解为两个独立非厄米扇区，各自拥有独立的广义布里渊区和非布洛赫绕数，揭示扇区分辨的非布洛赫体边对应。然而局域密度作为跨扇区协变量，即使某扇区无间隙且拓扑，该观测量仍对拓扑"失明"。但对平衡增益/损耗系统，周期边界下纠缠谱的有限时间零事件能逐扇区恢复隐藏边缘快度，构成无需开链即可提取开边界信息的动力学不变量。
AI.conclusion: 局域观测量在耗散拓扑超导体中对拓扑的失明性表明，非布洛赫体边对应在此类系统中并非总能通过局域密度等简单观测量体现。然而，纠缠谱的有限时间零事件提供了一种新的动力学不变量，能够在不物理打开链的情况下逐扇区恢复边缘拓扑信息，为探测隐藏的拓扑内容提供了可行途径。

title: Training Under Challenge: Executable Certificates and Challenge-Closed Optimality for Neural Networks
comment: 82 pages, 24 figures, 10 tables. Ancillary reproducibility materials included
summary: A flat training curve does not reveal whether a neural network has reached a global optimum, is locally trapped, is representation-limited, or is mismatched to its trainer. We introduce Training Under Challenge, an executable-certificate framework in which predeclared, architecture-valid procedures construct complete alternatives in the same certified class and reevaluate the same objective. Any lower-valued candidate is a replayable witness that lower-bounds the checkpoint's empirical global-optimality gap. Passing a finite suite is only suite-relative; global-gap conclusions require a separately justified coverage mechanism. We define a resource-indexed challenge-power modulus that characterizes the largest gap compatible with passage. For squared loss, current block-decrease operators make coverage checkable and yield uniform and realized-residual bounds. We prove the converse frontier: without coverage, a first-order ReLU trainer can reach infinitely many exact conditional head optima while converging to a non-global point. On a channel-gated ResNet-18 distillation problem with known optimum, eight internal challenges cover all 240 audited output directions, and realized-residual bounds lie within factors of 1.74--3.02 of the true gap. Paired predictive certificates separate decoder under-use from representation insufficiency, while quantized-denoising studies demonstrate diagnosis, repair, and current-state recertification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Training Under Challenge"（挑战训练）框架，一种可执行证书机制，通过预先声明、架构有效的程序构造同类别中的完整替代方案并重新评估同一目标函数，以量化神经网络检查点的全局最优性差距。该框架定义了资源索引的挑战功率模量，证明了无覆盖保证时一阶ReLU训练器可无限趋近精确条件头部最优而非全局点。在通道门控ResNet-18蒸馏问题中，八个内部挑战覆盖全部240个审计输出方向，实现残差界在真实差距的1.74–3.02倍范围内。
AI.motivation: 平坦的训练曲线无法区分神经网络是达到全局最优、局部陷入、表征受限还是与训练器不匹配，现有方法缺乏可执行的证书机制来量化全局最优性差距，因此需要一种能构造替代方案并重新评估目标函数的框架。
AI.method: 提出Training Under Challenge框架：(1) 预先声明架构有效的程序构造同类别完整替代方案；(2) 任何更低值的候选成为可重放见证者，下界检查点的经验全局最优性差距；(3) 定义资源索引的挑战功率模量；(4) 对平方损失利用块下降算子使覆盖可检查，得到一致性和实现残差界；(5) 通过配对预测证书分离解码器未充分利用与表征不足，并在量化去噪研究中展示诊断、修复与重认证。
AI.result: (1) 证明确认无覆盖时，一阶ReLU训练器可达无限多个精确条件头部最优却收敛到非全局点；(2) 在通道门控ResNet-18蒸馏问题中8个内部挑战覆盖全部240个审计输出方向；(3) 实现残差界在真实差距的1.74–3.02倍范围内；(4) 配对预测证书有效区分解码器未充分利用与表征不足；(5) 量化去噪研究验证了诊断、修复和重认证流程。
AI.conclusion: 挑战训练是一个可执行证书框架，能给出可重放的全局最优性差距下界。通过有限测试套件只能获得套件相对结论，全局差距结论需要单独论证的覆盖机制。该框架提供了覆盖可检查性、理论边界（含无覆盖时的不可能性结果）以及实际蒸馏和去噪任务的完整验证，为神经网络训练终点评估提供了可审计的量化手段。

title: Improved Measurement Cost Scaling in the Nonorthogonal Quantum Eigensolver
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Open-source codes in https://github.com/mkangquantum/noqe
summary: Quantum subspace diagonalization methods are promising algorithms for quantum chemistry on near-term quantum computers. These methods can estimate low-lying energies of molecular systems using shallow quantum circuits, at the cost of many circuit repetitions to estimate the projected matrix elements. Errors in these matrix elements can be converted into much larger eigenvalue errors by an ill-conditioned overlap matrix. We study this bottleneck for the nonorthogonal quantum eigensolver (NOQE), which constructs a compact multireference subspace from dressed unrestricted Hartree-Fock states. We prove a finite-shot perturbation bound showing that, after overlap thresholding, the eigenvalue sensitivity is controlled by the condition number of the retained overlap matrix rather than by a worst-case dimension factor. With a scalable thresholding scheme, the upper bound on the per-matrix-element shot count required to reach a target accuracy scales as $\mathcal{O}(M)$, improving on the previously known $\mathcal{O}(M^3)$ bound, where $M$ is the number of reference states. Numerical experiments on hydrogen chains and rings suggest that, in practice, the measurement cost of structured NOQE instances can grow even more slowly than this linear bound.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非正交量子特征求解器（NOQE）中投影矩阵元素误差对特征值估计的影响，证明了一个有限采样扰动界，表明在重叠阈值化后特征值灵敏度由保留重叠矩阵的条件数控制。通过可扩展的阈值化方案，达到目标精度所需的每个矩阵元素采样数上界从O(M³)改进为O(M)。数值实验表明结构化NOQE实例的测量成本可低于线性界。
AI.motivation: 量子子空间对角化方法有望在近期量子计算机上实现量子化学计算，但由于矩阵元素估计误差会被病态重叠矩阵放大为更大的特征值误差，这一瓶颈阻碍了方法的实际应用。理解并缓解这一误差放大效应是推动该类算法走向实用化的关键。
AI.method: 通过理论推导证明有限采样扰动界：在重叠矩阵阈值化后，特征值灵敏度由保留重叠矩阵的条件数控制（而非最坏情况下的维度因子）。提出了可扩展的重叠阈值化方案，将每矩阵元素所需的采样数上界从O(M³)改进为O(M)。通过氢链和氢环的数值实验验证了理论结果。
AI.result: 理论证明显示采样复杂度上界可从O(M³)降至O(M)；数值实验表明结构化NOQE实例的实际测量成本增长甚至比线性界更慢。
AI.conclusion: NOQE的测量成本瓶颈可以通过重叠阈值化策略得到显著缓解，采样复杂度从立方降到线性，使量子子空间对角化方法在近端量子计算上更具可行性。

title: General Probabilities of Causation with Causal Knowledge
summary: Probabilities of causation (PoCs) characterize individual causal responses that cannot be directly observed and therefore generally require partial identification. Tian and Pearl first derived theoretically sharp bounds for binary PoCs, including the probability of necessity (PN), the probability of sufficiency (PS), and the probability of necessity and sufficiency (PNS). Mueller et al. subsequently tightened the bounds for binary PNS by incorporating causal information encoded in covariates and mediators. More recently, Li and Pearl, as well as Shu et al., extended PoCs to multivalued settings and derived corresponding theoretical bounds. These developments naturally raise the question of whether additional causal knowledge can further tighten the bounds in multivalued settings. This paper addresses this question by deriving tighter bounds for multivalued PoCs through the incorporation of causal information encoded in covariates and mediators. We illustrate the theoretical results with toy examples, while simulation studies further demonstrate that the proposed bounds are tighter than existing nonbinary bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文通过纳入协变量和中介变量中编码的因果信息，推导出多值（multivalued）设置下因果关系概率（PoCs）的更紧边界，相较现有非二元边界具有更紧的性质。
AI.motivation: Tian和Pearl推导了二元PoCs的尖锐边界，Mueller等人通过纳入协变量和中介变量的因果信息进一步收紧了二元PNS边界，Li和Pearl以及Shu等人将PoCs扩展到多值设置并推导了理论边界。这些进展自然引出一个问题：在多值设置下，能否通过额外的因果知识进一步收紧边界？本文正是针对这一问题展开研究。
AI.method: 本文在多值设置下，将协变量和中介变量中蕴含的因果信息纳入到PoCs的边界推导过程中，从而导出比现有非二元边界更紧的理论界限。通过玩具示例说明理论结果，并通过仿真研究验证边界收紧的效果。
AI.result: 理论推导表明所提出的多值PoCs边界比现有的非二元边界更紧，玩具示例展示了具体效果，仿真研究进一步验证了边界收紧的结论。
AI.conclusion: 在协变量和中介变量的辅助下，多值设置下的PoCs边界可以得到进一步收紧，从而更精确地刻画个体的因果响应。

title: Shots-to-Approximate-Solution Scaling in Neutral-Atom Quantum Optimization
comment: 17 pages, 8 figures ; data and code available at https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.33205122
summary: Whether neutral-atom quantum optimization protocols exhibit genuine concentration toward low-energy solution structure remains an open question. Here, we introduce a shots-to-approximate-solution metric, STS(r), where r denotes the approximation ratio, and evaluate it using postprocessed outputs modeled by a degeneracy-weighted shell distribution governed by a single effective parameter, $β$, that quantifies concentration toward near-optimal independent sets. To extract the genuine concentration effect in the quantum data, we apply identical postprocessing to both experimental bitstrings and randomly generated bitstrings with matched excitation density, thereby constructing an excitation-matched random baseline. Experiments on programmable Rydberg-atom arrays with system sizes up to 125 sites show that quantum annealing consistently exceeds the random baseline, demonstrating enhanced concentration toward low-energy solution structure beyond what can be attributed solely to excitation density. The results further reveal two distinct target-dependent regimes. For near-exact targets with $r \approx 1$, the required shot count grows exponentially with system size and is reduced at the same exponential level by quantum annealing within the shell-model description. By contrast, for relaxed targets, the shot cost becomes effectively constant, and the corresponding quantum enhancement diminishes, with the classical postprocessing heuristic alone reaching the target in order-unity attempts. Together, these results establish an operational method for quantifying quantum optimization performance and clarify the regimes under which quantum approaches can yield practical benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于量化中性原子量子优化协议真实浓度效应的度量指标STS(r)，并通过激发密度匹配的随机基线对比实验，在多达125个Rydberg原子阵列上证明量子退火比随机基线表现出更强的低能解结构浓度。研究揭示了两种目标依赖的机制：近精确目标下所需射击数随系统尺寸指数增长但量子退火在同一指数级别上降低该成本；而宽松目标下射击成本近似恒定，量子增强效应减弱，经典后处理启发式即可在常数次尝试内达到目标。
AI.motivation: 中性原子量子优化协议是否真正展现出向低能解结构浓度收敛的特性仍是一个悬而未决的问题。现有研究缺乏一个操作性的度量方法来区分量子数据中的真实浓度效应与仅由激发密度等平凡因素导致的表观改进。
AI.method: 引入STS(r)度量（r为近似比），采用退化权重壳层分布建模后处理输出，由单一有效参数β量化向近最优独立集的浓度。核心方法是对实验比特串和激发密度匹配的随机比特串施加相同的后处理，构建激发匹配随机基线以提取量子数据中的真实浓度效应。实验基于可编程Rydberg原子阵列，系统尺寸达125个格点。
AI.result: 量子退火在所有情况下都一致地超过随机基线，显示出超越激发密度可解释范围的增强浓度效应。研究发现两种目标依赖机制：近精确目标（r≈1）下射击数随系统尺寸指数增长，量子退火在同一指数水平上降低所需射击数；宽松目标下射击成本接近常数，量子增强效应减弱，经典后处理启发式可在常数次尝试内达到目标。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一种操作性的量子优化性能量化方法，明确了量子方案在实际中能够产生收益的适用区间——即近精确解目标下量子退火能带来指数级别的射击数节省，而宽松目标下量子优势有限。

title: Evaluating AlphaEarth Foundations Embeddings for Wildfire Susceptibility Mapping
summary: Wildfire susceptibility mapping typically relies on physical variables assembled from multiple remote-sensing, climate, and geospatial products. AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) provides analysis-ready geospatial embeddings that may reduce this dependence on heavy harmonisation and task-specific feature engineering, but their value for wildfire susceptibility mapping has not been systematically evaluated. Using Victoria, Australia (2017-2025), as a case study, we show that AEF embeddings can reconstruct commonly used variables in wildfire susceptibility analysis with high accuracy. In downstream susceptibility models trained on satellite-derived fire occurrence data, embedding-based susceptibility models achieve ROC-AUC values above 0.92 and consistently identify high wildfire susceptibility across eastern Victoria, particularly Gippsland and the north-eastern uplands, with additional localized hotspots in central and northwestern Victoria. A key feature of AEF embeddings is their strong near-region transferability within climatically similar regions. When embedding-based models trained in Victoria are applied to Canberra and Western Sydney-Blue Mountains, ROC-AUC improves by around 4% at Canberra and declines by around 2% at Western Sydney-Blue Mountains, compared with a mean decrease of approximately 25% for physical-variable models. These findings provide practical guidance for using AEF embeddings and lay a foundation for scalable wildfire susceptibility mapping workflows for downstream users such as government agencies and (re)insurers.

AI.tldr: 本研究以澳大利亚维多利亚州（2017-2025）为案例，系统评估了AlphaEarth Foundations（AEF）地理空间嵌入在野火易发性制图中的应用价值。研究发现AEF嵌入能高精度重建传统野火易发性分析所需的物理变量，基于嵌入的易发性模型ROC-AUC超过0.92，并在澳大利亚东部识别出高野火易发区域。AEF嵌入在气候相似区域表现出强迁移能力，跨区域迁移时性能远优于传统物理变量模型（维州模型迁移至堪培拉时AUC提升约4%，至悉尼蓝山仅下降约2%，而物理变量模型平均下降约25%）。
AI.motivation: 传统野火易发性制图依赖多种遥感、气候和地理空间产品的人工整合与特征工程，过程繁琐且成本高昂。虽然AEF提供的分析就绪地理空间嵌入可能减少这种依赖，但其在野火易发性制图中的价值尚未被系统评估，因此急需验证其有效性并探索其在可扩展工作流中的潜力。
AI.method: 以澳大利亚维多利亚州（2017-2025）为案例，首先验证AEF嵌入能否高精度重建野火易发性分析中常用的物理变量；然后基于卫星衍生的火灾发生数据训练下游易发性模型，评估嵌入模型的ROC-AUC性能；最后通过将维州训练的嵌入模型迁移到堪培拉和西悉尼-蓝山地区，对比物理变量模型的迁移性能，检验嵌入在气候相似区域的迁移能力。
AI.result: AEF嵌入可高精度重建常用野火易发性变量；嵌入模型ROC-AUC超过0.92，一致识别出维多利亚东部（特别是吉普斯兰和东北高地）高野火易发区域，并在维州中部和西北部发现局部热点。迁移测试中，嵌入模型在堪培拉AUC提升约4%、西悉尼-蓝山下降约2%，而物理变量模型平均下降约25%，显示嵌入模型的显著迁移优势。
AI.conclusion: AEF嵌入能够有效支持野火易发性制图，减少对传统多源数据整合和特征工程的依赖，并在气候相似区域内具备出色的迁移能力。该发现为政府机构和（再）保险公司等下游用户提供了可扩展的野火易发性制图工作流的实用指导。

title: Hybrid HPC-Quantum Simulations: DFT-Quantum Embedding for Molecular Systems
summary:
Scientific simulations demand methods combining scalability with predictive accuracy. Density Functional Theory (DFT) on High-Performance Computing (HPC) enables large-scale electronic-structure simulations but is limited by approximations affecting strongly correlated systems and band-gap predictions. Quantum computing offers a pathway to address this, though current Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) hardware remains constrained by qubit resources, noise, and execution cost.
  This work presents a hybrid DFT-Quantum Embedding (QDFT) framework integrating classical HPC-based DFT with a quantum electronic-structure solver. Large systems are partitioned to isolate a chemically relevant active space, treated via the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE), while the remaining degrees of freedom are described by DFT. The framework incorporates active-space selection, embedded Hamiltonian construction, symmetry preservation, operator mapping, self-consistent density updating, and modular classical-quantum coupling.
  We focus on noiseless quantum simulation to systematically evaluate accuracy, convergence, active-space dependence, computational cost, and HPC scalability without hardware noise. Detailed profiling identifies computational bottlenecks and highlights limitations of CPU-based quantum simulation. A QPU runtime-estimation methodology is additionally developed to assess execution requirements on actual quantum hardware.
  Results demonstrate quantum embedding's potential to improve selected electronic-structure properties while retaining classical HPC's scalability. Noisy quantum simulation and QPU execution remain key future directions, providing a pathway toward practical, scalable HPC-quantum hybrid simulations as hardware matures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合DFT-量子嵌入（QDFT）框架，将经典HPC上的DFT与变分量子特征求解器（VQE）结合，通过将大体系划分为化学相关的活性空间用量子计算处理、其余自由度用DFT描述，在无噪声量子模拟条件下系统评估了精度、收敛性、活性空间依赖性、计算成本与HPC可扩展性，并开发了QPU运行时估算方法。
AI.motivation: DFT在HPC上支持大规模电子结构模拟，但受近似限制，难以准确处理强关联体系和带隙预测；量子计算虽有望解决该问题，但NISQ硬件受限于量子比特资源、噪声和执行成本，需要一种融合两者优势的混合方案。
AI.method: 提出QDFT框架，将大体系划分为化学相关的活性空间（由VQE处理）与其余自由度（由DFT描述），整合了活性空间选择、嵌入哈密顿量构建、对称性保持、算子映射、自洽密度更新和模块化经典-量子耦合等环节；在无噪声量子模拟下进行系统评估，并开发QPU运行时估算方法。
AI.result: 结果表明量子嵌入能改善选定的电子结构性质，同时保持经典HPC的可扩展性；详细性能剖析识别了计算瓶颈，揭示了CPU量子模拟的局限性，并提供了实际量子硬件上的执行需求估算。
AI.conclusion: QDFT框架展示了量子嵌入提升电子结构精度与HPC可扩展性兼容的潜力；带噪声的量子模拟和真实QPU执行是未来关键方向，为硬件成熟后实用化、可扩展的HPC-量子混合模拟提供了路径。

title: A Local-Linearly Convergent Algorithm for Nonconvex Equality-Constrained Optimization
summary: For solving nonconvex equality-constrained optimization problems, a recent Gradient-Eigenstep Algorithm by Goyens et al.~is an iteration-efficient approach, based on minimizing Fletcher's augmented Lagrangian function, for finding an approximate second-order stationary point from an arbitrary starting point. In this paper, the analysis of this algorithm is extended, offering a two-fold contribution. First, it is shown that a local-linear rate of convergence can be obtained by this method if it is initiated sufficiently close to a strong second-order stationary point and employs a sufficiently small step-size parameter and sufficiently large penalty parameter. In this case, the algorithm reduces to a gradient descent algorithm applied to minimize Fletcher's augmented Lagrangian. Second, as a particularly useful application of the first result, it is shown that the Gradient-Eigenstep algorithm can be used as an iteration-efficient subproblem solver in the context of a progressive sampling strategy for solving equality-constrained optimization problems when the objective and constraint functions are defined by large sample averages, ultimately offering an algorithm with an improved worst-case sample complexity when compared to an approach that solves a full-sample problem directly.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了Gradient-Eigenstep算法的分析，证明其在强二阶驻点附近以足够小的步长和足够大的罚参数启动时可获得局部线性收敛速率；并将其作为渐进采样策略的子问题求解器，用于求解由大样本均值定义的目标和约束函数，相比直接求解全样本问题具有更优的最坏情况样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: 非凸等式约束优化问题普遍存在于机器学习和大规模数据分析中。Goyens等人提出的Gradient-Eigenstep算法虽然迭代高效，但其收敛速率分析和在大规模问题中的应用潜力尚未被充分探索，特别是如何将其与采样策略结合以降低样本复杂度仍是一个开放问题。
AI.method: 作者从两方面展开分析：(1) 在强二阶驻点附近，通过选择合适的步长参数和罚参数，证明Gradient-Eigenstep算法退化为对Fletcher增广拉格朗日函数执行梯度下降，从而获得局部线性收敛速率；(2) 将上述结果应用于渐进采样策略框架，将Gradient-Eigenstep作为子问题求解器，在目标与约束函数为大样本均值定义的等式约束优化问题中，实现改进的样本复杂度。
AI.result: 证明了Gradient-Eigenstep算法在强二阶驻点附近以适当的参数设置可取得局部线性收敛；在渐进采样策略中作为子问题求解器使用时，相比直接求解全样本问题，获得了更优的最坏情况样本复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作不仅深化了对Gradient-Eigenstep算法理论性质的理解，还展示了其在采样策略下的实际价值，为非凸等式约束优化在大规模数据场景中的高效求解提供了新的理论保证。

title: AutoQuREO: A Framework for Automated Quantum Resource Estimation and Optimization
summary:
As quantum computing progresses from proof-of-principle demonstrations toward practical utility, a significant impediment is the need to augment algorithmic feasibility with system-level optimization across heterogeneous hardware and software stacks. Quantum resource estimation (QRE) plays a central role in this transition, yet existing approaches remain largely compilation-heavy or domain-knowledge-guided symbolic annotations, and tightly coupled to long-term fault-tolerant assumptions, limiting their topical applicability.
  In this work, we introduce AutoQuREO, an Automated framework for full-stack Quantum Resource Estimation and Optimization. AutoQuREO is built around four core novelties: (i) a flexible, user-defined abstraction of the quantum computing stack; (ii) a modular library of reusable stack components enabling rapid full-stack prototyping; (iii) surrogate modeling of layer-wise resources via algorithmic profiling and neuro-symbolic learning; and (iv) integrated multi-objective optimization that embeds QRE directly into deployment pipelines. Together, these design choices enable AutoQuREO to serve as a digital twin for quantum computing stacks, supporting the tractable exploration of complex design spaces.
  We demonstrate the capabilities of AutoQuREO through representative co-design case studies, including early-fault-tolerant quantum algorithms, small error correction codes, gate decomposition and variational training of parametric quantum circuits. These examples illustrate how AutoQuREO enables systematic discovery of unexploited resource trade-offs that are computationally intractable or abstruse using existing QRE tools. AutoQuREO is positioned as a general-purpose platform for advancing quantum technology readiness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoQuREO，一个自动化全栈量子资源估计与优化框架，通过灵活的用户定义栈抽象、模块化组件库、神经符号代理建模和集成多目标优化四大创新，作为量子计算栈的数字孪生，支持复杂设计空间的系统探索。
AI.motivation: 量子计算从原理验证迈向实用化过程中，需要跨异构软硬件栈的系统级优化。现有量子资源估计(QRE)方法要么依赖编译过程，要么依赖领域知识引导的符号注释，且紧密耦合于大规模容错的长期假设，限制了其应用的针对性。缺乏一个通用、灵活且可扩展到不同量子计算场景的资源估计与优化平台。
AI.method: AutoQuREO包含四大核心创新：(i) 灵活的用户定义量子计算栈抽象；(ii) 可复用栈组件的模块化库，支持快速全栈原型设计；(iii) 通过算法剖析和神经符号学习对逐层资源进行代理建模；(iv) 将QRE直接嵌入部署管线的集成多目标优化。这些设计使其作为量子计算栈的数字孪生。
AI.result: 通过代表性协同设计案例验证了AutoQuREO的能力，包括早期容错量子算法、小尺寸纠错码、门分解和参数化量子电路的变分训练。这些案例展示了AutoQuREO能系统性地发现现有QRE工具计算上难以处理或难以理解的资源权衡。
AI.conclusion: AutoQuREO定位为通用平台，用于推动量子技术成熟度的提升，弥补现有QRE工具在灵活性、可扩展性和设计空间探索方面的不足。

title: High-resolution Calibrated Probabilistic Hourly Precipitation from a Deterministic Forecast
summary: An ``Attention Residual U-Net'' method is described for probabilistic quantitative precipitation forecasting (PQPF) that predicts the hourly probability of no precipitation plus the distribution of positive precipitation from a weighted mixture of two Gamma distributions. The neural network is trained on patches of numerical weather prediction (NWP) hourly precipitation from The Weather Company's convection-permitting GRAF (Global high-Resolution Atmospheric Forecasting) model along with terrain information and column-average relative humidity from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration's (NOAA's) Global Forecast System (GFS). The target data are NOAA's Multi-Radar, Multi-Sensor (MRMS) gauge-corrected, quality controlled radar data sampled to the same grid as the GRAF data. The network outputs distributional parameters for each model grid point. Training uses negative log-likelihood as a proper scoring rule, with climatological initialization for stable convergence. Inference is performed as a single forward pass over the contiguous United States (CONUS) domain, with edge-replication padding to satisfy the network's spatial-divisibility requirement. The subsequent forecasts are spatially detailed, highly reliable, and skillful with respect to climatology and a simpler reference forecast method. The method is particularly useful for estimating probabilities in regions with large terrain variation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Attention Residual U-Net的深度学习概率定量降水预报（PQPF）方法，通过混合两个Gamma分布来预测逐小时无降水概率及正降水量分布。模型使用GRAF和GFS的NWP预报数据及地形信息作为输入，以MRMS雷达数据为目标，采用负对数似然作为训练损失函数，并在CONUS整个区域上单次前向推理生成高分辨率、高可靠性的概率降水预报，特别在地形起伏大的区域表现出色。
AI.motivation: 传统定量降水预报通常只提供确定性预报，无法充分表达降水的不确定性。概率降水预报（PQPF）能更好地表征降水的不确定性和极端事件风险，但现有方法在空间细节、可靠性以及地形复杂区域的表现上仍有不足，需要更先进的深度学习方法来改善。
AI.method: 采用Attention Residual U-Net神经网络架构，将预报输出建模为无降水概率与两个Gamma分布的加权混合。输入包括The Weather Company的GRAF对流解析NWP逐小时降水、地形信息和NOAA GFS的柱平均相对湿度；目标数据为与GRAF同网格采样的MRMS雷达质量控制数据。网络输出每个网格点的分布参数，训练采用负对数似然作为严格评分规则（proper scoring rule），并使用气候初始化保证收敛稳定性。推理时在CONUS域上进行单次前向传播，通过边缘复制填充满足网络空间可整除性要求。
AI.result: 生成的预报在空间上具有高分辨率细节，可靠性高，相对于气候预报和更简单的参考预报方法展现出显著的技巧优势，尤其是在地形变化较大的区域，概率估计效果尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: Attention Residual U-Net结合混合Gamma分布输出的框架能够有效生成空间细致且可靠的概率降水预报，是一种适用于业务化PQPF的强有力方法，尤其在地形复杂区域具有明显优势。

title: Encoding Circuit Satisfiability in Rydberg Atom Arrays
summary: Rydberg atom arrays natively encode the maximum-weight independent set (MWIS) problem through the blockade mechanism, so the Boolean circuit satisfiability problem (Circuit-SAT) can be brought onto the platform once it is reduced to MWIS. The conventional encoding of Circuit-SAT in the Rydberg atom array proceeds through conjunctive normal form (CNF) and incurs a substantial atom overhead. We introduce CAMERA (Circuit-SAT Atom-efficient MWIS Encoding for Rydberg Arrays), a method that provides MWIS encodings of Circuit-SAT instances on the king subgraph geometry of the array. CAMERA represents each logic gate as a compact weighted gadget and assembles the gadgets with a placement and routing compiler inspired by very large scale integration (VLSI) design. On random multi-gate benchmarks, the direct encoding route lowers the atom cost relative to the CNF route by an average factor of $22.4 \pm 1.8$. To demonstrate that the encoding extends from individual weighted gadgets to multi-gate arithmetic blocks, we compile a full adder and a multiplier, verifying each against its complete truth table by exact classical ground state calculations. We further showcase solving a representative Circuit-SAT instance end-to-end, from gate level compilation through a closed-system tensor-network simulation of a hardware-compatible annealing protocol on the encoded 30-atom instance to readout of a satisfying assignment. These results establish a complete encoding and simulation workflow as a proof of principle, and a concrete route toward solving a broader family of combinatorial problems on Rydberg atom arrays.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAMERA方法，一种在Rydberg原子阵列上高效编码Circuit-SAT问题的方案。通过将每个逻辑门编码为紧凑的加权gadget，并借助VLSI设计启发的布局布线编译器，CAMERA在king子图几何上组装gadget，相比传统CNF编码路线平均降低原子开销22.4倍。作者在随机多门基准上验证了该方法的优势，并编译了全加器和乘法器，通过精确基态计算验证其正确性，最后通过30原子实例的端到端模拟展示了完整工作流程。
AI.motivation: 传统的Circuit-SAT到Rydberg原子阵列的编码需要通过CNF转换，导致大量原子开销，降低了硬件利用率和可扩展性。因此需要一种更高效的直接编码方法，以降低原子成本并使其能够解决更大规模的组合优化问题。
AI.method: CAMERA方法将每个逻辑门表示为一个紧凑的加权gadget（使用加权原子编码），并通过受VLSI设计启发的布局布线编译器在阵列的king子图几何上组装这些gadget。编码过程直接从门级电路到MWIS，绕过了CNF中间表示。验证部分使用精确经典基态计算检查全加器和乘法器的完整真值表，并使用闭系统张量网络模拟硬件兼容的退火协议进行端到端求解。
AI.result: 在随机多门基准上，直接编码路线的原子成本相比CNF路线平均降低22.4±1.8倍。编译并验证了全加器和乘法器，经精确经典基态计算确认正确。端到端演示了一个30原子的Circuit-SAT实例，从门级编译经张量网络模拟退火协议到读出满足赋值，验证了完整工作流程的可行性。
AI.conclusion: CAMERA建立了从Circuit-SAT到Rydberg原子阵列的完整编码与模拟工作流程，证明了原理可行性，并为在Rydberg原子阵列上解决更广泛的组合问题提供了具体路径。该方法显著降低了原子开销，是向实用化量子/量子启发计算迈出的重要一步。

title: Distribution Steering via Sliced Optimal Transport Control
summary: Distribution steering seeks feedback laws that drive the state law of a dynamical system between prescribed initial and terminal distributions. Optimal transport provides a natural geometric approach, but its implementation generally requires a transport map or coupling in the full state space. Sliced optimal transport avoids this full-dimensional construction through one-dimensional projections. Yet, the resulting projected maps specify only directional displacements and do not by themselves prescribe a realizable feedback law. To this end, we develop a finite-horizon control framework based on sliced optimal transport. At each sampling instant, a projected optimal transport map defines a directional terminal condition, whose minimum-energy realization yields a randomized single-direction controller. Averaging over projection directions gives a deterministic sliced feedback. For the single-integrator dynamics, the averaged feedback makes the sliced Wasserstein distance to the target non-increasing. For Gaussian endpoint laws, it is affine, preserves Gaussianity, and steers the mean and covariance to their prescribed terminal values. We further identify a law-dependent gain that yields linear decay of the sliced Wasserstein distance together with an explicit characterization of the control energy. We also prove that the randomized controller converges to the averaged sliced flow as the sampling period vanishes. Finally, we extend the construction to linear dynamical systems. Reachability-normalized coordinates allow instantaneous realization of the sliced velocity for uniformly fully actuated systems, while local controllability Gramians provide exact finite-step realization for general controllable systems. Numerical examples illustrate the resulting distributional flows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于切片最优传输（sliced optimal transport, SOT）的有限时域控制框架，用于驱动态系统的状态分布从指定初始分布到达终端分布。在每个采样时刻，利用一维投影最优传输映射定义方向性终端条件，通过最小能量实现得到随机单方向控制器，再对投影方向取平均得到确定性切片反馈。文章证明了对单积分器动力学，该反馈使切片Wasserstein距离非增；对高斯端点分布，反馈是仿射的、保持高斯性，并能将均值和协方差精确驱动到目标值。此外还给出了线性衰减的增益特性、控制能量刻画，以及随机控制器在采样周期趋零时收敛到平均切片流的结论，并将构造推广到线性控制系统。
AI.motivation: 最优传输为分布转向提供了自然的几何方法，但其实现通常需要在全状态空间构造传输映射或耦合，维度高、计算复杂。切片最优传输虽通过一维投影避免了全维构造，但投影映射只给出方向性位移，并未直接提供可实现的反馈律。因此需要搭建一个桥接切片最优传输与反馈控制的框架，使得投影结果能够转化为实际可执行的控制器。
AI.method: 提出一个基于切片最优传输的有限时域控制框架。具体方法为：(1) 在每个采样时刻，由投影最优传输映射定义方向性终端条件；(2) 通过最小能量实现得到一个随机化的单方向控制器；(3) 对所有投影方向取平均，得到确定性的切片反馈控制器。对于单积分器系统给出收敛与单调性分析；对高斯端点情形分析仿射性质与矩演化；并利用可达性归一化坐标和局部可控性Gramian将框架推广到线性系统。
AI.result: 对单积分器动力学，平均反馈使切片Wasserstein距离非增；对高斯端点分布，反馈为仿射、保持高斯性，并精确驱动均值协方差到目标值；识别出与分布相关的增益，造成切片Wasserstein距离线性衰减并给出控制能量的显式刻画；证明了随机控制器在采样周期趋零时收敛到平均切片流；对均匀完全驱动系统可达性归一化坐标可即时实现切片速度，对一般可控系统可用局部可控性Gramian实现有限步精确实现。数值算例验证了分布流行为。
AI.conclusion: 该工作成功将切片最优传输从纯几何工具转化为可实际实现的分布转向反馈控制律，为有限时域分布控制提供了一种低维、可计算且可扩展的方法，并推广至一般线性可控系统，为后续更广泛的非线性与随机系统分布控制奠定了基础。

title: Geometry versus excitation sector in the decoherence of asymmetric $N$-qubit $W$ states
summary: We investigate how network geometry and excitation sector separately control pairwise entanglement decay in asymmetric multipartite $W$ states. To disentangle these effects, we introduce an analytically tractable $N$-qubit generalization of the asymmetric Lohmayer geometry and its complementary-excitation partner, yielding inequivalent vertex-base (VB) and base-base (BB) pair classes that can be compared directly with symmetric $W$-state references. We derive closed-form concurrence dynamics under representative one-sided noise models and find that, within either excitation sector, the VB concurrence has exactly the same noise dependence as the corresponding symmetric reference, preserving a noise-independent proportional advantage wherever both remain entangled. The amplitude-damping reordering previously identified for the three-qubit Lohmayer state is therefore a cross-sector effect rather than an intrinsic fragility of the VB geometry. In contrast, the BB pair exhibits a genuine same-sector structural fragility, with lower entanglement-sudden-death thresholds than the VB pair under depolarizing noise and, in the $(N-1)$-excitation sector, under amplitude damping. The results establish network geometry, excitation sector, and noise symmetry as distinct ingredients governing pairwise entanglement robustness in asymmetric quantum networks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了不对称多体W态中网络几何结构与激发扇区如何分别控制成对纠缠的衰减。通过引入N-qubit不对称Lohmayer几何构型及其互补激发伙伴，发现顶点-基底（VB）对的纠缠噪声依赖性与对称W态参考完全相同，而基底-基底（BB）对则表现出真正的同扇区结构脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 理解量子网络中纠缠退相干的控制因素至关重要，但网络几何与激发扇区的影响在以往研究中相互混淆。作者希望将这两个效应解耦，以精确区分它们对纠缠动力学各自的作用。
AI.method: 提出了N-qubit不对称Lohmayer几何构型的解析可处理推广形式及其互补激发伙伴，得到不等价的VB和BB两类成对构型，并与对称W态参考进行直接比较。在代表性单侧噪声模型下推导出闭式concurrence动力学。
AI.result: 在任一激发扇区内，VB对的concurrence噪声依赖性与对应对称参考完全相同，保持与噪声无关的比例优势。三量子比特Lohmayer态的幅值阻尼重排序被证明是跨扇区效应而非VB几何的内在脆弱性。BB对表现出真正的同扇区结构脆弱性，在去极化噪声下以及(N-1)激发扇区的幅值阻尼下，其纠缠突然死亡阈值低于VB对。
AI.conclusion: 网络几何、激发扇区和噪声对称性是控制不对称量子网络中成对纠缠鲁棒性的三个独立要素，本文为量子网络设计中的纠缠保护策略提供了理论指导。

title: Distinguishing case-mix from context heterogeneity in prognostic regression model synthesis settings
summary: Prognostic regression models often synthesize data from multiple sites, whether within a multi-site study, across federated settings, or in individual participant data meta-analysis. Here, a site is any data source, such as a hospital, registry, trial, or study, and need not be a physical center. Analysts must then decide whether one regression model represents all sites or whether site-specific models are needed. Established measures such as coefficient-level tau^2 quantify heterogeneity but do not distinguish its source. We focus on diagnosing whether coefficient heterogeneity reflects case-mix or site-specific context effects. Case-mix heterogeneity can arise when linear regression terms approximate multivariable non-linear relationships in populations with different covariate distributions. Contextual heterogeneity arises when comparable patients require different regression relationships across sites. We do this by fitting site-specific local regressions in a dimension-reduced space and partitioning the smoothed coefficient surfaces into a cross-site reference and site-specific deviations. An autoencoder and custom loss structure the latent space around local prognostic relationships. We then project this partition onto the outcome scale to derive observation- and site-level summaries. We demonstrate the approach on a COPD trial with two sites. In the three leading latent slope coordinates, coefficient-surface variation was predominantly contextual. The derived observation-level outcome-scale variance partition was case-mix-leading, whereas its between-site aggregation was concentrated in contextual differences rather than case-mix shifts. A permuted-site negative control assesses whether the contextual summary can arise when site labels carry no signal. This diagnostic distinction can inform whether joint or site-specific regression models should be evaluated.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种诊断方法，用于区分预后回归模型中的系数异质性来源：是病例组合（case-mix）还是情境效应（contextual effects）。该方法通过在降维空间中拟合局部回归，用自编码器将平滑系数曲面划分为跨站点参考和站点特异性偏差，并在结局尺度上生成观测级和站点级摘要。在COPD双站点试验中验证，发现系数表面变异以情境性为主，而观测级变异以案例组合为主。
AI.motivation: 在多站点预后回归建模中，分析者需要决定是使用统一的联合模型还是站点特异性模型。现有度量如系数级别的tau^2虽能量化异质性，却无法区分异质性的来源。区分案例组合异质性（由非线性函数近似和不同协变量分布导致）与情境性异质性（由不同站点对可比患者需要不同回归关系导致）对于模型选择至关重要，但此前缺乏系统性诊断工具。
AI.method: 方法包括四个核心步骤：(1) 拟合站点特异性局部回归于维度缩减空间（autoencoder结构化的潜在空间）；(2) 将平滑的系数曲面分解为跨站点参考部分和站点特异性偏差部分；(3) 将此分解投影到结局尺度，生成观测级和站点级的方差摘要；(4) 使用置换站点标签的阴性对照来检验情境性摘要是否可能仅由偶然产生。
AI.result: 在包含两个站点的COPD试验中，前三个主要潜在斜率坐标上的系数表面变异以情境性为主。观测级结局尺度方差分解以案例组合为主导，而站点间聚合则集中在情境性差异而非案例组合偏移。置换站点标签的阴性对照用于评估情境性摘要的显著性。
AI.conclusion: 该诊断框架能够区分预后模型系数异质性的来源（案例组合vs情境效应），为分析者决定采用联合模型还是站点特异性模型提供依据。研究强调了在多站点数据分析中，异质性诊断不应仅停留在系数层面，还需通过潜在空间学习区分其结构性来源。

title: Always-on, highly efficient microwave photon detector based on a superconducting artificial molecule
summary: Efficient detection of single microwave photons is a key capability for emerging quantum technologies. Yet, it remains far less developed than its optical domain counterpart. Realizing detectors that simultaneously achieve high efficiency, low dark counts, and continuous operation has proved challenging. Existing detectors operate cyclically, forcing a trade-off between efficiency and duty cycle. Here, we demonstrate a continuously operated microwave single-photon detector based on a superconducting artificial molecule. In our scheme, an incoming photon is captured by a bright state of the molecule and then transferred to a long-lived dark state via a driven-dissipative process. Photon ``clicks'' are revealed as quantum jumps in the continuously monitored dark state. We observe a cyclic detection efficiency of $0.73$, and a continuous detection efficiency of $0.47$ over a $5\,\mathrm{MHz}$ instantaneous bandwidth, with a $1\,μ\mathrm{s}$ temporal resolution and a $15\,μ\mathrm{s}$ dead time. By overcoming the trade-off between efficiency and duty cycle, this approach establishes continuous microwave photon detection for quantum sensing, quantum thermodynamics, and fundamental physics.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种基于超导人工分子的连续工作微波单光子探测器，通过将光子从亮态转移到长寿命暗态并监测量子跳变，实现了0.73的循环探测效率和0.47的连续探测效率（5 MHz瞬时带宽，1 μs时间分辨率，15 μs死时间），克服了传统探测器在效率与占空比之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 微波单光子探测是新兴量子技术的核心能力，但远落后于光学域探测器。现有探测器只能循环工作，在探测效率与占空比之间存在根本性权衡，难以同时实现高效率、低暗计数和连续运行，亟需突破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 采用超导人工分子方案：入射光子被分子的亮态捕获，随后通过驱动-耗散过程转移到长寿命的暗态；通过连续监测暗态的量子跳变来揭示光子"咔哒"信号，从而实现连续而非循环的探测工作模式。
AI.result: 实现了0.73的循环探测效率，以及0.47的连续探测效率，覆盖5 MHz瞬时带宽，具备1 μs时间分辨率和15 μs死时间。
AI.conclusion: 该方案通过克服效率与占空比之间的权衡，为量子传感、量子热力学和基础物理建立了连续微波光子探测能力。

title: CardioState-JEPA: Delay-Aware Cross-Modal Learning of a Shared Cardiac Representation
summary: Electrocardiography (ECG), photoplethysmography (PPG), and phonocardiography (PCG) provide complementary views of the same cardiac cycle, yet existing cardiac foundation models are trained for a single sensing modality, leaving the shared physiology across sensors unexploited. We introduce CardioState-JEPA, a cardiac foundation model to learn a single shared representation jointly across ECG, PPG, and PCG, built on a physiology-aware joint-embedding predictive architecture. The model maps heterogeneous waveforms into a common token space, processes them with a single shared Transformer encoder, and learns by predicting masked latent cardiac states, placing the pretraining target on shared physiology rather than sensor-specific waveform appearance. To handle the temporal offsets between electrical, mechanical, and hemodynamic events, cross-modal prediction uses a learned delay aligner that matches signals at the corresponding cardiac time. Because synchronized multi-sensor recordings are scarce, CardioState-JEPA first learns within-modality structure from abundant unimodal data and then uses paired data to align modalities in latent cardiac time. Evaluated as a frozen encoder across 25 downstream tasks spanning ECG, PPG, and PCG, our encoder improves average PPG classification by 8.2 AUROC points, PCG murmur detection by 18.8 AUROC points, and ECG classification by 15.5 AUROC points over the best self-supervised signal baseline and matches or exceeds cardiac models trained with privileged clinical text or supervised labels on several ECG benchmarks. These results establish that heterogeneous cardiac signals can mutually supervise a single foundation model of cardiac physiology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CardioState-JEPA，一个跨ECG、PPG、PCG三种心脏感知模态的共享心脏基础模型，采用生理感知的联合嵌入预测架构，将异构波形映射到统一token空间，通过掩码潜在心脏状态预测进行预训练，并利用延迟对齐器处理电-机械-血液动力学事件间的时间偏移。在25个下游任务上，冻结编码器在PPG、PCG和ECG分类上分别比最优秀的自监督信号基线提升8.2、18.8和15.5个AUROC点。
AI.motivation: ECG、PPG和PCG从不同视角描述同一个心动周期，但现有心脏基础模型仅针对单一传感模态训练，未能利用跨传感器的共享生理学信息，这浪费了异构信号间互补性带来的潜在表征提升。
AI.method: 构建CardioState-JEPA基础模型：(1) 将异构波形映射到统一的token空间；(2) 使用单一共享Transformer编码器处理；(3) 通过预测掩码的潜在心脏状态进行预训练，预训练目标聚焦于共享生理状态而非传感器特定的波形外观；(4) 引入学习式延迟对齐器（learned delay aligner）以匹配电、机械和血液动力学事件在对应心动时刻的时间偏移；(5) 采用两阶段训练：先从丰富的单模态数据学习模态内结构，再用配对数据在潜在心脏时间维度上对齐模态。
AI.result: 在25个覆盖ECG、PPG、PCG的下游任务上作为冻结编码器评估，相比最佳自监督信号基线，PPG分类平均提升8.2 AUROC点，PCG杂音检测提升18.8 AUROC点，ECG分类提升15.5 AUROC点；在多个ECG基准上达到或超过使用特权临床文本或监督标签训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 异构心脏信号可以相互监督训练一个统一的心脏生理基础模型，验证了跨模态共享表征的可行性，表明共享生理学比单模态外观更能有效驱动心脏基础模型的学习。

title: Completeness for flow-preserving rewrite rules
summary:
Complete sets of graphical rewrite rules enable fully graphical reasoning about quantum computations and have been an area of active research for more than a decade. Many recent applications of the ZX-calculus have made use of the close correspondence between ZX-diagrams and computations in the one-way model of measurement-based quantum computation. In this model, various kinds of flow properties ensure deterministic implementability; for ZX-diagrams, these same properties allow efficient translation into quantum circuits (a problem that is known to be #P-hard in general). Therefore, flow-preserving ZX-calculus rewrite rules are of strong interest.
  Here, we extend the set of flow-preserving rules appearing in the literature with a few new rules and extensions of existing rules. We then show that the resulting rule set is complete for all flow-preserving translations between ZX-diagrams of appropriate form. The proof employs a manifestly flow-preserving equivalent of circuit extraction, where a diagram with gflow is transformed, using only flow-preserving rewrite rules, into a diagram with causal flow.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了ZX-演算中保流（flow-preserving）的图形重写规则集，并证明该规则集对具有合适形式的ZX图之间所有保流变换是完备的。证明使用了显式的保流电路提取等价方法，将具有gflow的ZX图仅通过保流重写规则转换为具有因果流（causal flow）的图。
AI.motivation: ZX-演算中的图形重写规则对于全图形化推理量子计算至关重要。许多近期应用利用ZX图与单向量子计算模型（measurement-based quantum computation）之间的对应关系，其中流（flow）性质确保确定性可实施性和向量子电路的转换效率。因此，保留流性质的ZX-演算重写规则具有重要价值，但现有文献中的保流规则集尚不完整。
AI.method: 作者扩展了文献中已有的保流重写规则集，新增了若干规则并对现有规则进行了推广。然后证明了扩展后的规则集对于所有合适形式的ZX图之间的保流翻译是完备的。证明的核心是引入一种显式保流的电路提取等价方法，利用该方法可将具有gflow的ZX图通过纯保流重写规则转化为具有因果流的图。
AI.result: 得到了一个扩展的保流ZX-演算重写规则集，并证明了该规则集对ZX图之间所有保流翻译的完备性。这为流保持的图形推理提供了完整的公理化基础。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了保流ZX-演算重写规则的完备性空白，使得涉及流性质保持的图形重写推理在理论上是完整的，为ZX-演算在测量基量子计算领域的应用提供了更坚实的理论基础。

title: VALG: An Agentic System for ML Theory Research
summary:
Machine learning theory studies learning procedures through mathematical setups in which the data model, training protocol, oracle access, loss, metric, and randomness define the phenomenon that a theorem is meant to explain. Solving an open problem therefore requires the problem formulation, theorem target, and proof mechanism to be developed in concert. Researchers formulate hypotheses, test them through preliminary theoretical or empirical analysis, and refine both assumptions and proofs. We investigate whether this process can be organized as an autonomous agentic workflow for ML theory research.
  We develop VALG, an agentic system that combines multi-level Verification, Adaptive formulation of Learning-theory problems, and Graph-structured proof development. Within each source-relative theorem branch, VALG maintains a fixed mathematical specification, checks the theorem-level composition of a typed proof-dependency graph, and constructs and reviews local proofs in dependency order. When a proof attempt fails, VALG identifies whether the obstruction lies in a derivation, the proof structure, or the theorem formulation and routes the next attempt accordingly. Formulation-level obstructions initiate an explicitly related variant or relaxation, preserving the mathematical relation between the resulting theorem and the source problem.
  We evaluate VALG on nine subproblems from five COLT 2026 open problems. Two runs produce internally finalized theorem candidates that match the scope of their source briefs; the remaining seven yield restricted-method results, special cases, or conditional theorems. These case studies show how VALG keeps source-scope matches, relaxations, conditional results, and blocked attempts mathematically distinct. VALG is open source at https://github.com/DechenZhang/VALG-ML-Theory-Agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VALG，一个将机器学习理论研究过程组织为自主智能体工作流的系统。VALG结合多层级验证、自适应问题表述和图形化证明开发，在九个COLT 2026开放问题的子问题上进行评估，其中两个运行产生了与源问题范围匹配的最终定理候选。
AI.motivation: 机器学习理论研究通常需要研究者同时协调问题表述、定理目标和证明机制。传统上这一过程由人类研究者手工完成，本文旨在探究这一过程能否被组织为自主智能体工作流，从而实现ML理论研究的自动化探索。
AI.method: VALG系统包含三个核心组件：(1) 多层级验证（Verification），(2) 自适应学习理论问题表述（Adaptive formulation），(3) 图形结构的证明开发（Graph-structured proof development）。系统在源相关定理分支中维护固定的数学规范，检查类型化证明依赖图的定理级组合，并按依赖顺序构建和审查局部证明。当证明失败时，系统识别障碍来源于推导、证明结构还是定理表述，并相应调整策略。
AI.result: 在五个COLT 2026开放问题的九个子问题上的评估显示：两次运行产生了与源任务范围匹配的内部最终定理候选，其余七次产生了受限方法结果、特例或条件定理。案例分析表明VALG能够保持源范围匹配、放宽、条件结果和受阻尝试在数学上的区分。
AI.conclusion: VALG展示了自主智能体系统可以在ML理论研究中发挥作用，能够系统地执行假设形成、证明尝试、失败归因和问题重构的循环，并以开源形式发布以供进一步研究。

title: Time evolution of nonlinear dynamics on a quantum processor
summary: From fluid flow and transport to collective dynamics, numerical simulation of nonlinear partial differential equations underpins modern scientific computing. Extending this capability to quantum computers remains a longstanding challenge because nonlinear and non-Hermitian evolution is fundamentally incompatible with conventional Hamiltonian-based quantum simulation. Here we experimentally realize the time evolution of nonlinear fluid dynamics on a quantum processor using a hybrid variational framework for the viscous and inviscid Burgers equations. Our approach directly encodes the nonlinear dynamics into a variational optimization procedure, avoiding the enlarged linear embeddings and truncation overhead associated with Carleman linearization-based quantum algorithms. We further demonstrate convection-dominated dynamics corresponding to Reynolds numbers of order $10^2$. We encode the governing evolution into parametrized quantum circuits and iteratively reconstruct the time-dependent field through quantum-classical optimization. By introducing a zero-noise extrapolation method without additional circuit-folding overhead, we accurately execute deep error-circuits with entangling-gate counts beyond those typical of Hadamard test circuits. We accurately reconstruct the time evolution across multiple timesteps despite hardware noise and finite device coherence. Our results constitute, to our knowledge, the first experimental realization of nonlinear time propagation on a quantum processor, extending quantum simulation beyond predominantly linear settings and establishing a route toward quantum computation for nonlinear continuum dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文在量子处理器上首次实验实现了非线性流体动力学的时间演化，使用混合变分框架求解粘性和无粘Burgers方程，避免了Carleman线性化方法所需的线性嵌入和截断开销，并通过无额外电路折叠开销的零噪声外推法成功执行了深错误电路。
AI.motivation: 非线性偏微分方程的数值模拟是现代科学计算的基础，但将其扩展到量子计算机上一直是长期挑战，因为非线性与非厄米演化与传统的基于哈密顿量的量子模拟本质上不兼容。现有方法（如Carleman线性化）需要增大线性嵌入维度和截断开销，效率受限。
AI.method: 采用混合变分框架求解二维Burgers方程：将非线性动力学直接编码为变分优化过程，将控制演化编码进参数化量子电路，通过量子-经典联合优化迭代重建时变场。同时引入一种无额外电路折叠开销的零噪声外推（ZNE）方法，以在硬件噪声下准确执行超过Hadamard测试电路典型深度的纠缠门电路。
AI.result: 在量子处理器上成功实验实现了粘性和无粘Burgers方程的时间演化，展示了雷诺数约10^2的对流主导动力学；尽管存在硬件噪声和有限设备相干时间，仍能在多个时间步上准确重建时间演化，实现了超越Hadamard测试电路深度的深错误电路执行。
AI.conclusion: 这是量子处理器上非线性时间传播的首次实验实现，将量子模拟从以线性为主的场景扩展到非线性连续介质动力学，为量子计算在非线性连续动力学中的应用开辟了道路。

title: Huber-Wasserstein barycenters for robust distribution-valued data
summary:
We propose a robust barycenter for distribution-valued data by incorporating the Huber loss directly into the optimal transport cost. In contrast to metric-space Huber means, which apply the Huber loss to the Wasserstein distance after optimization, our construction acts on individual transport displacements, preserving quadratic behavior locally while limiting the influence of large displacements. The resulting Huber-Wasserstein barycenters form a natural interpolation between Wasserstein means and $L^1$-type Wasserstein medians.
  We establish the analytical and statistical foundations of this construction. For optimal transport with Huber loss, we prove regularity and uniqueness properties of dual potentials, existence of optimal transport maps, and stability as the Huber parameter varies. For the associated barycenter problem, we prove existence and characterization results, consistency of empirical plug-in estimators, and a finite-sample breakdown point essentially equal to $1/2$. In dimension one, we further derive the pointwise influence function and asymptotic distribution, quantify the associated robustness-efficiency trade-off, and show that displacement-wise Huberization can retain first-order information that is lost by distance-based Huberization under localized shape contamination. Numerical experiments on contaminated distribution-valued data demonstrate the robustness of the proposed barycenters and illustrate their interpolation between mean- and median-like behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种稳健的Huber-Wasserstein重心（barycenter），通过将Huber损失直接引入最优传输代价（作用于个体传输位移而非传输距离）来构建分布型数据的稳健重心估计，实现了Wasserstein均值与L1型Wasserstein中位数之间的自然插值，并建立了完整的解析与统计理论基础。
AI.motivation: 分布型数据（distribution-valued data）的均值估计（如Wasserstein重心）对异常值敏感，而现有方法要么仅在优化后对Wasserstein距离施加Huber损失（度量空间Huber均值），要么缺乏对个体传输位移的细粒度鲁棒控制。作者希望构建一种既保留二次最优传输的局部行为、又能限制大位移影响的稳健重心估计，并为其提供严格的理论保证。
AI.method: 1) 将Huber损失直接嵌入最优传输代价函数，对个体传输位移（individual transport displacements）施加Huber损失，而非对整体Wasserstein距离施加。 2) 对带Huber损失的最优传输问题证明了对偶势的正则性与唯一性、最优传输映射的存在性，以及关于Huber参数的稳定性。 3) 对相应的重心问题证明了存在性、刻画、经验plug-in估计量的一致性，以及有限样本崩溃点（breakdown point）本质上等于1/2。 4) 在一维情形推导了逐点影响函数（influence function）和渐近分布，量化了鲁棒性-效率权衡，并比较了位移级Huber化与距离级Huber化在局部形状污染下的信息保留差异。 5) 通过数值实验验证稳健性及均值-中位数插值行为。
AI.result: 证明了Huber损失下的最优传输具有对偶势正则性、唯一性和传输映射存在性，以及Huber参数变化时的稳定性；重心问题具有存在性、一致性估计和近似1/2的有限样本崩溃点；一维情形下得到了影响函数和渐近分布，揭示了鲁棒性-效率权衡，并表明位移级Huber化在局部形状污染下能保留距离级Huber化所丢失的一阶信息。数值实验验证了所提重心的稳健性及其介于均值与中位数之间的行为。
AI.conclusion: 位移级Huber化的Huber-Wasserstein重心是分布型数据稳健估计的一种自然且理论完备的构造，它在Wasserstein均值和L1型Wasserstein中位数之间提供了可控的连续插值，同时兼具强鲁棒性（崩溃点约1/2）和良好的统计性质，特别在一维情形下具有完整的影响函数表征。

title: Quantifying nonclassicality in qubit systems via positive operator-valued measures
summary: We introduce an operational measure of nonclassicality for qubit systems based on the violation of Kolmogorov consistency conditions in sequential measurements. In contrast to previous work by Milz et al.~\cite{Milz-2020}, who characterized classicality via NCGD maps, and Sakuldee et al.~\cite{Sakuldee-2022a, Sakuldee-2022b}, who studied quantum correlations under measurement disturbance, our witness explicitly quantifies nonclassicality in terms of the POVM unsharpness parameter $a_z$. For projective measurements on an initially diagonal state, the witness vanishes identically, showing that such measurements cannot reveal nonclassicality. However, by generalizing to positive operator-valued measures (POVMs), we find that non-projective measurements can reveal nonclassicality even for diagonal initial states. We derive explicit expressions for the witness for general initial states, including coherences, and show that its maximum value is $1/4$, which is a new result achieved for unbiased POVMs, maximal dephasing, and equal initial populations. Our results connect Kolmogorov consistency, Leggett-Garg inequalities, and POVMs, providing an experimentally accessible tool for detecting nonclassicality in qubit systems with potential applications in quantum technology certification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于顺序测量中Kolmogorov一致性条件违反的qubit系统非经典性操作度量，该度量通过POVM不锐度参数a_z显式量化非经典性。投影测量在初始对角态下无法揭示非经典性，但非投影POVM测量即使在初始对角态下也能揭示非经典性，且该度量的最大值为1/4。
AI.motivation: 以往的经典性刻画工作（如Milz等人的NCGD映射方法和Sakuldee等人的测量扰动方法）未能以操作性的方式显式量化非经典性。作者旨在提供一个更直接、可实验验证的非经典性度量，该度量基于Kolmogorov一致性条件的违反，并与Leggett-Garg不等式和POVM建立联系。
AI.method: 作者基于顺序测量中Kolmogorov一致性条件的违反定义非经典性度量，该度量以POVM不锐度参数a_z明确表示。通过比较投影测量与POVM测量的情形，推导了一般初始态（包括相干项）下度量的显式表达式，并证明其最大值1/4在无偏POVM、最大去相干和等初始布居条件下取得。
AI.result: 度量在投影测量且初始态为对角态时恒为零；推广到POVM后，即使初始态为对角态也能检测到非经典性。度量最大值达到1/4，这是一个新的结果。该度量连接了Kolmogorov一致性、Leggett-Garg不等式与POVM框架。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了实验上可访问的qubit系统非经典性检测工具，可与现有经典性刻画方法互补，在量子技术认证中具有潜在应用价值。

title: Chance-constrained selection of sequential intervention strategies from counterfactual estimates
comment: 46 pages, 10 figures, 20 tables. Includes supplementary material as an appendix
summary: Many operational decisions are sequences of interventions under a cumulative resource limit, such as a maintenance schedule within a crew-hour budget. Choosing among them calls for the outcome and the cumulative cost each would produce, counterfactual quantities identified from observational data. Two strategies with the same expected cost can exceed the budget at very different rates, so constraining the mean does not bound how often an overrun occurs. Prior two-step architectures, recently extended to continuous doses, constrain the mean cost rather than its tail and allocate at a single decision point. Methods that do bound a cost tail take its distribution from a specified model rather than identifying it from data. We present a predict-then-optimize framework. In the prediction step, any estimator returning an outcome value and a cost distribution supplies what the decision rule consumes, so the predictor is interchangeable. In the optimization step, a chance-constrained selection over a finite candidate set bounds the probability that the cumulative cost exceeds the budget. That tail does not decompose across stages, so each strategy is scored whole. Sweeping the tolerated violation probability traces a safety-utility frontier, and distribution-free finite-sample bounds cover violation and outcome shortfall. Four of five environments, spanning clinical treatment and equipment maintenance, supply exact counterfactual ground truth; the fifth carries real outcomes from a digital-health micro-randomized trial. Across them, the rule holds the budget where a point-estimate rule overruns it, at an outcome cost the frontier makes explicit. All code is available at https://github.com/mfriendly/counterfactual-chance-selection

AI.tldr: 提出一个predict-then-optimize两阶段框架：预测阶段用任意可互换的估计器输出结果值和成本分布，优化阶段在有限候选集上进行机会约束选择，以界定累计成本超预算的概率，从而提供安全-效用前沿并给出无分布有限样本界。
AI.motivation: 许多运营决策是受累积资源限制的干预序列（如维护排程受工时预算约束）。传统方法只约束均值成本而非尾部，无法控制超预算过冲的频率；且现有两阶段架构只在单一决策点分配，能约束成本尾部的分布方法则依赖指定模型而非从数据识别。
AI.method: 提出predict-then-optimize框架：(1) 预测步骤，任何能返回结果值和成本分布的估计器都可被决策规则消费，预测器可互换；(2) 优化步骤，在有限候选集上进行机会约束选择，界定累计成本超过预算的概率。由于尾部不跨阶段分解，每个策略被整体评分。扫描可容忍违规概率生成安全-效用前沿，并提供无分布有限样本边界。
AI.result: 在五个环境中验证，其中四个提供精确反事实真值（涵盖临床治疗和设备维护），第五个采用数字健康微随机试验的真实结果。对比表明该方法在点估计规则超预算的环境中能守住预算，且前沿明确展示了对应的结果代价。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架能有效约束累计成本的尾部而非仅均值，在预算保持与结果效用之间提供了可量化的权衡，且预测器可互换增强了方法的通用性和可扩展性。代码已开源。

title: Robust controlled-Z gate for Rydberg atoms based on level-crossing-free echoing rapid adiabatic passage
summary: We propose a controlled-Z gate scheme for Rydberg atoms based on level-crossing-free echoing rapid adiabatic population transfer. We design antisymmetric Rabi frequency pulses and symmetric detuning pulses, enabling the system to completely avoid level-crossing points throughout the evolution, and the dynamical phase is naturally eliminated by the time-reversal symmetry of the double-pulse sequence. We incorporate dissipative effects through the Lindblad master equation. The numerical simulation yields a two-qubit CZ gate fidelity of 0.9999. When the Rabi-frequency fluctuation is within $\pm 2\%$, and the detuning offset is within $\pm 1\%$, the fidelity can still remain above 0.999. Under the same dissipative model, the three-qubit CCZ gate achieves a fidelity of 0.999. When a single-parameter fluctuation does not exceed $\pm 3\%$, the fidelity is always higher than 0.997. Our scheme requires no laser phase jumps or fast switching operations. The zero-area pulse structure suppresses first-order intensity noise, and the symmetric double-pulse sequence avoids spatially resolved laser switching, making it suitable for parallel gate operations in large-scale neutral-atom arrays.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于无交叉回波快速绝热布居转移的里德堡原子受控Z门方案，通过反对称拉比频率脉冲和对称失谐脉冲避免能级交叉，利用时间反演对称性消除动力学相位。数值模拟表明两量子比特CZ门保真度达0.9999，三量子比特CCZ门保真度达0.999，且对参数波动具有良好鲁棒性，无需激光相位跳变或快速开关，适用于大规模中性原子阵列的并行门操作。
AI.motivation: 传统里德堡原子CZ门的实现通常需要激光相位跳变或快速开关操作，且容易受到能级交叉和参数波动的影响，限制了门操作的保真度和可扩展性。作者旨在设计一种无需快速切换、对噪声鲁棒且适用于大规模中性原子阵列并行操作的受控Z门方案。
AI.method: 基于无交叉回波快速绝热布居转移（Echoing Rapid Adiabatic Population Transfer）设计CZ门方案。具体地，设计反对称拉比频率脉冲和对称失谐脉冲，使系统在整个演化过程中完全避免能级交叉点；利用双脉冲序列的时间反演对称性自然消除动力学相位；通过Lindblad主方程纳入耗散效应进行数值模拟。协议无需激光相位跳变或快速开关操作，零面积脉冲结构可抑制一阶强度噪声。
AI.result: 数值模拟结果表明：两量子比特CZ门保真度为0.9999；在拉比频率波动±2%和失谐偏移±1%范围内，保真度仍高于0.999；相同耗散模型下三量子比特CCZ门保真度为0.999；单参数波动不超过±3%时，保真度始终高于0.997。
AI.conclusion: 该方案在保持高保真度的同时，避免了激光相位跳变和快速开关操作的需求，显著降低了实验实现难度。零面积脉冲结构抑制一阶强度噪声，对称双脉冲序列避免空间分辨激光开关，使其特别适合大规模中性原子阵列中的并行门操作，为可扩展量子计算提供了实用方案。

title: Foundations of Independent Component Analysis
summary: We present the mathematical foundations of linear independent component analysis (ICA) models based on standard literature in a self-contained note. It is aimed at readers with a background in measure-theoretic probability theory. We first develop the theory of the characteristic functions of probability measures on $\mathbb{R}^d$, including their analyticity and the way in which they determine and characterise the distributions. We then focus on several identifiability results of ICA models with successively strengthened assumptions on the sources: from merely non-constant, to non-Gaussian, to Gaussian-free independent sources. Under the strictest assumptions, we show that the independent sources are identifiable up to translation, permutation, scales and signs, and this even in the presence of additive Gaussian noise. Furthermore, we present the online equivariant gradient descent ICA algorithm for recovering the independent sources from data, in the standard complete noiseless non-Gaussian ICA setting.

AI.tldr: 本文以自包含的形式阐述线性独立成分分析（ICA）模型的数学基础，基于测度论概率论背景，系统发展特征函数理论并给出不同假设强度下ICA模型的可识别性结果，同时介绍在线等变梯度下降ICA算法。
AI.motivation: ICA模型是信号处理和盲源分离中的重要工具，但其数学基础分散于多篇文献中，缺乏自包含且严谨的整理，尤其是面向具有测度论概率论背景读者的系统性阐述。作者希望填补这一空白。
AI.method: 首先系统构建R^d上概率测度特征函数的理论，包括其解析性质及对分布的确定与刻画作用；然后依次在源向量从非常数、非高斯到无高斯分量的渐强假设下，给出ICA模型的可识别性结果；最后在标准完备无噪声非高斯ICA设定下，给出在线等变梯度下降算法来恢复独立源。
AI.result: 在最严格假设（高斯无关的独立源）下，即使存在加性高斯噪声，独立源仍可在平移、置换、尺度和符号意义下被识别；算法部分提供了在线等变梯度下降方法用于数据中恢复独立源。
AI.conclusion: 本文为线性ICA模型提供了严谨且自包含的数学基础，明确了不同假设强度下的可识别性边界，并给出了可行的在线恢复算法，可作为相关研究者进入ICA理论领域的系统性参考。

title: Time-resolved correlation engineering in DLCZ Raman photon sources
summary: Memory-assisted quantum networks require photon sources with controllable temporal and correlation properties. The Duan-Lukin-Cirac-Zoller (DLCZ) protocol provides a platform based on spontaneous Raman scattering in atomic ensembles, but a unified predictive theory connecting control parameters to correlations under realistic propagation and noise conditions remains lacking. Here we present a propagation-inclusive open-system quantum theory that retains write-induced population redistribution while combining Heisenberg-Langevin dynamics with Maxwell-Schrödinger propagation. We experimentally validate its key predictions. The theory predicts time-dependent Stokes generation, spin-wave evolution, retrieved anti-Stokes wavepackets, and time-resolved cross-correlations. Experiments confirm robust correlations under retrieval tuning and enhanced correlations for shorter write pulses, consistent with the different scaling of correlated coincidences and accidental backgrounds with the mean spin-wave excitation number. Classically controlled retrieval enables temporal gating and slicing of the anti-Stokes wavepacket, establishing a quantitative framework for correlation engineering in memory-compatible DLCZ photon sources.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种包含传播效应的开放量子系统理论，用于预测DLCZ协议中存储器兼容光子源的关联特性，并通过实验验证了其在可控时域整形与关联工程方面的预测能力。
AI.motivation: DLCZ协议基于原子系综中的自发拉曼散射为量子网络提供了平台，但缺乏将控制参数与真实传播和噪声条件下的关联联系起来的统一预测理论。
AI.method: 构建传播包含的开放系统量子理论，保留写入诱导的粒子数重分布，将海森堡-朗之万动力学与麦克斯韦-薛定谔传播方程相结合，并进行实验验证。
AI.result: 理论成功预测了时间依赖的Stokes产生、自旋波演化、反Stokes波包检索及时间分辨互关联；实验证实了检索调谐下的稳健关联以及更短写入脉冲增强的关联；经典控制的检索实现了反Stokes波包的时间门控与切片。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为存储器兼容DLCZ光子源的关联工程建立了定量框架，弥补了理论预测与实验控制之间的空白。

title: The data geometry of masking diffusion: Certified-optimal schedules via unmasking growth complexity
summary: We study masking diffusion for discrete sampling and introduce a path-resolved measure of data geometry called the \emph{unmasking growth complexity} ({\textsf{UGC}\xspace}). Its local increments directly control Kullback--Leibler (KL) discretization error, yielding a unified analysis of Bernoulli-subset and fixed-cardinality unmasking schemes. In log-reveal-odds coordinates, this structure yields optimized single-block and multi-block schedules, and quantifies the gains from adapting computational effort to data geometry. Crucially, we show how {\textsf{UGC}\xspace} increments can be estimated from samples via KL increments along coupled reveal trajectories. This leads to \emph{certified-optimal} samplers that achieve a prescribed KL error with high probability and iteration complexity within a constant factor of the corresponding oracle procedure. Collapsing the \ugc path yields the aggregate {\textsf{UGC}\xspace} mass, which connects to classical multivariate dependence measures and complexity measures from previous analyses of discrete diffusion. In the fine-partition limit, the squared integral of the square-root {\textsf{UGC}\xspace} density determines the sharp leading-order optimal Euler discretization error. Examples exhibit substantial dimension-dependent gains over coarse schedules, including $\widetildeΩ(\sqrt{d})$ improvements achievable with a constant number of adaptively placed blocks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究离散扩散的掩码采样问题，提出一种称为"去掩码增长复杂度"(UGC)的路径解析数据几何度量。UGC的局部增量直接控制KL离散化误差，统一了Bernoulli子集和固定基数去掩码方案的分析。在log-reveal-odds坐标系中，该结构产生优化的单块和多块调度策略，并量化自适应计算精力带来的增益。作者展示了如何通过耦合揭示轨迹上的KL增量从样本中估计UGC增量，从而得到"认证最优"采样器，这些采样器能以高概率达到规定的KL误差，且迭代复杂度在Oracle过程的常数因子范围内。在精细划分极限下，平方根UGC密度的平方积分决定尖锐的首阶最优Euler离散化误差。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型中的掩码(masking)采样方法在生成建模中广泛使用，但对其离散化误差的理解缺乏统一的理论框架。现有分析通常针对特定调度策略或特定数据结构，无法量化数据几何对采样效率的影响，也难以实现自适应最优采样。
AI.method: 引入UGC度量刻画去掩码过程中的数据几何，利用其局部增量建立KL离散化误差的统一上界；在log-reveal-odds坐标下推导单块与多块的优化调度；通过耦合揭示轨迹的KL增量估计UGC，构建具有高概率KL误差保证和常数因子最优迭代复杂度的认证采样器。
AI.result: 在精细划分极限下，平方根UGC密度的平方积分精确决定首阶最优Euler离散化误差；实例显示自适应放置常数个块即可实现相对于粗调度的~Ω(√d)维度相关提升，表现出显著的维度依赖增益。
AI.conclusion: UGC为离散扩散采样提供了一种统一且可估计的几何框架，不仅实现理论最优的采样策略，还揭示了数据几何与离散化误差之间的定量联系，为自适应采样调度提供了坚实的理论基础。

title: Formal Verification of Quantum Ancilla Safety
summary: Ensuring ancilla safety is a critical correctness requirement for quantum compilation, since ancilla qubits are routinely introduced to implement complex operations with fewer gates and reduced depth. However, formally verifying this property is computationally hard due to state-space explosion in the number of qubits, particularly for dirty ancillae, which carry unknown initial states and must be restored after use. We propose an end-to-end verification-and-repair framework that rigorously addresses both clean and dirty ancilla safety. Our core contribution is a two-step reduction strategy: we first prove that verifying an $m$-qubit dirty ancilla register decomposes into $2m$ independent clean ancilla safety checks; subsequently, we reduce each clean ancilla safety instance to an algebraic commutativity check against Pauli-$Z$ and Pauli-$X$ operators. This approach yields an efficient and naturally parallel verifier and enables actionable diagnosis by classifying violations into logic errors and phase errors. Leveraging this diagnosis, we further design lightweight repair routines that append local single-qubit rotations to eliminate a broad class of local ancilla faults. We implement the full pipeline in a prototype tool using a dual-backend architecture combining decision diagrams and weighted model counting, and validate it on diverse circuits ranging from arithmetic benchmarks to Grover's algorithm. Our experiments demonstrate scalability to thousands of qubits and show that the proposed repairs effectively improve ancilla safety while preserving circuit functionality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种端到端的量子编译辅助量子比特（ancilla）安全性验证与修复框架，通过两步归约策略将脏辅助量子比特的验证问题分解为独立的清洁辅助比特安全性检查，并进一步归约为代数交换性检查，实现了可扩展到数千量子比特的高效验证与轻量级修复。
AI.motivation: 辅助量子比特（ancilla）是量子编译中常用的资源，用于以更少的门数和更浅的深度实现复杂操作。然而，确保ancilla安全性（即使用后恢复原状）是正确性验证的关键要求，形式化验证这一问题由于量子比特数量增加导致的状态空间爆炸而计算困难，尤其是脏ancilla（携带未知初始态）的验证更具挑战性。
AI.method: 提出两步归约策略：(1) 将m量子比特脏ancilla寄存器的验证分解为2m个独立的清洁ancilla安全性检查；(2) 将每个清洁ancilla安全性实例归约为针对Pauli-Z和Pauli-X算子的代数交换性检查。在此基础上，将违规分类为逻辑错误和相位错误，并设计轻量级修复例程（追加局部单量子比特旋转）来消除局部ancilla故障。实现采用双后端架构，结合决策图和加权模型计数。
AI.result: 在从算术基准到Grover算法的多种电路上验证了该框架，实验表明可扩展到数千个量子比特，且所提出的修复方法能有效改善ancilla安全性同时保持电路功能不变。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过数学归约将原本高复杂度的ancilla安全性验证问题简化为可并行的高效检查，并提供可操作的错误诊断与修复机制，为量子编译中的ancilla安全性保障提供了实用的端到端解决方案。

title: Exponential Convex Calibration Dimension for the Multi-Label Jaccard Measure
summary: The per-instance Jaccard score, or intersection over union (IoU), is standard in multi-label classification and binary segmentation. With $s$ labels, its loss matrix has $2^s$ outcomes and reports. Under the convention $\mathrm{Jac}(\varnothing,\varnothing)=1$, we prove that the Jaccard score, shifted-loss, and ordinary loss matrices are nonsingular and that the loss columns have affine dimension $2^s-1$. The proof combines a finite MinHash Gram representation with Boolean Möbius inversion. For exact calibration, we prove $2^{s-1} \leq \mathrm{CCdim}(L^{\mathrm{Jac}}) \leq 2^s-1$. The lower bound uses a factorially weighted distribution with $2^{s-1}+1$ supported outcomes and Bayes-optimal reports. Consequently, every exactly calibrated convex surrogate requires exponentially many prediction coordinates. We also give two polynomial-dimensional approximation guarantees with explicit regret transfers. A new $F_1$-to-Jaccard transfer turns an existing $(s^2+1)$-dimensional $F_1$ surrogate into a polynomial-time rule with asymptotic Jaccard regret at most $3-2\sqrt{2}$. For any $α>0$ and $0<ρ<1$, a MinHash square-loss surrogate attains Jaccard-regret floor $α$ uniformly over arbitrary conditional label distributions. With probability at least $1-ρ$, the direct construction has dimension $O((s^2+s\log(1/ρ))/α^2)$, while a signed variant has dimension $O((s+\log(1/ρ))/α^2)$. Thus zero-regret calibration requires exponential dimension, whereas every fixed additive regret tolerance admits polynomial prediction dimension.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多标签分类中逐实例Jaccard分数（IoU）的校准与风险转移问题。证明其损失矩阵非奇异且列仿射维度为2^s-1，给出精确校准的CC维界[2^{s-1}, 2^s-1]，意味着零遗憾校准需要指数维预测坐标；同时提出两种多项式维近似保证，包括F1到Jaccard的风险转移和MinHash平方损失的遗憾下界保证。
AI.motivation: Jaccard分数（IoU）是多标签分类和二分分割的标准评价指标，但其损失的校准性质和预测维度需求尚未被充分理解。核心动机是确定：要实现零遗憾校准需要多少预测维度？能否在多项式维度内实现固定遗憾容差的近似校准？
AI.method: 本文采用Boolean Möbius逆变换与有限MinHash Gram表示相结合的方法证明损失矩阵的非奇异性。校准维度下界通过构造因子加权分布和贝叶斯最优报告实现；近似保证方面，将现有(s^2+1)维F1代理转化为Jaccard风险转移，并提出基于MinHash的平方损失代理及其有符号变体以实现多项式维遗憾控制。
AI.result: 证明了Jaccard、平移损失和普通损失矩阵非奇异，损失列仿射维度为2^s-1；精确校准CC维满足2^{s-1} ≤ CCdim ≤ 2^s-1。F1到Jaccard的转移给出渐近Jaccard遗憾至多3-2√2；MinHash平方损失代理在任意条件标签分布上均匀实现α遗憾下限，直接构造维度O((s^2+s·log(1/ρ))/α^2)，有符号变体维度O((s+log(1/ρ))/α^2)。
AI.conclusion: 零遗憾校准本质上需要指数级预测维度，而固定的加性遗憾容差只需多项式预测维度即可实现，揭示了Jaccard指标校准确认中的一个基本维度分隔现象。

title: Controlling quantum transport by measurement-rate modulation
summary: Temporal modulation of the measurement rate provides a powerful mechanism for controlling open-system dynamics through measurement backaction. We demonstrate this mechanism in a minimal exactly solvable model of a continuously monitored quantum particle on a switching lattice. We derive exact analytical expressions for the long-time current under both periodic and stochastic switching, revealing a common slow-switching limit and identifying a measurement-induced crossover between Zeno- and anti-Zeno-dominated transport regimes that controls the direction of the current.

AI.tldr: 本文研究通过时间调制测量率来控制开放系统动力学，在最小可精确求解的连续监测量子粒子切换晶格模型中，推导了周期和随机切换下长时间电流的精确解析表达式，发现了测量诱导的量子Zeno与anti-Zeno输运机制交叉，该交叉控制电流方向。
AI.motivation: 测量反作用（measurement backaction）是开放量子系统动力学的核心机制之一，而时间调制测量率可能提供一种有力的控制手段。作者希望在一个可精确求解的最小模型中，从理论上揭示测量率时间调制如何影响量子粒子的输运行为。
AI.method: 构建一个连续监测的量子粒子在切换晶格（switching lattice）上的最小可精确求解模型。分别在周期切换和随机切换两种时间调制方案下，推导长时间电流的精确解析表达式，并比较两种方案的共同慢切换极限。
AI.result: 获得了周期与随机切换下长时间电流的精确解析解，识别出共同的慢切换极限行为，并发现了测量诱导的Zeno效应与anti-Zeno效应主导的输运区间的交叉，该交叉决定了电流方向。
AI.conclusion: 时间调制测量率可作为控制开放量子系统输运方向的有效手段，通过测量导致Zeno与anti-Zeno行为之间的交叉可以实现电流方向的可控切换，为基于测量反作用的量子输运调控提供了理论框架。

title: Defensive Boosting for Online Probabilistic Forecasting
summary:
We study online probabilistic forecasting of binary outcomes chosen by an adaptive adversary. Given an online learning algorithm for a weak hypothesis class $H$, we would like to efficiently obtain two incomparable guarantees that existing online boosting techniques provide separately. Online gradient boosting competes in Brier score with the best predictor induced by the span of $H$ on every sequence, but promises nothing when the span does not contain an accurate predictor. Online weak-to-strong boosting drives classification error to zero under a weak-learning condition, but promises little when that condition fails.
  We give a simple defensive forecasting algorithm, the Defensive Booster, that obtains both guarantees. On every adaptive sequence, its Brier score is competitive with the best prediction induced by the span of $H$ at the same rate as online gradient boosting; simultaneously, whenever the realized transcript satisfies the smooth weak-learning condition, its Brier score and randomized classification error satisfy the same rate guarantee as online classification boosting. This is achieved by operationalizing the "dual view" of boosting: When the algorithm's randomized classification error is persistently high, its mistake weights form a smooth reweighting on which every weak hypothesis has low edge, yielding an ex-post hard-core certificate that the weak-learning condition fails. We also develop a strongly adaptive variant, which satisfies both guarantees on every time interval. The Defensive Booster is very efficient: it accesses just one weak-class learner, whereas the prior online boosting methods we compare against maintain large weak-learner ensembles. Experiments on synthetic and real data streams demonstrate its strong predictive performance (sometimes substantially improving over all prior baselines) coupled with orders-of-magnitude faster runtime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Defensive Booster的防御性在线预测算法，通过操作化boosting的"对偶视角"，同时获得两种先前只能由不同在线boosting技术分别提供的保证：(1) 在Brier得分上与H的跨度诱导的最佳预测器竞争；(2) 在平滑弱学习条件下，分类误差率与在线分类boosting一致。该算法仅需一个弱学习器，效率极高，并通过实验验证了其优越的预测性能和大幅提升的运行速度。
AI.motivation: 现有的在线boosting方法只能单独提供两种不兼容的保证：在线梯度boosting在Brier得分上具有竞争力，但当地类外无准确预测器时没有保证；在线弱到强boosting在弱学习条件下能驱动分类误差到零，但条件不满足时保证不足。如何在一个算法中同时获得这两种保证是核心挑战。
AI.method: 提出了Defensive Booster算法，是一种防御性预测算法。其核心创新在于操作化boosting的"对偶视角"：当算法的随机分类误差持续较高时，其错误权重会形成一种平滑的重加权，使得所有弱假设的边(edge)都很低，从而提供事后硬核(hard-core)证据表明弱学习条件不成立。这实现了两种保证的自动切换。同时提出了强自适应变体，在任意时间区间上同时满足两种保证。算法只访问一个弱类学习器，而之前的在线boosting方法需要维护大型弱学习器集成。
AI.result: Defensive Booster在自适应序列上同时获得两种保证：Brier得分与在线梯度boosting同速率的竞争力，以及在平滑弱学习条件下与在线分类boosting同速率的Brier得分和随机分类误差保证。强自适应变体在任意时间区间上保持两种保证。该算法仅需一个弱学习器，而先前的在线boosting方法需要大型集成。在合成和真实数据流上的实验显示其预测性能强大（有时大幅超过所有先前基线），运行速度提升数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: Defensive Booster通过一个简单而高效的算法解决了在线boosting中两种重要保证不可兼得的困境。其理论贡献在于建立了防御性预测与在线boosting之间的联系，并通过对偶视角提供了事后可验证的弱学习条件失败证据。实际应用价值体现在其单学习器的高效性、快速的运行时间以及优越的预测性能，使其成为在线概率预测和分类的有力工具。

title: Classical Simulation and Design Frontiers for IBM's Doped Clifford Sampling Experiment
summary: We classically simulate the IBM doped Clifford random circuit sampling experiment, comprising $70$ qubits, $70$ entangling layers, and $468$ inserted $T$ gates. A deterministic temporal-boundary tensor network contraction approach is specifically designed to tackle such open-boundary one-dimensional brickwork circuits with operator-Schmidt-rank-$2$ entangling gates. For an $n$-qubit circuit of depth $d$, the resulting unsliced path evaluates an exact amplitude with contraction width $\lceil d/2\rceil$; Ratcatcher calculations certify that no smaller width is possible for the tested instances. Because one-qubit gates are absorbed without changing the network topology, the width and dense scheduled contraction cost are independent of their values and of the number and placement of $T$ gates. For the IBM instance, its largest intermediate tensor contains $2^{35}$ complex64 entries (256 times smaller than IBM's estimation), corresponding to a tensor payload of $256$ GiB, and is distributed across eight GPUs within a node. Using 32 nodes, with eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs per node, we completed all 2051 amplitude batches corresponding to IBM's published output bitstrings in 37.3 minutes. The resulting probabilities yield a log-XEB estimate of $0.35034$ with a 95\% interval of $[0.29763,0.40305]$. Under the Porter--Thomas and scrambled-noise assumptions, this is numerically compatible with IBM's fidelity lower bound; separately, fidelity-weighted resource accounting projects a 583-contraction workload with a 10.6-minute makespan on the same 32 nodes. More broadly, the approach provides a practical diagnostic for experimental outputs and a quantitative tool for designing future doped Clifford sampling experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文对IBM 70量子比特、70层纠缠、468个T门的掺杂Clifford随机电路采样实验进行了经典模拟。作者设计了面向开放边界一维砖墙电路和张量缩并的方法，通过时间边界张量网络收缩，在32个节点（每节点8块NVIDIA H100 GPU）上37.3分钟内完成了所有2051个振幅批次的计算，得到log-XEB估计0.35034，与IBM的保真度下界数值兼容。
AI.motivation: 验证和挑战IBM声称的量子优势掺杂Clifford随机电路采样实验，证明此类实验可以被经典计算高效模拟，并为未来掺杂Clifford采样实验的设计提供定量诊断工具。
AI.method: 采用确定性的时间边界张量网络收缩方法，专门针对具有算子Schmidt秩为2纠缠门的开放边界一维砖墙电路。该方法吸收单量子比特门而不改变网络拓扑，使收缩宽度和调度成本与单比特门取值及T门数量和位置无关；对于n量子比特深度d的电路，未切片路径的精确振幅收缩宽度为⌈d/2⌉，并由Ratcatcher计算验证其最优性。
AI.result: 对于IBM实例，最大中间张量含2^35个complex64条目（比IBM估计小256倍），即256 GiB，分布在单节点8块GPU上。使用32个节点共256块H100 GPU，在37.3分钟内完成全部2051个振幅批次，得到log-XEB估计0.35034（95%置信区间[0.29763,0.40305]）。在Porter-Thomas和杂乱噪声假设下与IBM保真度下界数值兼容；保真度加权资源估算预测583次收缩负载，32节点上10.6分钟即可完成。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功以远低于IBM预期计算成本的方式经典模拟了70比特掺杂Clifford采样实验，为实验输出提供了实用诊断工具，并为设计未来掺杂Clifford采样实验提供了定量设计指南。

title: Controlled dynamics of a multi-component discrete-time quantum walker
summary: We investigate a discrete-time quantum walk of a three-component quantum particle on a one-dimensional lattice. As coin operators, we employ parameterized rotations generated by the Gell-Mann matrices, which enable systematic tuning of the couplings between the internal components. We analyze how these couplings influence and control the dynamics by systematically exploring the position-space probability distribution across a broad region of the parameter space. To quantify the impact of different inter-component couplings, we further examine the ratio of the mean position to the variance in each half of the lattice. Our results indicates that the system supports a rich variety of transport regimes, ranging from nearly symmetric, rapidly spreading walks to strongly anisotropic dynamics with partial localization. This framework thus provides a new avenue for engineering targeted spreading and trapping behavior in multicomponent discrete-time quantum walks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在一维晶格上运行的三分量离散时间量子行走，采用由Gell-Mann矩阵生成的参数化旋转作为硬币算子，系统探索了参数空间中不同内部耦合对动力学的影响，发现了从近对称快速扩散到强各向异性部分局域化的多种输运机制。
AI.motivation: 离散时间量子行走是多分量量子粒子动力学的重要平台，但此前对三分量系统内部耦合如何影响和控制动力学的研究尚不充分，缺乏系统性的参数空间探索。
AI.method: 采用Gell-Mann矩阵生成参数化旋转作为硬币算子来调节内部分量间的耦合，通过系统扫描宽泛参数空间分析位置空间概率分布，并利用每半晶格中平均位置与方差的比值来量化不同分量间耦合的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现该系统支持丰富的输运机制，从近乎对称且快速扩散的行走到强各向异性伴随部分局域化的动力学不等。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为在多分量离散时间量子行走中工程化定向扩展和捕获行为提供了新途径。

title: Witnessing the architecture of quantum circuits
summary: Determining whether a target unitary can be implemented within a prescribed quantum circuit architecture is a fundamental problem in quantum information, with direct implications for optimisation and compilation of quantum circuits, and hardware-efficient quantum computation. While existing synthesis and compilation methods are primarily constructive, they generally do not provide rigorous certificates that a unitary cannot be realised using given implementation resources. Here we introduce a general framework to define quantum circuit architecture witnesses, which certify the incompatibility of a unitary transformation with a specified quantum circuit architecture. We formulate the witness construction as a semidefinite program by maximising the fidelity between the Choi state of the target unitary and those of tested circuits. The resulting witnesses provide practical and quantitative certificates of incompatibility, implying lower bounds on implementation resources such as the gate count or circuit depth, and can also be used experimentally to benchmark quantum devices by certifying that an implemented unitary channel goes beyond the capabilities of a given circuit architecture. For Clifford unitaries, we exploit the stabiliser formalism to reduce the construction to linear programming, enabling both more efficient numerical certification for circuits containing on the order of seven two-qubit gates, and analytical witnesses for some families of architectures made of an arbitrary number of gates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通用的量子电路架构见证（quantum circuit architecture witness）框架，通过将见证构造转化为半定规划（SDP）问题（最大化目标酉算子Choi态与测试电路Choi态之间的保真度），严格证明某个酉变换无法在给定的量子电路架构中实现。对于Clifford酉算子，利用稳定子形式化将问题简化为线性规划，可高效处理约七个双量子比特门的电路，并为任意数目门的架构族提供解析见证。
AI.motivation: 现有的综合和编译方法主要是构造性的，一般无法提供严格的证据证明某个酉算子无法在给定的实现资源下实现。本文旨在填补这一空白，为量子电路架构不兼容性提供严格的认证框架。
AI.method: 通过最大化目标酉算子的Choi态与待测电路Choi态之间的保真度，将见证构造形式化为半定规划（SDP）问题。所得见证提供实用且定量的不兼容性证明，暗示门数或电路深度等实现资源的下界。对于Clifford酉算子，利用稳定子形式化将构造简化为线性规划（LP），提高数值认证效率，并能构造解析见证。
AI.result: 该框架能提供实用且定量的不兼容性证书，给出实现资源（如门数、电路深度）的下界；可用于实验上基准测试量子设备，认证实际实现的酉通道超出给定电路架构的能力。对于Clifford酉算子，线性规划方法可高效认证包含约七个双量子比特门的电路，并能得到任意门数架构族的解析见证。
AI.conclusion: 量子电路架构见证为量子电路编译与优化中的不可实现性问题提供了严格的数学认证工具，兼具理论普适性（SDP框架）与实际可扩展性（Clifford情形下的LP简化），在量子硬件基准测试和高效量子计算验证中具有重要应用价值。

title: Entanglement distribution and quantum storage of more than 8000 modes over a metropolitan network
summary: Entanglement generation between telecommunication photons and matter is central to fibre-based quantum repeaters. Achieving practical communication rates requires multiplexing, which multimode quantum memories can provide.
