Rare-earth-ion ensembles offer large temporal multimode storage by exploiting the numerous spectral channels within their absorption spectrum. Here, we report on a quantum repeater node comprised of a $^{171}$Yb$^{3+}$:Y$_2$SiO$_5$ multimode quantum memory, featuring a 250 MHz bandwidth and a $76.6~μ\mathrm{s}$ lifetime, and a bandwidth-matched entangled photon-pair source. We introduce and validate a quantitative measure of the effective temporal mode capacity using a Schmidt decomposition. With this platform, we demonstrate entanglement between a telecom photon propagating through a 25.3 km fiber spool and a 979 nm photon stored for $125~μ\mathrm{s}$ across 16340 temporal modes. Finally, we report a field deployment distributing entanglement over 5.66 km through the Geneva metropolitan fibre network while storing 8235 modes for $63~μ\mathrm{s}$.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了一个基于171Yb3+:Y2SiO5多模量子存储器的量子中继节点，实现了电信波段光子与物质之间的纠缠生成。该平台具备250 MHz带宽和76.6 μs存储寿命，利用Schmidt分解引入并验证了有效时间模式容量的定量度量。研究展示了电信光子经过25.3 km光纤传输后与存储在164万个时间模式上的979 nm光子之间的纠缠，并在日内瓦都市光纤网络中进行了5.66 km的现场部署演示。
AI.motivation: 实现基于光纤的量子中继器需要电信光子与物质系统之间的纠缠生成，而实际通信速率需要多路复用（multiplexing）能力。稀土离子掺杂晶体凭借其吸收光谱中的大量光谱通道，能够提供大规模的时间模式多路复用存储能力，是实现高速率量子通信的关键平台。
AI.method: 采用171Yb3+:Y2SiO5稀土离子多模量子存储器（带宽250 MHz、寿命76.6 μs），结合带宽匹配的纠缠光子对源。引入Schmidt分解作为定量度量有效时间模式容量的工具，并验证了该方法的有效性。实验通过电信光子与979 nm存储光子之间的纠缠来评估系统性能。
AI.result: 实现了电信光子经25.3 km光纤传输后与存储在16340个时间模式上（125 μs）的979 nm光子之间的纠缠。在日内瓦都市光纤网络中完成5.66 km的现场部署，成功存储8235个模式，存储时间63 μs。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了基于稀土离子多模量子存储器的量子中继节点在实际光纤网络环境中的可行性，大规模时间模式多路复用能力显著提升了量子通信速率潜力，为未来建设高速率、长距离量子中继网络奠定了重要实验基础。

title: Mid-circuit ground-state cooling and ancilla readout in the $\textit{omg}$ architecture
summary: The trapped-ion optical-metastable-ground ($\textit{omg}$) architecture for quantum processors promises the full functionality of two-species experiments, including sympathetic cooling and non-destructive ancilla readout, without the corresponding hardware overhead. We confirm that we can cool a global motional mode of a mixed metastable-ground state Coulomb crystal to the motional ground state via dissipative operations on the ground ($\textit{g}$) qubit without disturbing coherence of the metastable ($\textit{m}$) qubit. This enables quantum logic spectroscopy to non-destructively readout the state of the $\textit{m}$ qubit using fluorescence detection of the $\textit{g}$ qubit. Extensions of these demonstrations to larger system sizes should enable the mitigation of motional heating after ion shuttling and syndrome extraction for quantum error correction, both crucial primitives for future fault-tolerant quantum computers based on trapped ions.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了被困离子OMG架构中，通过在地态qubit上进行耗散操作即可将混合亚稳态-基态库仑晶体的全局运动模式冷却至基态，且不扰动亚稳态qubit的相干性，实现利用基态qubit荧光检测对亚稳态qubit进行非破坏性量子逻辑谱读取，为容错量子计算的关键原语铺平道路。
AI.motivation: 传统双物种离子阱实验虽能提供同情冷却和非破坏性辅助读取功能，但硬件开销过大。OMG架构旨在仅用单一离子物种的不同电子态（基态和亚稳态）实现同样的全功能，从而消除硬件冗余。本文核心动机是验证该架构的关键冷却与读取可行性。
AI.method: 采用混合基态-亚稳态库仑晶体，对混合离子体系的全局运动模式施加基于耗散的激光冷却策略，仅作用于基态qubit，同时监测亚稳态qubit的相干性是否保持；随后利用量子逻辑谱技术，通过基态qubit的荧光检测对亚稳态qubit进行非破坏性状态读取。
AI.result: 成功将混合基态-亚稳态的全局运动模式冷却至运动基态，且在冷却过程中亚稳态qubit的相干性未受扰动；实现了基于基态qubit荧光检测的亚稳态qubit非破坏性读取。
AI.conclusion: 该演示为OMG架构在更大系统中的扩展奠定基础，有望缓解离子穿梭后的运动加热问题并支持量子纠错的症候提取，这是未来基于被困离子的容错量子计算机的关键原语。

title: Counter-examples for Tensorization Property of Strong Data Processing Inequality for Quantum Divergences
summary: The data processing inequality is a fundamental property that describes the loss of information through noisy channels. A more refined description is characterized by the strong data processing inequality (SDPI). In classical information theory, the tensorization of strong data processing inequality holds for a whole family of $f$-divergences. However, its quantum counterpart is less known. The tensorization of SDPI was shown only for some special cases previously, and the general understanding about the tensorization property of SDPI for quantum divergences remains open. In this work, we report two negative results: the tensorization property fails for certain quantum chi-square divergences, and it also does not hold for the quantum relative entropy.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了两个关于量子散度强数据处理不等式（SDPI）张量化的负面结果：对于某些量子卡方散度，张量化性质不成立；对于量子相对熵，张量化性质同样不成立。
AI.motivation: 在经典信息论中，强数据处理不等式（SDPI）的张量化性质对于整个f-散度族都成立，但这一性质在量子信息论中的对应情况尚不清楚。此前仅在一些特殊情形下证明了SDPI的张量化，量子散度SDPI张量化性质的普适理解仍然是一个开放性难题。
AI.method: 本文通过构造具体的反例来证明两个负面结果：针对一类量子卡方散度，以及量子相对熵，分别证伪了SDPI张量化性质的普适成立性。
AI.result: 获得了两个负面结果：（1）张量化性质对某些量子卡方散度不成立；（2）张量化性质对量子相对熵不成立。
AI.conclusion: 量子散度的SDPI张量化性质并不是普适成立的，这与经典信息论形成鲜明对比。这揭示了量子散度与经典f-散度在张量化性质上的根本差异，为量子信息论中SDPI的适用边界提供了重要的反面证据。

title: Ion trap on borosilicate substrate with integrated femtosecond-laser-written waveguide
summary: We present an ion-trap platform on borosilicate glass with an integrated femtosecond-laser-written waveguide for on-chip light delivery. The optical layer is physically separated from the electrode substrate and bonded atop the trap, remaining compatible with silicon-based integration. We engineer single-mode low-loss guidance at 729 nm with tunable mode-field diameter and achieve low-loss curved waveguides down to a radius of curvature of 6 mm. We also extend single-mode operation to a wavelength of 405 nm. The fabrication process is compatible with the industrial fabrication of a single-metal-layer surface-electrode trap, including active fiber alignment and bonding. We validate the platform in a cryogenic trapped-ion system with $^{40}$Ca$^+$, demonstrating trapping, shuttling the ion to a zone in front of the waveguide, and coherent operations driven by 729 nm light delivered through the integrated waveguide. We characterize the effect of the exposed dielectric on the ion and measure stray electric fields that show slow drift at a timescale of hours. The architecture is compatible with hybrid micro-optics (e.g. pick-and-place lenses) to realize single ion addressing and provides a robust, scalable route to integrated light delivery for trapped-ion devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于硼硅酸盐玻璃的离子阱平台，集成飞秒激光刻写波导用于片上光传输。光学层与电极基板物理分离并键合在阱上方，在729 nm和405 nm波长下实现单模低损耗传输（弯曲半径可低至6 mm），并在低温捕获离子系统中用^40Ca^+验证了离子捕获、穿梭以及通过波导传输729 nm光驱动的相干操作。
AI.motivation: 传统离子阱系统依赖于自由空间光学或光纤传输来输送激光到离子位置，光路对准复杂、体积大、扩展性差。为了实现大规模可扩展的量子计算/模拟，需要一种稳健、可规模化、与工业制造兼容的集成化光传输方案，将光信号高效地输送到阱内离子附近。
AI.method: 在硼硅酸盐玻璃基底上用飞秒激光直写技术制备单模波导，并将其作为独立光学层与电极基板物理分离后键合在表面电极阱上方。通过优化波导设计实现729 nm及405 nm波长下的单模低损耗传输，实现弯曲半径低至6 mm的弯曲波导，并与单金属层表面电极阱的工业制造工艺（包括光纤主动对准和键合）兼容。
AI.result: 在低温捕获离子系统中，用^40Ca^+离子验证了平台功能：成功实现离子捕获、将离子穿梭至波导前方区域，并通过集成波导传输的729 nm光驱动离子相干操作。表征了暴露介电材料对离子的影响，测得杂散电场在小时量级时间尺度上存在缓慢漂移。
AI.conclusion: 该架构与混合微光学（如pick-and-place透镜）兼容，可实现单离子寻址，为捕获离子器件提供了一条稳健、可扩展的集成光传输路线，且与硅基集成兼容，具有良好的工业可制造性前景。

title: Heterogeneously Integrated Squeezed-Light Generation and Detection on a Single Photonic Chip
summary: Squeezed light underpins quantum-enhanced sensing and continuous-variable quantum information processing, and integrated photonics offers a route to producing it at scale. Universal to these applications are squeezed-light generation and measurement. Importantly, quantum measurements serve not only as readout but also as active operations in quantum-state evolution. However, integrating squeezed-light generation and photodetection on the same photonic chip has remained challenging because they impose fundamentally conflicting material requirements: low optical loss to preserve quantum correlations, but efficient photon absorption for photodetection. Here, we demonstrate squeezed-light generation, routing, and balanced homodyne detection integrated on a single photonic chip through heterogeneous integration. A two-mode squeezed quantum microcomb comprising 34 quantum modes is measured with approximately 3 dB squeezing. Our work establishes a scalable architecture for fully integrated squeezed-light quantum photonic systems, unifying quantum-state generation, processing, and detection on a single chip.

AI.tldr: 通过异构集成技术，在单个光子芯片上实现了压缩光生成、路由和平衡零差检测的完整集成，测量到包含34个量子模式的二模压缩量子微梳，压缩度约3 dB，为全集成量子光子芯片建立了可扩展架构。
AI.motivation: 压缩光是量子增强传感和连续变量量子信息处理的基础，集成光子学是规模化产生压缩光的重要途径。然而，压缩光生成和光电检测需要在同一芯片上集成，二者对材料的要求本质矛盾：压缩光生成需要低光学损耗以保持量子关联，而光电检测需要高效的光子吸收。此前在单一芯片上实现两者的集成一直极具挑战性。
AI.method: 采用异构集成（heterogeneous integration）技术，将压缩光生成、路由和平衡零差检测集成在单个光子芯片上。利用量子微梳产生二模压缩光，包含34个量子模式，并通过平衡零差检测进行测量。
AI.result: 成功在单个光子芯片上演示了压缩光生成、路由和平衡零差检测的完整集成，实现了包含34个量子模式的二模压缩量子微梳，压缩度约为3 dB，验证了全集成方案的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了全集成压缩光量子光子系统的可扩展架构，首次将量子态生成、处理和检测统一到单个芯片上，解决了材料相容性这一根本难题，为大规模量子光子芯片的应用铺平了道路。

title: Homomorphic Aggregation of Continuous-Variable GKP States
summary: Aggregating logical quantum information encoded in continuous-variable phase space is essential for distributed quantum computing. However, passive linear optics fail for non-Gaussian Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) codes due to symplectic lattice compression and entanglement-induced decoherence. We present an active, measurement-based framework for the homomorphic aggregation of multi-node GKP states. Utilizing GKP Bell states and homodyne feed-forward, we construct a completely positive trace-preserving map that computes the logical sum of distributed states while preserving the logical code space geometry up to correctable finite-squeezing deformations. We prove this protocol operates as an approximate quantum non-demolition measurement, bound its cryptographic leakage for continuous one-time pads, and derive analytical logical fidelity limits under finite-squeezing constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于主动测量和补偿的框架，用于对多节点连续变量GKP量子比特进行同态聚合，通过GKP贝尔态和零差前馈构建完全正迹保护映射，在有限压缩约束下计算分布式量子态的逻辑和，并证明其作为近似量子非破坏测量、界定密码泄漏和逻辑保真度极限。
AI.motivation: 分布式量子计算需要聚合连续变量相空间中编码的逻辑量子信息，但无源线性光学对非高斯GKP码因辛格点阵压缩和纠缠诱导退相干而失效，因此需要一种能在多节点间实现GKP态同态聚合的主动方案。
AI.method: 利用GKP贝尔态和零差前馈补偿构建完全正迹保护(CPTP)映射，实现分布GKP态的逻辑和聚合计算，同时保持逻辑码空间几何使其仅产生可修正的有限压缩变形。通过量子非破坏测量框架分析协议性质，并对连续一次性密码本的密码学泄漏与有限压缩下的逻辑保真度进行解析推导。
AI.result: 证明了该协议可作为近似量子非破坏测量运作，给出了连续一次性密码本的密码泄漏上界，并推导了有限压缩约束下逻辑保真度的解析极限。
AI.conclusion: 该主动测量框架突破了无源线性光学对非高斯GKP态聚合的限制，为分布式连续变量量子计算中的逻辑信息同态聚合提供了具有可证明保真度和安全性边界的可行方案。

title: Heat transport in driven quantum systems: Comparison between the Floquet-Redfield equation and the master equation in the instantaneous eigenbasis
summary: We provide a comprehensive study of heat transport in periodically driven quantum systems using a combination of master equation and Floquet approach. We give exact results (within the weak coupling Redfield theory, with no Markovian or secular approximations) and compare them with alternative approaches involving further approximations. Numerical and analytical results obtained in their appropriate driving regimes are provided for the driven spin boson-model. The adiabatic regime, which is relevant to thermal machines, is discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文利用主方程与Floquet方法相结合，对周期性驱动的量子系统中的热输运进行了全面研究。在弱耦合Redfield理论框架下（不做Markovian或secular近似）给出精确结果，并与采用进一步近似的其他方法进行比较，对驱动自旋-玻色子模型在相应驱动区间内提供了数值和解析结果，并讨论了与热机相关的绝热区间。
AI.motivation: 周期性驱动的量子系统在量子热机、量子制冷机等热力学应用中具有重要意义，但目前缺乏在弱耦合Redfield理论框架下不做额外近似的精确热输运结果，需要系统性地研究驱动机制下热流的精确描述。
AI.method: 结合主方程（master equation）和Floquet理论，在弱耦合Redfield框架内（不做Markovian或secular近似）导出精确热输运表达式，并在相应驱动区间内对驱动自旋-玻色子模型进行数值与解析求解，同时与引入进一步近似的方法进行对比。
AI.result: 给出了弱耦合Redfield理论下精确的热输运结果，获得了驱动自旋-玻色子模型在相应驱动区间内的数值与解析解，并明确了不同近似方法在各驱动区间内的适用性与偏差。
AI.conclusion: 在Redfield理论框架下可精确描述周期性驱动系统的热输运，无需Markovian或secular近似即可获得可靠结果；绝热区间（对热机应用尤为重要）得到了充分的讨论与分析。

title: Phase information transfer by post-selection in Spin--Mechanical assisted magnetometry
summary: Quantum information transfer between light-matter-type systems is poised to enable important applications, while also serving as a testbed for theoretical investigation. Such systems can be realized with spins coupled to a mechanical oscillator, a platform that has been extensively studied both theoretically and experimentally. Early demonstrations of quantum information transfer have relied mostly on coherent control. However, measurement-induced backaction has emerged as a strong alternative for quantum control. In this work we use post-selection on the spin system as a selective backaction to refocus spin's phase information onto the mechanical oscillator. We identify physical resources and operating regimes that govern conditional phase transfer, including oscillator quantum coherence, the number of spins, the mechanical initial state, coupling strength, oscillator amplitude, and relaxation. We benchmark different scenarios using the variance as the figure of merit, estimated via two complementary approaches: a semiclassical variance estimator and a Pegg-Barnett quantum estimator. The Cramér-Rao bound is also computed for comparison. The analysis provides a framework for understanding phase transfer in high-dimensional hybrid quantum systems and for measurement-induced backaction used in quantum magnetometry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自旋-机械振子混合量子系统中，通过后选择实现对自旋相位信息到机械振子的条件性量子信息传递。利用测量诱导的反作用（measurement-induced backaction），通过对自旋系统进行后选择，将自旋相位信息重新聚焦到机械振子。作者识别了控制条件相位传递的物理资源和工作区间（如振子量子相干性、自旋数量、机械初始态、耦合强度、振子振幅和弛豫），并使用方差作为性能指标，通过半经典方差估计器和Pegg-Barnett量子估计器两种互补方法进行评估，同时计算Cramér-Rao下界进行比较。
AI.motivation: 早期量子信息传递的演示主要依赖相干控制，但测量诱导的反作用作为量子控制的强有力替代方案尚未被充分探索。在自旋-机械振子这类高维混合量子系统中，理解条件相位传递的物理机制和资源，对于量子磁力测量等应用具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用后选择机制作为选择性反作用，将自旋相位信息传递到机械振子系统。通过两个互补的估计方法（半经典方差估计器和Pegg-Barnett量子估计器）对相位传递性能进行量化，并与Cramér-Rao下界进行比较，系统扫描影响传递效率的多个物理参数。
AI.result: 识别出控制条件相位传递的关键物理资源和工作区间，包括振子量子相干性、自旋数量、机械初始态、耦合强度、振子振幅与弛豫等因素。两种互补的估计方法为相位传递性能提供了完整评估，并与Cramér-Rao界建立了对比基准。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解高维混合量子系统中的相位传递以及测量诱导反作用在量子磁力测量中的应用提供了统一的理论框架。

title: Robust Genuine Multipartite Entanglement in Two Walker Quantum Walks
summary: Discrete-time quantum walks provide a versatile framework for investigating the generation, redistribution, and transport of quantum correlations in composite quantum systems. Here, we study the dynamics of bipartite and genuine multipartite entanglement in a two-walker discrete-time quantum walk on a one-dimensional lattice. By employing logarithmic negativity and the generalized geometric measure (GGM), we systematically characterize the redistribution of bipartite entanglement among different subsystem partitions and the emergence of genuine multipartite entanglement involving the two coin and two position degrees of freedom. We show that the entanglement dynamics are strongly influenced by the lattice topology. The open-boundary regime exhibits a monotonic redistribution of quantum correlations, whereas the closed-boundary regime gives rise to pronounced oscillatory behavior due to boundary-induced interference and recurrent wave-packet overlap. In the open-boundary regime, the GGM rapidly approaches its theoretical maximum value of $1/2$ and remains largely insensitive to the choice of the initial Bell state as well as to continuous variations of the local coin operator over a broad parameter range, except near the Pauli-$X$ coin. These results demonstrate that maximal genuine multipartite entanglement generation is a robust and generic feature of open-boundary two-walker discrete-time quantum walks, establishing them as promising platforms for engineering multipartite quantum correlations in quantum information processing and quantum simulation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了二维离散时间量子行走中两个行走者之间的二分纠缠和真正多体纠缠动力学，揭示了晶格拓扑（开放边界vs闭合边界）对纠缠演化的关键影响。开放边界条件下，广义几何度量（GGM）迅速趋近理论最大值1/2，且对初始贝尔态选择和局域硬币算符的变化高度鲁棒，表明开放边界双行走者离散时间量子行走是生成最大真正多体纠缠的通用平台。
AI.motivation: 离散时间量子行走是研究复合量子系统中量子关联的生成、再分配和输运的通用框架。理解和调控量子行走中多体纠缠的动力学特性，对于量子信息处理和量子模拟中的应用至关重要，特别是在不同晶格拓扑条件下纠缠行为的系统性表征尚不充分。
AI.method: 采用对数负度（logarithmic negativity）和广义几何度量（GGM）两种纠缠度量，系统研究了在一维晶格上双行走者离散时间量子行走中不同子系分区的二分纠缠再分配以及涉及两个硬币和两个位置自由度的真正多体纠缠的产生。分别考察了开放边界和闭合边界两种边界条件下的纠缠动力学。
AI.result: 研究发现纠缠动力学强烈依赖晶格拓扑：开放边界条件下量子关联呈单调再分配，GGM迅速接近理论最大值1/2，且对初始贝尔态选择及局域硬币算符的大范围连续变化不敏感（仅在Pauli-X硬币附近例外）；闭合边界条件下则因边界诱导干涉和波包周期性重叠产生显著的振荡行为。
AI.conclusion: 最大真正多体纠缠的产生是开放边界双行走者离散时间量子行走的鲁棒且普通的特征，确立了该系统作为工程化多体量子关联的可行平台，在量子信息处理和量子模拟中具有广阔应用前景。

title: Quantum-Inspired Phase Bicoherence Spectroscopy: A Framework for Detecting Universal Textural Angular Order Across Multi-Modal Complex Datasets
summary: Classical image analysis routinely discards structurally meaningful orientation signatures encoded within Fourier phase, which are easily corrupted by local cellular rotation. Although quantum-inspired data processing offers new avenues for complex signal characterization, practical tools for directly extracting gauge-invariant angular correlations without explicit phase reconstruction remain scarce. Here we introduce Quantum Phase Bicoherence (QPBC) spectroscopy, a novel quantum-interferometric framework for capturing gauge-invariant angular order. The method embeds image angular sectors into a nine-qubit entangled state and probes three-body bicoherence via an ancilla, yielding 16 interpretable readout channels. We validate our framework on three independent public multi-modal imaging datasets covering fluorescence (BBBC021), bright-field (BBBC041) and histopathology (PathMNIST). QPBC consistently resolves angular-phase order and discriminates distinct biological phenotypes with high statistical significance. After principal-axis alignment, the optimal probing frequency universally converges, driven by Fourier directional sensitivity; negative-control experiments fully eliminate discriminative capacity, demonstrating frequency tuning acts as an on-off switch. Cross-dataset benchmarks confirm QPBC outperforms conventional Fourier-phase statistics, where inherent inversion symmetry serves as a built-in pipeline self-check. QPBC delivers a universal, classically unachievable quantitative texture observable, establishes interpretable quantum morphometry, and broadens the toolbox for quantum-inspired analysis applicable to diverse multi-modal microscopic measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出量子相位双相干（QPBC）光谱学，一种基于九量子比特纠缠态和辅助量子比特的量子干涉测量框架，用于提取图像中规范不变的角向序特征，无需显式相位重构。该框架在三个公共多模态成像数据集（荧光、明场、组织病理）上验证，能高统计显著性区分生物表型，并超越传统傅里叶相位统计。
AI.motivation: 经典图像分析通常丢弃傅里叶相位中编码的结构性取向信息，而这些信息容易被局部细胞旋转破坏。虽然量子启发的数据处理为复杂信号表征提供了新途径，但缺乏无需显式相位重构即可直接提取规范不变角向关联的实际工具。
AI.method: 将图像角向扇区嵌入九量子比特纠缠态，通过辅助量子比特探测三体双相干性（bicoherence），输出16个可解释的读出通道。训练/分析流程包括主轴对齐以及频率调谐；通过负对照实验验证频率调谐作为开关机制。
AI.result: 在BBBC021（荧光）、BBBC041（明场）和PathMNIST（组织病理）三个公共数据集上，QPBC持续解析角相位序并高统计显著性区分不同生物表型。主轴对齐后最优探测频率普遍收敛到由傅里叶方向敏感性驱动的值；负对照实验完全消除判别能力；跨数据集基准显示QPBC优于传统傅里叶相位统计，且内置的反演对称性作为流程自检机制。
AI.conclusion: QPBC提供了一种通用、经典不可实现的定量纹理观测量，建立了可解释的量子形态学（quantum morphometry），扩展了适用于多种多模态显微测量的量子启发性分析工具箱。

title: Universal magic state concentration
summary: Magic plays a dual role in quantum computation: it promotes stabilizer dynamics from efficient classical simulability to universality, but it presents a central challenge for fault tolerance, since non-stabilizer operations are harder to protect against noise. Magic state distillation addresses this issue; however, existing protocols typically assume prior structure in the input, such as proximity to the target or a specified noise model. Here we introduce universal magic state concentration: a fixed stabilizer protocol that converts a few copies of an unknown pure non-stabilizer qubit state into an exact target magic state. Motivated by the obstruction to exact $T$-state concentration, we show that $\mathrm{CCZ}$ states behave fundamentally differently. Six input copies are necessary and sufficient to distill one exact $\mathrm{CCZ}$ state, with an optimal success probability determined by the linearized order-three stabilizer Rényi entropy $M^{\mathrm{lin}}_3$. Beyond this, we show that $M^{\mathrm{lin}}_3$ governs the optimal state dependence of any protocol up to nine input copies, and we showcase an eight-copy protocol with improved success probability. Furthermore, block repetition of our protocols yields asymptotic distillation rates that achieve optimal scaling up to logarithmic factors. As a corollary, any unknown pure qubit magic state suffices for universal quantum computation via exact $\mathrm{CCZ}$ injection. Together, these results identify the stabilizer Rényi entropy as a fundamental operational quantity in magic state distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"通用魔法态浓缩"：一个固定的稳定子协议，可将少量未知纯非稳定子量子比特态转化为精确的目标CCZ魔法态。六拷贝输入是精确蒸馏一个CCZ态的充要条件，最优成功概率由线性化三阶稳定子Rényi熵M_3^lin决定，且该熵量在最多九拷贝输入下支配所有协议的最优态依赖。块重复该协议可获得渐进蒸馏速率，达到对数因子内的最优标度。作为推论，任何未知纯量子比特魔法态都足以通过精确CCZ注入实现通用量子计算。
AI.motivation: 魔法态在量子计算中扮演双重角色：一方面使稳定子动力学从经典可模拟变为通用计算，另一方面却对容错构成挑战，因为非稳定子操作更难抵抗噪声。魔法态蒸馏是解决此问题的关键途径，但现有协议通常假设输入具有先验结构（如接近目标态或特定噪声模型）。作者希望设计不依赖输入先验信息的普适协议，并探究不同魔法态家族（如T态与CCZ态）在精确浓缩方面的根本差异。
AI.method: 作者引入了"通用魔法态浓缩"框架：一个固定的稳定子协议，将未知纯非稳定子量子比特态转化为精确目标魔法态。他们分析了T态精确浓缩的障碍，并证明CCZ态在本质上是不同的。通过线性化三阶稳定子Rényi熵M_3^lin来刻画最优成功概率，并推导出六拷贝充要条件。此外还构建了一个八拷贝协议提升成功概率，并通过块重复实现渐进蒸馏速率的优化。
AI.result: 证明了六输入拷贝是蒸馏一个精确CCZ态的充要条件，最优成功概率由线性化三阶稳定子Rényi熵M_3^lin确定；M_3^lin在最多九拷贝输入下支配任何协议的最优态依赖；提出了八拷贝协议以改进成功概率；块重复协议达到对数因子内的最优渐进蒸馏速率；任何未知纯量子比特魔法态都可通过精确CCZ注入实现通用量子计算。
AI.conclusion: 稳定子Rényi熵被确立为魔法态蒸馏中的一个基本操作量。CCZ态相对于T态在精确浓缩问题上展现出根本不同的行为，这为理解魔法态蒸馏的结构提供了新视角，并为不依赖先验噪声模型的通用容错量子计算方案铺平了道路。

title: Field-Widened Multimode Interferometer with Long Time-Bin Delay Using a Multi-Pass Herriott Cell
summary: Interference of optical signals in free-space channels requires optical receivers to support many spatial modes due to atmospheric turbulence, typically necessitating adaptive optics systems. Field-widened interferometers offer a passive alternative, making them particularly attractive for time-bin encoded signals with delays on the order of one nanosecond. Here, we demonstrate a field-widened, multimode interferometer design that achieves a high interference visibility for spatially multimode beams with large time bin separations. The interference of the multimode beams is enabled using a multi-pass Herriott cell that enables a very long path separation with a small form-factor. The design is tested using both numerical ray-tracing simulations and proof-of-principle demonstrations. We create a prototype interferometer with a path length difference of 12ns and determine that it maintains a high interference visibility with a large field-of-view of $0.4^{\circ}$.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种场加宽多模干涉仪设计，利用多程Herriott腔实现大路径差和小型化，在12ns路径差下对空间多模光束保持高干涉可见度，视场角达0.4°。
AI.motivation: 自由空间信道中大气湍流导致光学信号需要接收多个空间模式，传统自适应光学系统复杂且昂贵。场加宽干涉仪作为一种无源替代方案具有吸引力，尤其适用于延迟约1纳秒的时间仓编码信号，但需要解决多模干涉和紧凑设计之间的权衡问题。
AI.method: 采用多程Herriott腔设计，在紧凑外形下实现非常长的路径分离，使时间仓编码信号的空间多模光束能够发生干涉。通过数值光线追踪模拟和原理验证实验进行测试，并制作了路径差为12ns的原型干涉仪。
AI.result: 原型干涉仪实现了12ns的路径长度差，在0.4°的大视场范围内保持高干涉可见度，同时兼顾了小型化的外形尺寸。
AI.conclusion: 该场加宽多模干涉仪为自由空间量子或经典光通信提供了一种紧凑、无源的多模干涉方案，能够满足长时间仓间隔的时间仓编码信号需求，避免了对自适应光学系统的依赖。

title: Spectral Localization Principle for Entanglement Harvesting
summary: We propose a unified physical principle for entanglement harvesting: the entanglement that two localized detectors can extract from a quantum field is determined solely by how localized the field's effective spectral density is. We demonstrate this in an analytically solvable model of two qubits coupled to a leaky single-mode cavity, which in turn couples to a continuous electromagnetic bath, and derive the maximum harvestable concurrence in closed form, $\mathcal{C}_{\max}(Q)=2e^{-π/(2Q)}(1+e^{-π/(2Q)})/(1+3e^{-π/Q})$, where $Q\equiv|Δ|/κ$ is the ratio of the qubit-cavity detuning $Δ$ to the cavity linewidth $κ$. In the high-$Q$ limit, $\mathcal{C}_{\max}\simeq1-π^{2}/(16Q^{2})$, so the entanglement is robust against cavity loss; in the low-$Q$ limit it decays exponentially to zero, consistent with the irreversible-reservoir character of a continuous field, where maximal entanglement is unattainable. Since $Q$ is proportional to the inverse participation ratio (IPR) of the effective spectral density, it is the single dimensionless parameter governing the crossover from deterministic gate-based entanglement ($Q\to\infty$) to vacuum harvesting ($Q\to0$). Our framework operationalizes the Reeh-Schlieder theorem by quantifying the fraction of vacuum correlations accessible to localized detectors. It also reveals a formal correspondence of the maximal concurrence with the IPR, analogous to the conductivity-participation-ratio relation in Anderson localization. The predicted $\mathcal{C}_{\max}(Q)$ curve is, in principle, directly observable in superconducting circuit QED experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的物理原理：两个局域探测器从量子场中提取纠缠的能力完全由场的有效频谱密度的局域化程度决定。作者在分析可解的"两个量子比特耦合到泄漏单模腔、腔再耦合连续电磁浴"模型中，推导出可提取纠缠（concurrence）的闭式最大值公式，并揭示了高Q极限下纠缠对腔损耗的鲁棒性、低Q极限下指数衰减等现象，同时将该框架与Reeh-Schlieder定理的算符化及Anderson局域化中的电导-参与比关系建立了对应。
AI.motivation: 纠缠提取（entanglement harvesting）是量子信息与量子场论交叉的核心问题，但以往缺乏统一的物理原理来解释不同模型中提取纠缠的行为。作者希望找到决定纠缠提取能力的单一控制参数，并提供一个解析可解的模型来在闭式层面上阐明局域化程度与可提取纠缠之间的定量关系。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个分析可解的物理模型：两个量子比特与一个泄漏单模腔耦合，该腔再与连续电磁浴耦合。利用该模型推导出最大可提取纠缠（concurrence）的闭式表达式 C_max(Q)=2e^{-π/(2Q)}(1+e^{-π/(2Q)})/(1+3e^{-π/Q})，其中Q是量子比特-腔失谐与腔线宽之比。通过高Q与低Q极限分析揭示纠缠行为的渐近特征，并将Q解释为有效频谱密度的逆参与比（IPR），从而建立统一的物理原理。
AI.result: 推导出最大并发度的精确闭式公式；高Q极限下 C_max≈1-π²/(16Q²)，表明在小腔线宽条件下纠缠对腔损耗高度鲁棒；低Q极限下并发度指数衰减至零，体现连续场的不可逆电阻（reservoir）特性。揭示了Q作为唯一无量纲参数，控制着从确定性门操作纠缠（Q→∞）到真空纠缠提取（Q→0）的过渡。并发度与IPR的对应关系类似于Anderson局域化中电导与参与比的关系。该预测曲线原则上可在超导电路QED实验中直接观测。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个统一的物理原理：纠缠提取完全由有效频谱密度的局域化程度（即Q参数）决定。该框架不仅将Reeh-Schlieder定理在可操作层面量化（即局域探测器可获取的真空关联分数），还揭示了与Anderson局域化的深层数学类比。由于预测的C_max(Q)曲线在超导电路QED中可观测，该工作为实验验证纠缠提取的统一原理提供了清晰路径。

title: Strong unitary designs in optimal depth and space
summary: Unitary designs provide finite-moment approximations to Haar-random unitaries, with wide-ranging applications across physics and quantum information, from scrambling and black-hole dynamics to foundational primitives in quantum algorithms. Strong unitary designs capture a more demanding operational notion of approximation, requiring indistinguishability from Haar randomness even for quantum algorithms that may access a unitary not only in the forward direction, but also through its inverse, transpose, and complex conjugate. Motivated by the physical requirement that scrambling arise within the system itself, Schuster, Ma, Lombardi, Brandão, and Huang (arXiv:2509.26310) left open whether strong unitary designs can be generated in logarithmic depth using only the system qubits. For every fixed design order $k$ and measurable-error tolerance, we construct strong approximate unitary $k$-designs in optimal $Θ(\log n)$ all-to-all circuit depth using only the $n$ original system qubits. Our new ingredient is a logarithmic-depth Pauli-mixing bound for the perfect-matching ensemble, whose layers pair the qubits uniformly at random and apply independent random two-qubit gates. This bound controls the mixed forward-reverse two-query case, which we combine with existing design and gluing results to obtain strong unitary designs of arbitrary fixed order.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了仅使用n个系统量子比特、最优Θ(log n)全连接电路深度下的强近似酉k-设计，解决了Schuster等人留下的开放问题。
AI.motivation: 强酉设计要求即使在算法可访问酉算子及其逆、转置和复共轭的情况下也能与Haar随机不可区分，是更严格的操作性近似概念。物理上要求混沌（scrambling）发生在系统自身内部，因此Schuster等人留出了开放问题：能否仅使用系统量子比特在对数深度内生成强酉设计。
AI.method: 新引入的关键工具是对完美匹配系综（perfect-matching ensemble）的对数深度Pauli混合界。该系综的每一层将量子比特均匀随机配对并施加独立的随机两比特门。这个界控制了前向-反向混合双查询情形，再与已有的设计构造和拼接（gluing）结果相结合，获得任意固定阶数的强酉设计。
AI.result: 对于任意固定设计阶数k和可测误差容限，成功构造了最优Θ(log n)深度下的强近似酉k-设计，且仅使用n个原始系统量子比特。
AI.conclusion: 该结果证明了在无辅助量子比特的对数深度电路中即可实现强酉设计，达到深度下界最优，解决了此前文献中遗留的开放问题。

title: Quantum correlations and Basis-Independent Coherence Distribution in Two Gravitational Cat States
summary: We study the distribution of quantum correlations and basis-independent coherence in a pair of massive particles confined in a double-well potential and coupled through their mutual Newtonian gravitational interaction. Non-classical correlations are characterized using Bures distance of entanglement and quantum discord, while coherence is quantified through the square root of the quantum Jensen--Shannon divergence (QJSD) from the maximally mixed state, yielding a measure that is invariant under arbitrary unitary transformations and is therefore genuinely basis-independent. The total coherence $C_T$ decomposes into two operationally distinct contributions: the collective coherence $C_C$, which captures quantum correlations between the two subsystems, and the localized coherence $C_L$, which captures the intrinsic quantum coherence of each individual subsystem. We analyze how temperature $T$, the gravitational coupling $Δ$, and the single-particle energy scale $w$ govern the redistribution of coherence between its collective and localized components. Our results show that $C_L$ is more robust against thermal fluctuations than $C_C$, and that increasing $Δ$ preferentially enhances collective coherence by strengthening gravitationally induced inter-particle correlations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究双阱势阱中通过牛顿引力相互作用耦合的一对大质量粒子系统中量子关联与基无关相干性的分布，揭示了温度、引力耦合强度和单粒子能量尺度如何调控集体相干性与局域相干性的再分配。
AI.motivation: 探索引力系统中的量子关联和非经典相干性，特别是在大质量粒子体系中引力相互作用如何影响量子信息的分布，为量子引力界面和量子信息理论的交叉研究提供理论基础。
AI.method: 利用Bures距离纠缠度和量子失谐表征非经典关联，采用量子Jensen-Shannon散度的平方根作为基无关的相干性度量，将总相干性分解为集体相干性和局域相干性两个分量，并系统分析温度T、引力耦合Δ和单粒子能量尺度w对相干性再分配的影响。
AI.result: 局域相干性CL对热涨落比集体相干性CC更鲁棒；增大引力耦合Δ会通过增强引力诱导的粒子间关联而优先增强集体相干性。
AI.conclusion: 引力相互作用能够在双粒子体系中有效调节量子相干性的集体与局域分配，为该类系统的量子信息处理应用提供了理论指导。

title: Exponential quantum advantage for learning signals with a single qubit
comment: 131 pages, including 7 pages of main text, 4 main figures, and 8 supplementary figures
summary: Quantum technology has the potential to transform scientific discovery, but quantum advantages often require processing capabilities well beyond the reach of experimental platforms. We show that coupling a single controllable qubit to an otherwise conventional sensor can exponentially reduce the number of measurements required to learn classical signals. These rigorous quantum advantages apply to fundamental sensing tasks, including learning Fourier coefficients, extracting temporal correlations from time-varying signals, and estimating transformations of physical observables. Using a superconducting cavity--qubit architecture, we experimentally demonstrate $10^7$-fold reductions in the number of measurements required for Fourier-amplitude and time-varying signal learning. Our $\textit{quantum feature sensing}$ algorithms further enable orders-of-magnitude improvements in simulations of weak-signal dark matter detection and wireless communication applications. These quantum advantages are derived from Quantum Phase-Space Inference (Q$Ψ$), a unifying theory of quantum-enhanced experiments that simultaneously converts a set of experimental objectives and constraints into tight lower bounds and optimal quantum-enhanced learning algorithms while producing a certificate of quantum advantage. Q$Ψ$ extends beyond the regimes captured by quantum Fisher information and provides a framework for systematically identifying rigorous quantum advantages in practical experimental tasks. Together, our results establish that near-term quantum technology can exponentially enhance our ability to learn from classical signals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出量子特征感知（Quantum Feature Sensing）算法，证明将单个可控量子比特耦合到常规传感器可将学习经典信号所需的测量次数指数级减少，并在超导腔-量子比特平台上实验实现了10^7倍的测量次数缩减，同时建立了统一的量子相空间推断（QΨ）理论框架。
AI.motivation: 量子优势通常需要远超现有实验平台的处理能力，难以在近期的量子技术上实现。作者希望探索是否能用单个可控量子比特对常规传感任务带来指数级增强，从而在实用的经典信号学习中建立可实验验证的严格量子优势。
AI.method: 提出量子特征感知算法，将单个可控量子比特耦合到常规传感器；并建立量子相空间推断（QΨ）统一理论框架，该框架可同时将实验目标和约束转化为紧下界与最优的量子增强学习算法，同时生成量子优势证书。基于超导腔-量子比特架构进行实验验证，包括傅里叶系数学习、时变信号时间关联提取和物理可观测量变换估计等基本感知任务。
AI.result: 超导腔-量子比特实验中实现了傅里叶振幅和时变信号学习中10^7倍的测量次数缩减；在弱信号暗物质探测模拟和无线通信应用中实现数量级的性能提升。QΨ理论框架超越了量子Fisher信息的适用范围，为实际实验任务中严格量子优势的系统性识别提供了新方法。
AI.conclusion: 近期的量子技术能够指数级增强我们从经典信号中学习的能力，单个可控量子比特耦合至常规传感器即可在多种基础感知任务中获得严格且可实验验证的量子优势，为实用化量子增强感知铺平了道路。

title: Ambient unitaries don't enable shallow group designs
summary: Characterising the efficiency with which designs over various subsets of the unitary group may be constructed is an important goal of quantum information theory. While it is now known that approximate unitary designs can be realised in depth logarithmic in the system size, it has recently been shown that ensembles of local nearest-neighbour sublinear-depth one-dimensional circuits over the matchgate, orthogonal, and symplectic groups cannot form approximate 2-designs over their parent groups; similarly, sublinear-depth ensembles of Cliffords cannot form a Clifford 4-design. In this note we show that this remarkable exponential separation is not merely an artefact of restricting to ensembles consisting of unitaries from the subgroups themselves, but rather that no ensemble of local nearest-neighbour sublinear-depth unitaries can realise approximate designs in the aforementioned cases, even when employing "ambient" unitaries from beyond the subgroup itself (possibly acting on ancilla qubits). This implies that various natural tomography and benchmarking schemes which involves sampling from these groups suffer from a dramatic circuit depth overhead compared to similar protocols which involve sampling from the full unitary group. We additionally conclude that, in all of the above cases, the known linear-depth design constructions are up to constant factors optimal.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在matchgate、正交、辛和Clifford群的局部最近邻次线性深度电路中，即使允许使用来自母群之外的环境酉算子（包括作用于辅助量子比特的算子），也无法形成近似2-design（Clifford情况下为4-design）。这推翻了此前认为该指数级分离可能仅局限于子群内部酉算子的可能性，并表明相关断层扫描和基准测试方案相比全酉群采样方案需要巨大的电路深度开销，同时证明了已知的线性深度设计构造在常数因子意义上是最优的。
AI.motivation: 此前已知次线性深度的局部最近邻电路（属于matchgate、正交、辛群）无法构成其母群的近似2-design，Clifford次线性深度电路也无法构成Clifford 4-design，存在令人瞩目的指数级分离现象。关键开放问题是：这种分离是否仅仅源于将酉算子限制在子群内部，还是即使允许使用环境酉算子这一更一般的设定下仍然成立。本文旨在填补这一空白，揭示问题的本质。
AI.method: 本文采用理论证明的方法，将先前关于子群内部酉算子设计的否定性结果推广到更一般的情形，即允许电路中的酉算子来自母群之外（可能涉及辅助量子比特）。通过系统性分析各类局部最近邻次线性深度电路的结构约束，证明在这些放宽条件下近似设计仍然无法实现。
AI.result: 证明了不存在任何局部最近邻次线性深度的酉算子集合能在上述情形下实现近似设计，即使允许使用来自子群之外的环境酉算子（含辅助量子比特）。这意味着涉及的量子断层扫描和基准测试协议需要承受巨大的电路深度代价，且已知的线性深度构造在常数因子内已达到最优。
AI.conclusion: 本文验证了次线性深度与线性深度之间在设计实现上的指数级分离是一个根本性的现象，而非局限于子群内部结构的伪影。这为量子信息处理中设计复杂性的理解提供了更完整的图景，并明确了相关协议在实际实现中的深度瓶颈。

title: Quantum simulation of non-Markovian dynamical systems
summary:
Existing quantum algorithms for simulating dynamical systems -- from Hamiltonian simulation to linear and nonlinear differential equations solvers -- simulate Markovian dynamics, in which the system's future evolution depends solely on its current state. We turn our attention to developing quantum algorithms for non-Markovian dynamical systems where the system's future evolution depends on its past history and thus has memory. Specifically, we develop efficient algorithms for linear Volterra integro-differential equations (VIDEs) with a convolution memory kernel that output a quantum state encoding the state description over a time interval or at a particular time. Given efficient circuits for the problem inputs, our algorithms achieve an exponential speedup in system size over existing classical algorithms.
  We develop an algorithm for general kernels assuming that $\textsf{M} < 1$, where $\textsf{M}$ characterizes the strength of the memory term relative to the dissipation of the Markovian part of the dynamics. We complement this with lower bounds for general-kernel VIDEs when $\textsf{M} \geq 1$, showing that the problem becomes intractable for a family of systems. However, by specializing to structured kernels which admit concise decompositions over exponentials, we develop efficient quantum algorithms even when $\textsf M \geq 1$ by converting the VIDE into a larger set of ODEs, a procedure which we call Markovianization. As an application of the overall framework, we discuss the Mori-Zwanzig formalism used in open quantum systems and fluid dynamics. Overall, our results expand the range of dynamical systems that quantum computers can simulate efficiently.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了针对非马尔可夫动力学系统（具体为带有卷积记忆核的线性 Volterra 积分微分方程，VIDEs）的高效量子算法。在一般核且M<1条件下算法实现了相对经典算法的指数级加速；当M≥1时给出了下界证明一般核问题不可解，但通过将VIDE转化为更大规模ODE集合的"马尔可夫化"（Markovianization）过程，对具有指数分解结构的内核仍可实现高效量子模拟。该框架可应用于Mori-Zwanzig形式体系下的开放量子系统和流体动力学。
AI.motivation: 现有量子模拟算法主要针对马尔可夫动力学系统（系统的未来演化只依赖当前状态），而对于未来演化依赖历史状态（即具有记忆性）的非马尔可夫动力学系统缺乏高效的量子算法。本文旨在填补这一空白，开发针对非马尔可夫动力学系统的量子模拟算法。
AI.method: 1) 针对一般卷积记忆核的VIDEs，在M<1条件下设计高效量子算法，输出编码时间区间或特定时刻状态描述的量子态，实现相对经典算法的指数级加速；2) 证明M≥1时一般核VIDEs对一类系统不可解（给出下界）；3) 针对可分解为指数函数简洁组合的结构化核，提出"马尔可夫化"（Markovianization）方法，将VIDE转化为更大幅度的ODE集合，即便M≥1也能实现高效量子算法。
AI.result: 在M<1条件下实现了对一般核VIDEs的高效量子模拟和指数级加速；证明了M≥1时一般核VIDEs的下界不可解性；但对结构化指数可分解核，通过Markovianization方法在M≥1情况下仍能实现高效量子算法。该方法框架可推广至Mori-Zwanzig形式体系下的开放量子系统和流体动力学应用。
AI.conclusion: 本文显著扩展了量子计算机可高效模拟的动力学系统范围，从马尔可夫动力学扩展到了非马尔可夫（带记忆）动力学。通过区分一般核与结构化核的处理策略（含困难度下界与马尔可夫化方法），为量子模拟非马尔可夫系统提供了理论基础和算法工具。

title: Clifford Circuit Synthesis for Distributed Quantum Architectures with Arbitrary Network Topology
summary: To achieve large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computation, it may be easier to combine many small sets of qubits than to construct a single large set. For example via quantum error correction with block codes, or distributed quantum processors utilizing shared entanglement. In these regimes, the time or error budget of the overall quantum computation may be dominated by non-local operations. Hence, it is worthwhile to minimize the number of these operations. We consider the case where both non-local and local connectivity may be arbitrarily restricted, and give an asymptotically optimal synthesis method for distributed CNOT and Clifford circuits, based on block-matrix Gaussian elimination. We extend this to all Clifford+RZ circuits by generalizing the Pauli exponential circuit representation; this naturally integrates with existing methods for optimizing T-count. As an application, we show how to implement CNOT circuits in a CSS code encoding n logical qubits in k blocks using O(nk) inter-block transversal CNOTs and intra-block Pauli measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于块矩阵高斯消元法的渐近最优综合方法，用于在局部和非局部连接均受限的分布式量子计算场景下合成CNOT和Clifford电路，并扩展至所有Clifford+RZ电路。作为应用，展示了如何利用O(nk)个块间横贯CNOT和块内Pauli测量，在CSS码中实现编码n个逻辑量子比特于k个块的CNOT电路。
AI.motivation: 大规模容错量子计算的实现可能比构建单个大型量子比特阵列更容易通过组合多个小型量子比特集合来完成（如块码量子纠错或分布式量子处理器）。在这些场景中，整体计算的时间和错误预算可能由非局部操作主导，因此最小化这些操作的数目具有重要意义。
AI.method: 基于块矩阵高斯消元法，提出渐近最优的分布式CNOT和Clifford电路综合方法。通过推广Pauli指数电路表示，将方法扩展至所有Clifford+RZ电路，并与现有的T计数优化方法自然集成。
AI.result: 给出了渐近最优的合成方法，并展示了在CSS码中，编码n个逻辑量子比特于k个块时，仅需O(nk)个块间横贯CNOT和块内Pauli测量即可实现CNOT电路。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为受限连接下的分布式量子电路合成提供了渐近最优的理论保证，并为块码量子纠错和分布式量子计算中的非局部操作优化提供了实用途径。

title: Every PPT channel has finite entanglement-breaking index
summary: We prove that every PPT linear map has finite entanglement-breaking index, thereby establishing the eventual entanglement-breaking property of PPT channels in full generality. Furthermore, by utilizing completely positive maps with low entanglement dimensionality, we show that a large family of PPT maps, which strictly containing the class of 2-superpositive maps, has entanglement-breaking index bounded above by 3, uniformly in the dimension. In particular, these results provide strong evidence that the PPT-cubed conjecture may hold in full generality.

AI.tldr: 本文证明每个PPT线性映射都具有有限的纠缠破坏指数，从而完整确立了PPT信道的最终纠缠破坏性质。此外，利用低纠缠维数的完全正映射，证明了一类严格包含2-超正映射的PPT映射族具有统一以3为上界的纠缠破坏指数（与维数无关），为PPT-立方猜想在完全一般性下成立提供了有力证据。
AI.motivation: 纠缠破坏信道和PPT信道是量子信息理论中的核心概念。理解PPT信道的纠缠破坏性质（即反复应用信道后是否最终破坏所有纠缠）是一个重要的开放问题。已有的结果仅在部分情形下成立，本文旨在完全一般性下证明这一性质，并探索PPT-立方猜想的可能性。
AI.method: 文章采用两种技术手段：（1）对一般PPT线性映射，证明其具有有限的纠缠破坏指数；（2）引入低纠缠维数的完全正映射，构造一个严格包含2-超正映射的PPT映射族，并证明该族中所有映射的纠缠破坏指数至多为3。
AI.result: 证明了所有PPT线性映射具有有限的纠缠破坏指数；构造了一个大规模PPT映射族（严格包含2-超正映射类），其纠缠破坏指数在任意维数下统一以3为上界。这些结果为PPT-立方猜想的完全成立提供了强有力的证据。
AI.conclusion: 本文在完全一般性下确立了PPT映射的最终纠缠破坏性质，并通过精致的构造将一大类PPT映射的纠缠破坏指数统一限制在3以内，显著推进了PPT-立方猜想的研究进展。

title: Experimental Quantum Key Distribution in an Indefinite Causal Order
summary: In quantum physics the order in which different operations occur can be placed in superposition. The resulting processes have an indefinite causal order and are both of fundamental interest and can be viewed as a novel quantum resource that enables a variety of new protocols. Here we report an experimental implementation of one such protocol, where we perform BB84-like quantum cryptography by placing Alice and Bob's measurement-and-preparation operations in a photonic quantum SWITCH. By embedding Alice and Bob within the quantum SWITCH, the protocol achieves an average eavesdropper detection probability of $0.15 \pm 0.02$ per shared qubit, with eavesdropper detection performed through measurements of the control qubit rather than by comparing the key. Unlike the standard BB84 and related schemes, which detect eavesdropping by publicly revealing and discarding a fraction of the raw key, our approach requires no disclosure of key material: every retained qubit can, in principle, be tested for eavesdropping while remaining available for key generation. The experiment relies on a new measurement technique that allows the polarization of a photon to be measured inside the quantum SWITCH without destroying path coherence. Although the present implementation does not yet constitute a secure quantum key distribution protocol, owing to the post-selection required for measurements within the quantum SWITCH, it provides a proof of principle that indefinite causal order can be exploited to detect eavesdropping without sacrificing key bits.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了利用光量子SWITCH实验实现BB84-like量子密码协议的方案，将Alice和Bob的测量与制备操作置于不定因果序叠加中，通过测量控制量子比特来检测窃听，无需公开和丢弃密钥比特，达到每共享量子比特0.15±0.02的平均窃听者检测概率。
AI.motivation: 传统BB84协议检测窃听需要公开并丢弃一部分原始密钥，浪费密钥资源。作者希望利用量子力学中的不定因果序（indefinite causal order）作为一种新的量子资源，实现在不牺牲密钥比特的情况下检测窃听者的方案。
AI.method: 将Alice和Bob的测量与制备操作嵌入到光子的量子SWITCH中，使操作的因果顺序处于叠加态。通过测量控制量子比特来检测窃听，而非对比密钥。实验中开发了一种新技术，允许在量子SWITCH内部测量光子偏振而不破坏路径相干性。注意，当前实现依赖后选择，尚不构成安全的QKD协议。
AI.result: 实验实现了平均窃听者检测概率为0.15±0.02（每个共享量子比特），且所有保留的量子比特原则上均可进行窃听检测而同时用于密钥生成，无需披露任何密钥材料。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为利用不定因果序检测窃听而不牺牲密钥比特提供了原理验证。虽然当前实现由于量子SWITCH内测量的后选择要求尚不能构成安全的量子密钥分发协议，但展示了不定因果序作为量子资源在密码学中的新应用潜力。

title: Quantum-Geometric Bound on Dynamical Instability in Bosonic Systems
summary: Quantum-geometric speed and dynamical instability are two natural rates for a driven quantum system, and their relation is unsettled even for exactly solvable dynamics. Here we show that for any multimode quadratic bosonic system referred to the bare-mode vacuum the Fubini-Study speed v_FS is the Frobenius norm of the symmetric, stretching part of the flow. This yields a sharp bound, lambda_max <= sqrt(2) v_FS, saturated by a resonant pure squeezer. The bound is not invertible: in a detuned parametric amplifier we hold either rate fixed while varying the other.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多模二次玻色子系统的量子几何速度与动力学不稳定性之间的关系，证明Fubini-Study速度v_FS等于flows对称拉伸部分的Frobenius范数，并导出一个由共振纯压缩器饱和的尖锐上界。
AI.motivation: 量子几何速度（Fubini-Study速度）和动力学不稳定性是驱动量子系统的两个自然速率，但即使在可精确求解的动力学中，二者之间的关系也尚未明确。作者希望建立这两个关键速率之间的严格数学联系。
AI.method: 对任意相对于裸模真空的多模二次玻色子系统，将Fubini-Study速度v_FS表示为流（flow）对称拉伸部分的Frobenius范数。利用这一表示推导出上界lambda_max <= sqrt(2) v_FS，并通过共振纯压缩器（resonant pure squeezer）证明该界的紧致性。通过失谐参量放大器（detuned parametric amplifier）的数值/解析分析展示该界不可逆，即可以固定一个速率同时变化另一个。
AI.result: 得到尖锐上界lambda_max <= sqrt(2) v_FS，并由共振纯压缩器饱和；同时证明该界不具有可逆性，在失谐参量放大器中可独立调控两个速率中的任意一个。
AI.conclusion: 量子几何速度与动力学不稳定性之间存在严格的数学关系，但该关系不是双向约束。这为理解驱动量子系统中几何与动力学速率的本质差异提供了理论基础。

title: Is the Aharonov-Casher phase geometrical or dynamical?
summary: We consider two two-dimensional (2D) electronic systems in the presence of a perpendicular homogeneous electric field that generates a Rashba spin-orbit interaction (RSOI): a system of non-interacting electrons in a 2D conductor, modeled using the 2D Schrödinger equation (SE), and a single-layer graphene system, modeled using a 2D Dirac equation (DE) for massless fermions. In both cases the RSOI is expressed via an $SU(2)$ Rashba vector potential ${\bf A}_{R}$. We demonstrate that ${\bf A}_{R}$ cannot be eliminated from either the 2D SE or the 2D DE via a gauge transformation. Nevertheless, for a plane wave solution, an $SU(2)$ matrix exists that eliminates ${\bf A}_{R}$ from the resulting 1D SE. This unitary matrix is an Aharonov-Casher (AC) phase factor, and facilitates the calculation of the AC phase in the Schrödinger scheme. The plane wave solution for the DE contains two components of ${\bf A}_{R}$: $A_{R, k}$ in the direction of the wave vector ${\bf k}$, and $A_{R, n}$ normal to ${\bf k}$. The latter generates an effective electron mass that cannot be eliminated from the DE. The former generates an AC phase that can be eliminated by a time-dependent unitary transformation. Thus, the Dirac AC phase is time-dependent, i.e., it is a dynamical phase. This is in contradistinction to the Schrödinger AC phase which is geometrical.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了二维电子系统和单层石墨烯在Rashba自旋轨道耦合下的Aharonov-Casher(AC)相位。结果表明，SU(2)Rashba矢量势无法通过规范变换从二维薛定谔方程或二维狄拉克方程中消除，但在平面波解中可通过AC相位因子从一维薛定谔方程中消除。关键发现是：薛定谔方案中的AC相位是几何相位，而狄拉克方案中的AC相位是含时的动力学相位，且垂直于波矢的Rashba分量会产生无法消除的有效电子质量。
AI.motivation: 探究Rashba自旋轨道耦合产生的SU(2)矢量势能否通过规范变换或幺正变换消除，并系统比较薛定谔方程与狄拉克方程两种框架下的Aharonov-Casher相位性质差异。
AI.method: 分别用2D薛定谔方程描述非相互作用的二维导体电子系统和2D狄拉克方程描述单层石墨烯无质量费米子，将RSOI表示为SU(2)Rashba矢量势，分析平面波解下是否存在幺正矩阵消除该矢量势，并对比两种方案中AC相位的数学形式与物理性质。
AI.result: 发现Rashba矢量势不能通过规范变换从2D SE或2D DE中消除；但平面波解中，一个AC相位因子幺正矩阵可从1D SE中消除该势。对于DE，Rashba势的两个分量中垂直于波矢的分量产生不可消除的有效质量，平行于波矢的分量产生的AC相位可通过含时幺正变换消除，因此狄拉克AC相位是动力学相位，而薛定谔AC相位是几何相位。
AI.conclusion: 薛定谔方案与狄拉克方案中的AC相位具有本质不同的物理性质：前者为几何相位，后者为动力学相位，揭示了不同电子系统框架下Rashba自旋轨道耦合与几何/动力学相位关系的深刻差异。

title: Pathways to Quantum Science for High-School and Incoming College Students
summary: The convergence of AI and quantum computing requires a new approach to cybersecurity. Credible experts estimate that by 2030 a cryptographically relevant quantum computer will be capable of breaking the encryption that underpins all of our digital communication. One of the most disruptive technology in history is coming and it's expected to change everything. In this context academic institutions will contribute to their states' future economic prosperity by leveraging their strengths and resources, particularly talent development, in key and emerging areas prioritized across the state. We report on current efforts to develop a Pathways Plus to Quantum Information Science (QIS) degree, a set of dual credit courses for high-school (HS) students and incoming college students pursuing a minor or specialization in Quantum Computing (QC). As of today, in the US, quantum topics appear on the HS curriculum standards in just two states: OH (Computing) and TX (Physics). Reaching out to HS and even middle school students (and their teachers) presents obvious long-term benefits in terms of workforce development for the quantum industrial ecosystem. Standing in the way of successful, widespread introduction of QC and QIS topics in HS and middle school are three distinct obstacles: (a) lack of materials at the right level for students and instructors, (b) funding and support for professional development for teachers, and (c) lack of state standards. In this paper we address all three aspects with a special focus on the benefits of quantum virtual labs and ZX calculus in the classroom.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一项将量子信息科学（QIS）引入高中及大学低年级的Pathways Plus学位计划，通过双学分课程、量子虚拟实验室和ZX演算来解决教材缺失、师资培训和州标准缺乏三大障碍，以应对2030年量子计算机对现有网络安全构成的威胁。
AI.motivation: AI与量子计算的融合对网络安全构成重大威胁，预计到2030年密码学相关的量子计算机将能破解当前支撑所有数字通信的加密体系。为保障国家未来的经济繁荣，学术机构需要提前布局量子计算人才梯队建设，当前美国仅有俄亥俄州（Computing）和得克萨斯州（Physics）将量子主题纳入高中课程标准，急需扩展K-12阶段的量子教育。
AI.method: 提出Pathways Plus to Quantum Information Science（QIS）学位计划，为高中生和大学新生提供双学分课程，并辅以量子虚拟实验室和ZX演算作为教学工具。论文从三个方面系统应对挑战：(a)开发适合学生和教师水平的教学材料，(b)提供教师专业发展的资金与支持，(c)推动州级课程标准的制定。
AI.result: 论文聚焦于量子虚拟实验室和ZX演算在课堂教学中的具体应用，并将围绕三大障碍提出可行的解决方案，目前该学位计划仍在推进和实施过程中。
AI.conclusion: 面向高中生乃至初中生（及其教师）开展量子计算和量子信息科学教育具有显著的长期效益，对于构建量子产业生态所需的人力资源基础至关重要。作者认为这是应对即将到来的量子计算时代网络安全挑战的关键路径。

title: Floquet Quasiparticle Poisoning of Frozonium
comment: Main text: 10 pages, 4 figures. Supplementary material: 4 pages
summary: Periodic driving can suppress the Josephson nonlinearity of a fluxonium superconducting circuit, producing a nearly harmonic Floquet spectrum at isolated freezing points [K. Lewellen et al., Newton 2, 100434 (2026)]. Here we show that this dynamically frozen behavior does not generically suppress quasiparticle-induced dissipation in the resulting frozonium circuit. We formulate quasiparticle processes in the frozonium using a Floquet framework and analyze both drive-assisted Cooper-pair breaking and tunneling of pre-existing quasiparticles. Pair generation is controlled by gap-breaking thresholds at high drive frequencies, while multiphoton resonances produce pronounced rate enhancements at lower frequencies. Quasiparticle tunneling exhibits connected resonance structures organized by the harmonic Floquet-Magnus spectrum near the freezing point, with resonant hybridization generating characteristic avoided crossings. Our results show that suitable operating regimes must balance dynamical freezing against quasiparticle loss and provide a framework for identifying experimental drive parameters away from harmful resonances.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了周期驱动抑制超导fluxonium电路的约瑟夫森非线性后产生的"frozonium"电路中，准粒子诱导耗散是否被抑制。结果表明动态冻结并不会普遍抑制准粒子耗散，需在实验中平衡动态冻结与准粒子损失。
AI.motivation: 周期驱动可在孤立冻结点产生近谐波的Floquet谱，有望实现低非线性电路，但动态冻结行为是否同时抑制准粒子引起的耗散尚不清楚，这直接关系到该类电路的实用可行性。
AI.method: 采用Floquet框架系统地描述frozonium电路中的准粒子过程，分别分析驱动辅助的库珀对破裂过程（关注高驱动频率下的能隙击穿阈值和低频下的多光子共振增强）以及已有准粒子的隧穿过程（在冻结点附近用谐波Floquet-Magnus谱表征，识别共振杂化导致的特征避免交叉结构）。
AI.result: 发现驱动辅助的库珀对生成受高频率下的能隙击穿阈值控制，而在低频下多光子共振会显著增强速率；准粒子隧穿在冻结点附近呈现由谐波Floquet-Magnus谱组织的连通共振结构，共振杂化产生典型的避免交叉。
AI.conclusion: 动态冻结并不能普遍抑制准粒子诱导耗散，实际工作中需在动态冻结与准粒子损耗之间权衡，文章为识别远离有害共振的实验驱动参数提供了理论框架。

title: Stabilizer complexity and the Python's lunch
summary: In this note, we study the stabilizer complexity of the reduced density matrix corresponding to one side of a partially entangled thermal (PET) state with fixed energy boundary conditions in a holographic CFT. In particular, we study Wigner negativity, an operationally meaningful magic monotone which can be interpreted as the complexity of classically simulating any quantum circuit preparation of the reduced state on the subregion. Using assumptions on the pseudorandomness of the CFT spectrum and the heavy operator insertion, we observe that the Wigner negativity of the PET state relative to the microcanonical density matrix at the given energy is given by $\exp\left[\frac{1}{8G_N}(A_{\text{out}} - A_{\text{min}})\right]$, where $A_{\text{out}}$ is the area of the outer extremal surface, while $A_{\text{min}}$ is the area of the minimal extremal surface. Thus, the stabilizer complexity of the reduced density matrix on the boundary subregion is $O(1)$ in the absence of a python's lunch, but gets exponentially enhanced in the presence of a python's lunch in the bulk geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了全息CFT中部分纠缠热（PET）态约化密度矩阵的稳定子复杂度，发现其Wigner负性由外极值面面积与最小极值面面积之差决定，表现为指数形式exp[(A_out - A_min)/8G_N]，从而稳定子复杂度在没有"蟒蛇午餐"时为O(1)，存在"蟒蛇午餐"时呈指数增强。
AI.motivation: 作者希望从全息对偶的角度理解量子态的稳定子复杂度（stabilizer complexity）与魔幻（magic）资源。Wigner负性作为可操作的魔幻单调量，可解释为量子电路制备该态所需的经典模拟复杂度。通过研究PET态在给定能量下的约化密度矩阵，作者旨在建立体几何结构（特别是极值面的存在性，即"蟒蛇午餐"）与边界态魔幻复杂度之间的定量联系。
AI.method: 作者在固定能量边界条件的全息CFT中构造PET态，利用CFT能谱及重算子插入的伪随机性假设，计算约化密度矩阵相对于微正则密度矩阵的Wigner负性。推导过程中关联了体几何中的外极值面（outer extremal surface）和最小极值面（minimal extremal surface）的面积，从而将Wigner负性表达为这两者面积差的指数函数。
AI.result: 推导出Wigner负性为exp[(A_out - A_min)/8G_N]。当体几何中没有"蟒蛇午餐"时（即无额外的极值面结构），稳定子复杂度为O(1)；当存在"蟒蛇午餐"时，稳定子复杂度获得指数增强。这建立了量子信息论中的魔幻资源与全息几何中的拓扑结构（极值面）之间的定量对应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了一个重要全息对应关系：体几何中"蟒蛇午餐"结构的存在会导致边界约化密度矩阵的稳定子复杂度呈指数增长。这为理解量子引力的computational complexity与量子信息论中的magic resource之间的关系提供了新的视角，也进一步支持了"复杂度=体分（complexity=volume-like）"猜想类方向的研究。

title: Dual Gauge Theory for Two Dimensional Superfluid Turbulence
summary: We describe turbulent hydrodynamics of superfluids in two spatial dimensions via the dynamics of point-like vortices coupled to an emergent 2+1 dimensional $U(1)$ gauge field. The cascade of superfluid kinetic energy is equivalently described by a cascade of dual electric field energies. We study superfluid turbulence using the equations of motion of the dual gauge theory in the presence of a drive and dissipation. In the limit that the vortices are point-like, the dual equations of motion directly yield the hydrodynamical equations of the superfluid. We obtain a turbulent cascade consistent with Kolmogorov's scaling law for two dimensional fluid turbulence. We observe clustering of like-signed vortices and compute the kinetic energy flux to show that the turbulent regime exhibits an inverse energy cascade.

AI.tldr: 本文通过二维超流体中点状涡旋与涌现的2+1维U(1)规范场的耦合动力学，描述了超流体湍流。超流体动能级联等价于对偶电场能量的级联，并发现与二维流体湍流的Kolmogorov标度律一致的湍流级联，同时观察到同号涡旋聚集以及逆能量级联现象。
AI.motivation: 二维超流体湍流是一个基础但复杂的问题，理解其湍流级联机制（正/逆级联）具有重要的物理意义。作者通过将对偶规范理论框架引入超流体湍流研究，旨在为超流体湍流提供一个新的、等价的描述框架，从而更深入地理解二维超流体中的能量级联与涡旋动力学行为。
AI.method: 作者将二维超流体中点状涡旋的动力学与涌现的2+1维U(1)规范场耦合起来，利用对偶规范理论的运动方程在存在驱动和耗散的情况下研究超流体湍流。在点状涡旋极限下，对偶运动方程直接还原为超流体的流体动力学方程，并通过计算动能通量来分析湍流级联的性质。
AI.result: 获得了与二维流体湍流Kolmogorov标度律一致的湍流级联；观察到了同号涡旋的聚集现象；通过计算动能通量证明了湍流区域表现出逆能量级联（inverse energy cascade）。
AI.conclusion: 对偶规范理论框架可以等价并且有效地描述二维超流体湍流，其中超流体动能级联可等价为对偶电场能量的级联。该框架重现了Kolmogorov标度律，并揭示了二维超流体湍流中同号涡旋聚集与逆能量级联等关键物理特征。

title: Type III von Neumann Algebras are Magical
summary: The number of non-Clifford gates needed to perform a task, or simply \textit{magic}, is a resource for fault-tolerant quantum computation. Von Neumann algebras provide a formal mathematical structure to describe infinite-dimensional quantum systems, such as those in quantum field theory or quantum statistical mechanics. A particularly important class of von Neumann algebras is called Type III algebras, for which the standard notions of finite-dimensional systems such as density matrices and traces break down. In this work, we argue that Type III von Neumann algebras fundamentally require an infinite amount of magic. Specifically, we consider the thermodynamic limit of finite-dimensional quantum systems, such as lattice systems, and show that if the states in the thermodynamic limit possess only a bounded amount of magic, the resulting local von Neumann algebra cannot be of Type III. Our result has direct implications for the quantum simulations of quantum field theories, for which the algebra of a local subregion is known to be of Type III.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了Type III von Neumann代数本质上需要无限量的magic（非Clifford门资源）。作者考虑有限维量子系统（如格点系统）的热力学极限，证明如果热力学极限下的态仅具有有界数量的magic，则相应的局部von Neumann代数不可能是Type III的。这对量子场论的量子模拟有直接影响，因为局部子区域的代数已知是Type III的。
AI.motivation: 探索Type III von Neumann代数（描述无穷维量子系统如量子场论和量子统计力学的数学结构）所需的magic资源量。由于Type III代数中密度矩阵和迹等标准概念失效，其是否本质上需要无限量magic是一个根本性的开放问题，对于理解容错量子计算中非Clifford门的资源需求至关重要。
AI.method: 作者从有限维量子系统（如格点系统）的热力学极限出发进行分析。通过论证：若热力学极限下的态只含有有界数量的magic（即非Clifford门资源有限），则相应的局部von Neumann代数不能是Type III类型。这是一个基于magic资源有界性与代数类型之间关系的理论论证。
AI.result: 证明了Type III von Neumann代数本质上要求无限量的magic资源。具体而言，热力学极限中若态只含bounded magic，则其局部von Neumann代数必然不是Type III的。由于量子场论局部子区域代数已知为Type III，这意味着量子场论的模拟本质上需要无限多的非Clifford门资源。
AI.conclusion: Type III von Neumann代数与无限magic资源之间存在根本性联系。这为量子场论量子模拟的资源复杂度提供了新的理论下界，表明模拟量子场论不可能仅依靠有限量的magic资源来完成，从而对容错量子计算的资源规划具有重要指导意义。

title: Ising-machine-like Driving Condition Restrictions in SSBM and Additional Pseudo-annealing- Driving Method for SSBM that Achieves Best Cut Value Search -
comment: 5 page, 3 figures and 1 Supplementary Materials file
summary: In our previous paper, we described the proposal and validation of a new physical implementation-type simulator (spontaneous symmetry breaking machine (SSBM)) for a combinatorial optimization problem that utilizes a phenomenon dual to the model in which a pseudo-spin many-body system is created by spontaneous symmetry breaking. Furthermore, we performed numerical simulations with different initial fluctuations on a large-scale benchmark problem (K_{2000}) and reported that we identified a condition under which pseudo-spin patterns gradually converge during the solution search process to ultimately form a single pattern and that the cut value of this converged solution reached 99.7% of the known best. In this paper, we discuss the conditions under which the SSBM can exhibit behavior analogous to that of a continuous-variable-type Ising machine, and report that by adding an effect similar to physical annealing to these conditions, the SSBM can be made to search for the best known cuts in K_{2000}.

AI.tldr: 本文在前作提出的自发对称破缺机（SSBM）基础上，探讨其能够表现出类似连续变量伊辛机行为的条件，并发现通过在这些条件下加入类似物理退火的效应，SSBM 能够在K_{2000}基准问题上搜索到已知最优切割。
AI.motivation: 前作已验证SSBM在K_{2000}大规模基准问题上可收敛至已知最优的99.7%，本文旨在进一步探索SSBM具备连续变量伊辛机类行为的条件，并通过物理退火效应提升其求解能力至已知最优水平。
AI.method: 分析SSBM展现连续变量型伊辛机行为的条件，并在满足这些条件的基础上引入类似物理退火的效应，对K_{2000}基准问题进行求解实验。
AI.result: 通过添加类似物理退火的效应，SSBM在K_{2000}问题上能够搜索到已知最佳切割值。
AI.conclusion: SSBM在特定条件融合物理退火机制后，可达到连续变量伊辛机的搜索能力，甚至获得已知最优解，进一步验证了其作为组合优化求解器的潜力。

title: One-sided stripe supersolidity from engineered non-axisymmetric dipolar interactions
summary: A supersolid combines density order with phase coherence, and doped lattice solids ask whether added defects can become coherent without melting the ordered background. We study a soft-core Bose-Hubbard model with isotropic hopping and an engineered non-axisymmetric dipolar interaction, \(V_{ij}=V_2(x_{ij}^2-y_{ij}^2)/r_{ij}^5+W_6/r_{ij}^6\), where the sign-changing \(d_{x^2-y^2}\) component selects a fixed \((q,0)\) stripe channel and the \(W_6/r^6\) core stabilizes the short-distance attractive branch. Using sign-problem-free quantum Monte Carlo method with worm algorithm, we find that the half-filled stripe parent responds asymmetrically to doping: the hole side forms locked commensurate stripe solids with vanishing superfluid stiffness, whereas the particle side forms a stripe supersolid with finite compressibility \(κ>0\), finite superfluid stiffness \(ρ_s>0\), and enhanced double occupancy \(D\). Keeping the same off-site kernel while increasing \(U/t\) toward the hard-core limit shows that the particle-side supersolid disappears once doublon-like defects are projected out. Thus the engineered dipolar kernel selects the fixed \((q,0)\) stripe channel, while onsite softness selects the phase-coherent defect sector.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究软核Bose-Hubbard模型中条纹超固体的掺杂行为。通过工程化非轴对称偶极相互作用锁定(q,0)条纹通道，发现半填充母体对空穴和粒子掺杂的响应不对称：空穴侧形成锁定共度条纹固体（超流刚度为零），粒子侧则形成具有有限压缩率、有限超流刚度和增强双占据的条纹超固体。增大U/t至硬核极限后粒子侧超固体消失，说明位点软性是相位相干缺陷扇区的关键。
AI.motivation: 超固体结合了密度序与相位相干，而掺杂的晶格固体提出了一个基本问题：加入的缺陷能否在不熔化有序背景的情况下变得相干。作者希望通过研究掺杂的条纹固体，理解缺陷相干性与背景有序之间的相互作用机制。
AI.method: 采用软核Bose-Hubbard模型，含各向同性跳跃和工程化的非轴对称偶极相互作用V_ij=V_2(x_ij^2-y_ij^2)/r_ij^5+W_6/r_ij^6。符号变化的d_{x^2-y^2}分量选择固定的(q,0)条纹通道，W_6/r^6核心项稳定短距离吸引分支。使用无符号问题的量子蒙特卡洛方法配合虫算法求解。
AI.result: 半填充条纹母体对掺杂具有不对称响应：空穴侧形成锁定的共度条纹固体，超流刚度消失；粒子侧形成条纹超固体，具有有限压缩率κ>0、有限超流刚度ρ_s>0和增强的双占据D。增大U/t趋向硬核极限时，粒子侧超固体消失，表明doublon类缺陷被投影掉后相位相干消失。
AI.conclusion: 工程化偶极核选择固定的(q,0)条纹通道，而位点软性（onsite softness）选择相位相干的缺陷扇区。这两个因素共同决定了掺杂条纹系统的超固体行为。

title: Critical Microwave Mach-Zehnder-Type Interferometry with Dual-LO Rydberg Atoms
summary: High-precision phase measurement of microwave fields underpins a wide range of applications, including wireless communications, distributed radar, plasma diagnostics, and antenna metrology. Existing Rydberg-atom-based approaches, however, often face trade-offs among phase resolution, measurement range, and system complexity. Here we demonstrate a Rydberg-atom-based microwave Mach-Zehnder-type interferometer using a dual-local-oscillator configuration. The two local oscillators establish two coherent interferometric pathways in the Rydberg medium. Their coherent mixing with the signal field produces an interferometric intermediate-frequency output governed by a phase-to-intensity transfer characteristic that enables critical-point enhancement. This scheme supports direct phase retrieval with a resolution exceeding $0.1^\circ$ and unambiguous full $360^\circ$ phase coverage with the reconfigurable dual-LO architecture. Moreover, near the critical interference point, the system exhibits a sharply enhanced phase-to-amplitude transduction, where weak amplitude variations are converted into pronounced phase responses, yielding a sensitivity enhancement exceeding 25 dB. Besides, the same interferometric transfer mechanism enables microwave propagation-distance and polarization metrology, achieving a propagation-distance precision below 20 $μ$m at 5.7 GHz together with a polarization-angle resolution exceeding $0.1^\circ$. This approach eliminates the need for complex optical configurations and lock-in detection, providing a simple, scalable, and reconfigurable Mach-Zehnder-type quantum microwave interferometry framework for multifunctional high-precision microwave metrology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并演示了一种基于里德伯原子和双本地振荡器（dual-LO）结构的微波马赫-曾德尔干涉仪，实现了优于0.1°的相位解析精度、完整360°相位覆盖、超过25 dB的相位-幅度转换灵敏度增强，并拓展至微波传播距离（<20 μm @ 5.7 GHz）和偏振角（>0.1°）计量，无需复杂光学配置和锁相检测。
AI.motivation: 高精度微波相位测量广泛应用于无线通信、分布式雷达、等离子体诊断和天线计量等领域，但现有基于里德伯原子的方法在相位分辨率、测量范围和系统复杂度之间存在权衡，亟需一种同时兼顾高分辨率、全范围覆盖和低复杂度的方案。
AI.method: 采用双本地振荡器配置构建里德伯原子微波马赫-曾德尔型干涉仪：两个本地振荡器在里德伯介质中建立两条相干干涉路径，与信号场相干混频产生中频输出；利用相位到强度的传递特性实现临界点增强效应，通过可重构的dual-LO架构实现直接相位提取和全360°无模糊覆盖；同时利用干涉传递机制进行传播距离和偏振计量。
AI.result: 相位解析精度优于0.1°，覆盖完整360°相位范围；在临界干涉点附近获得超过25 dB的相位-幅度转换灵敏度增强；在5.7 GHz下实现低于20 μm的传播距离测量精度，偏振角分辨率优于0.1°。
AI.conclusion: 该方法消除了对复杂光学配置和锁相检测的需求，提供了一种简单、可扩展、可重构的马赫-曾德尔型量子微波干涉测量框架，适用于多功能高精度微波计量。

title: Inductively-protected Andreev (IPA) spin qubit
summary: The spin of a quasiparticle trapped in a quantum dot Josephson junction forms the basis of an Andreev spin qubit (ASQ): a semiconductor-superconductor device where the interplay between a localized spin degree of freedom and superconductivity leads to a spin-resolved Josephson potential. In this work, we show that shunting an ASQ with a linear inductor enhances its relaxation time by separating the spin-qubit states into distinct potential wells in phase space, nearly eliminating wavefunction overlap. The resulting inductively protected Andreev (IPA) spin qubit is equivalent to two fluxoniums in the heavy regime, one for each spin. Thus, the IPA qubit combines the long coherence times, low-frequency ground-state manifold, and large anharmonicity of a protected superconducting qubit with the operational advantages of a spin degree of freedom.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种电感保护的安德烈夫自旋量子比特（IPA），通过将ASQ并联线性电感，将自旋量子比特态分离到相位空间的不同势阱中，几乎消除了波函数重叠，从而显著延长弛豫时间。该量子比特等效于两个重磁通型量子比特（重极限中的两个fluxonium），兼具受保护超导量子比特的长相干时间、低频基态流形和大非谐性，以及自旋自由度的操作优势。
AI.motivation: 安德烈夫自旋量子比特（ASQ）利用量子点约瑟夫森结中准粒子自旋与超导性之间的相互作用形成自旋分辨的约瑟夫森势，但其弛豫时间受自旋态间波函数重叠限制。作者希望通过引入电感分流来保护该自旋量子比特，延长其相干时间。
AI.method: 将ASQ与线性电感并联分流，使自旋量子比特态在相位空间中分别落入不同的势阱中，从而几乎完全消除两个自旋态波函数之间的重叠，实现电感保护的安德烈夫自旋量子比特（IPA）。该方案从理论上等价于两个重磁通极限下的fluxonium量子比特（每个自旋对应一个）。
AI.result: 电感分流显著延长了ASQ的弛豫时间；IPA量子比特等效于两个重极限fluxonium的叠加，结合了受保护超导量子比特的优势（长相干时间、低频基态流形、大非谐性）与自旋自由度的操作便捷性。
AI.conclusion: IPA量子比特通过电感保护策略实现了自旋量子比特与受保护超导量子比特優势的融合，为半导体-超导体混合量子计算平台提供了一种具有长弛豫时间和优越操作特性的新型量子比特方案。
